🇹🇷Malzemeler
Kişi sayısına göre küçük boy lavaş
Küçük boy 1 taco burger için yaklaşık 55–60 g orta yağlı dana kıyma (Ben tek çekim kıyma kullandım.)
Tuz
Karabiber
Ceddar peyniri

Not: Ben 10 adet küçük boy taco burger hazırladım ve toplam 600 g kıyma kullandım.

Hazırlanışı

Kıymayı tuz ve karabiber ile lezzetlendirip güzelce yoğurun. Ardından yaklaşık 55–60 g olacak şekilde porsiyonlara ayırıp yuvarlayın.

Kıymayı lavaşın üzerine yerleştirin ve elinizle iyice bastırarak lavaşın üzerine ince bir şekilde yayın.

Yapışmaz tavayı  ısıtın. Kıymalı tarafı alta gelecek şekilde lavaşları tavaya yerleştirin ve yaklaşık 2 dakika kızartın.

Daha sonra taco burgerleri çevirin ve üzerine çedar peyniri ekleyin. Tavanın kapağını kapatıp peynir eriyene ve lavaşın altı güzelce kızarana kadar pişirin.

Pişen taco burgerleri tavadan alın. Üzerine dilediğiniz malzemeleri ve sosları ekleyip servis edin.

Burger Sosu

Malzemeler
120 g mayonez
2 tatlı kaşığı ketçap
2 tatlı kaşığı hardal
1 diş sarımsak, ezilmiş
1 yemek kaşığı çok ince doğranmış kornişon turşu
3-4 tatlı kaşığı turşu suyu
½ tatlı kaşığı şeker
Bir tutam tuz
Bir tutam karabiber
½ tatlı kaşığı kırmızı toz biber 

Hazırlanışı
Tüm malzemeleri bir kaseye alın ve güzelce karıştırın. Sosunuz hazır.

Ayrıca:
½ adet beyaz soğan
½ adet kırmızı soğan
2 tatlı kaşığı soya sosu
1 tatlı kaşığı esmer şeker
½ yemek kaşığı tereyağı

Hazırlanışı
Soğanları yarım ay şeklinde doğrayın.
Tereyağını tavada eritin ve soğanları ekleyin. Orta ateşte, ara sıra karıştırarak soğanları yavaşça kavurun. Ardından esmer şekeri ve soya sosunu ekleyin. Ara sıra karıştırarak soğanları güzelce karamelize edin.
Hazırladığınız karamelize soğanları sosa ekleyip karıştırın.

recipe.description: high protein low carb keto gluten free balanced Butter Chicken.

ingredients.name: plain tomato sauce, canned tomatoes, or crushed tomatoes

instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine cubed chicken thighs, grated garlic, grated ginger, Whole Fat Yogurt, and lemon juice. Mix well.
Step 2: In a separate bowl, mix paprika, turmeric, cumin, cayenne, chili powder, salt, and garam masala to create the spice mix.
Step 3: Add the spice mix to the chicken mixture and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Step 4: In a pan, heat butter and oil (or ghee) over medium heat.
Step 5: Add diced onion and sauté until translucent.
Step 6: Add garlic and ginger, and cook for another minute.
Step 7: Stir in garam masala, coriander, and cumin, and cook for a minute until fragrant.
Step 8: Add the marinated chicken to the pan and cook until browned.
Step 9: Pour in the tomato sauce and bring to a simmer.
Step 10: Stir in heavy cream and cook until the sauce thickens.
Step 11: Add sugar to taste to balance the tanginess from the tomatoes.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a bowl, combine the zucchini, mushrooms, cherry tomatoes, bell pepper, and red onion.
Drizzle with olive oil, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, salt, and cracked black pepper. Toss to coat.
Spread the vegetables on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes until tender.

meta.description:
🍽️ ESCONDIDINHO DE ALMÔNDEGAS

Sabe aquele dia que a sua fome pede comida de mãe? Então faz esse escondidinho de almôndegas. É daqueles pratos que abraçam a gente: purê cremoso, almôndegas bem temperadas, molho de tomate e muito queijo gratinado por cima. ❤️

🍳Tudo o que aparece por aqui e eu considero uma boa compra, desde ingredientes até utensílios de cozinha, costuma ser compartilhado no meu grupo de ofertas através da minha curadoria gratuita diária.

📝 Purê de Batatas

• 4 batatas médias descascadas e em cubos
• 1 colher (sopa) de manteiga ou azeite
• 1/4 de xícara de leite
• Sal, pimenta-do-reino e noz-moscada a gosto

👩‍🍳 Preparo do Purê

Cozinhe as batatas até ficarem macias. Escorra, amasse bem e volte para a panela. Acrescente a manteiga e o leite aos poucos, mexendo até formar um purê cremoso. Tempere a gosto.

📝 Almôndegas

• 400 g de carne moída
• 1/2 cebola picada ou ralada
• 2 dentes de alho amassados
• 1 colher (sopa) de farelo de aveia ou psyllium
• Sal, pimenta-do-reino, salsa e cebolinha a gosto
• 300 ml de molho de tomate

👩‍🍳 Preparo das Almôndegas

Misture todos os ingredientes, modele as bolinhas e cozinhe diretamente no molho de tomate por cerca de 15 minutos ou doure na Airfryer a 180°C por 8 a 10 minutos antes de juntar ao molho.

🧀 Montagem

• Purê de batatas
• Almôndegas ao molho
• Muçarela fatiada
• Orégano

Espalhe o purê em um refratário, distribua as almôndegas com o molho, cubra com a muçarela e finalize com orégano. Leve ao forno a 200°C por cerca de 10 minutos, até o queijo derreter e gratinar.
Créditos @luannafreitas._ ✨

meta.title: Video by butterwithwafa

recipe.description: vegetarian high protein balanced Fruity Pebbles Cinnamon Rolls.
instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine milk, sugar, and yeast. Let it sit for 5-10 minutes until frothy.
Step 2: Add eggs and vanilla extract to the mixture and mix well.
Step 3: Gradually add flour and salt, mixing until a dough forms.
Step 4: Knead in softened butter and fruity pebbles until smooth.
Step 5: Cover the dough and let it rise for about 1 hour or until doubled in size.
Step 6: For the filling, beat together softened butter, cream cheese, granulated sugar, lemon juice, and vanilla extract until smooth.
Step 7: Stir in fruity pebbles into the filling mixture.
Step 8: Roll out the dough on a floured surface and spread the filling evenly over it.
Step 9: Roll the dough tightly and slice into rolls.
Step 10: Place rolls in a baking dish and let them rise for another 30 minutes.
Step 11: Bake in a preheated oven at 350°F (175°C) for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown.
Step 12: For the icing, beat together cream cheese, softened butter, powdered sugar, and vanilla extract until smooth.
Step 13: Drizzle the icing over the warm rolls and top with fruity pebbles.
recipe.name: Fruity Pebbles Cinnamon Rolls

instructions: En un recipiente agregamos 40g de harina de trigo y 10g de azúcar para la mezcla de la levadura.
Añadimos 80ml de agua tibia y 3g de levadura instantánea a la mezcla anterior.

En otro recipiente, combinamos 560g de harina de trigo, 220ml de agua, 40g de azúcar, 10g de sal y 30g de manteca vegetal.

meta.description:
Key Lime Pie meets cheesecake for one of our favorite cheesecake variations: key lime cheesecake. This key lime cheesecake is based on our grandma’s classic cheesecake recipe, but includes lime juice and zest for a key lime twist on the classic. The base is a graham cracker crust and it is topped with a creamy key lime cheesecake layer. After baking, it is topped with a layer of key lime curd. 

All ingredients needed below & full recipe can be found in link in bio 🍋‍🟩 happy baking !
xx Maddie & Jules

Ingredients
Crust:
1 ½ sticks butter melted
2 ½ cups graham cracker crumbs 15 sheets, a little less than 2 packages that come in a box of 3
¼ cup sugar
½ teaspoon salt
Filling:
40 oz cream cheese room temperature (5x 8 oz sticks)
1/4 cup heavy cream
2 teaspoons vanilla
2 cups sugar
2 teaspoons lime zest
3 tablespoons flour 1 tablespoon cornstarch
½ cup lime juice
½ teaspoon salt
5 eggs + 2 egg yolks
Topping:
1/4 cup lime juice + 1 tablespoon lemon juice
2 large eggs
3/8 cups sugar
1 pinch salt
½ cup unsalted butter
2 teaspoons lime zest

Video by kitchen_bythesea
meta.title: Video by kitchen_bythesea

recipe.description: high protein Key Lime Cheesecake.
instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 325°F (163°C).
Step 2: In a bowl, mix melted butter, graham cracker crumbs, sugar, and salt to form the crust.
Step 3: Press the crust mixture into the bottom of a springform pan.
Step 4: In a large mixing bowl, beat cream cheese until smooth.
Step 5: Add heavy cream, vanilla, sugar, lime zest, flour, cornstarch, lime juice, and salt. Mix until well combined.
Step 6: Add eggs and egg yolks one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
Step 7: Pour the filling into the prepared crust.
Step 8: Bake for 60-70 minutes or until the center is set.
Step 9: In a separate bowl, whisk together lime juice, lemon juice, large eggs, sugar, and salt for the topping.
Step 10: Pour the topping over the cheesecake and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes.
Step 11: Remove from the oven and let cool before refrigerating for at least 4 hours.
Step 12: Once chilled, top with unsalted butter and lime zest before serving.
recipe.name: Key Lime Cheesecake
notes: Crust is made from graham cracker crumbs, melted butter, sugar, and salt.
Filling includes cream cheese, heavy cream, vanilla, sugar, lime zest, flour, cornstarch, lime juice, salt, eggs, and egg yolks.
Topping is a key lime curd made with lime juice, lemon juice, eggs, sugar, salt, unsalted butter, and lime zest.

sample_steps: Step 1: Make a custard by mixing together the milk and sugar.
Step 2: Heat the mixture over a double boiler.

meta.description:
Banana Ice-Cream. — Make a custard with one pint of milk, one cup of sugar, and two eggs. When cold, add one pint of cream, and six bananas, sifted, or cut in thin slices. Add a little lemon juice if the bananas lack flavor. 

Tips for making a custard: mixed together, your milk and your sugar. Then take out a little bit of this mixture after it’s heated a little bit over the double boiler and add that to your eggs. You decrease the chances that your eggs will scramble. That is called tempering your eggs once you have done that add the egg mixture back into the custard and you’re going to cook it over low heat. The customer covers the back of a spoon. That’s about the time that it will reach 175°. At that point, let your custard cool before making your ice cream.  It needs to cool several hours. 

Once it has cooled really well, mix it with your heavy cream, and any other flavorings or toppings that you want, and then add it to your ice cream maker. Crank the Ice Cream for approximately 25 to 30 minutes . This will create almost like a soft serve consistency. You can freeze it at that point. That it’s called ripening the Ice Cream.#FourthOfJuly #HomemadeIce cream.#FrozenCustard.

meta.title: Video by pas.ttimecook

recipe.description: vegetarian high protein low carb keto gluten free balanced Banana Ice-Cream.
instructions: Step 1: Make a custard by mixing together the milk and sugar.
Step 2: Heat the mixture over a double boiler.
Step 3: Take out a little bit of the heated mixture and add it to the eggs to temper them.
Step 4: Add the tempered egg mixture back into the custard.
Step 5: Cook the custard over low heat until it coats the back of a spoon and reaches about 175°F.
Step 6: Let the custard cool for several hours.
Step 7: Once cooled, mix in the heavy cream and any additional flavorings or toppings.
Step 8: Add the mixture to an ice cream maker and churn for approximately 25 to 30 minutes.
Step 9: Freeze the ice cream to achieve a firmer consistency.
recipe.name: Banana Ice-Cream
notes: Tempering eggs prevents scrambling.
Custard should reach 175°F to thicken properly.
Ripening the ice cream involves freezing after churning.

meta.description:
💫FIDEOS CON SALSA 🍝 | Receta S. XIX

Una receta sencilla, humilde y llena de sabor. Así se preparaban estos fideos con salsa en los antiguos recetarios catalanes: un sofrito de ajo y perejil, una picada para espesar la salsa y un toque de limón que lo cambia todo. 🍋

📝 Ingredientes

🫒 aceite de oliva virgen extra
🧄 dientes de ajo
🌿 Un buen manojo de perejil
🌰  piñones
💧 agua
🍝 de fideos
🧂 Sal al gusto
🌿 Una pizca de especias (pimienta, canela o nuez moscada, al gusto)
🍋 piel de limón

👨‍🍳 Elaboración

1️⃣ Sofríe los ajos picados junto con el perejil en el aceite hasta que desprendan todo su aroma. 🧄🌿

2️⃣ Mientras tanto, prepara una picada machacando los piñones (o las almendras) con una pizca de sal. Añádela al sofrito y cocina un minuto más. 🌰

3️⃣ Incorpora el agua poco a poco, removiendo para que la picada se disuelva y forme una salsa ligera. 💧

4️⃣ Cuando rompa a hervir, añade los fideos, sazona con sal, incorpora las especias y un trocito de piel de limón. 🍝🍋

5️⃣ Cocina hasta que los fideos estén en su punto y la salsa haya espesado ligeramente. ¡Listo para servir! 😋

recipe.description: Fideos con salsa.
instructions: Sofríe los ajos picados junto con el perejil en el aceite hasta que desprendan todo su aroma.
Mientras tanto, prepara una picada machacando los piñones (o las almendras) con una pizca de sal. Añádela al sofrito y cocina un minuto más.
Incorpora el agua poco a poco, removiendo para que la picada se disuelva y forme una salsa ligera.
Cuando rompa a hervir, añade los fideos, sazona con sal, incorpora las especias y un trocito de piel de limón.
Cocina hasta que los fideos estén en su punto y la salsa haya espesado ligeramente. ¡Listo para servir!
recipe.name: Fideos con salsa
notes: Receta sencilla, humilde y llena de sabor.
Se puede usar almendras en lugar de piñones para la picada.

summary.name: Chicken Stock
sample_ingredients: 4 leg quarters or a whole roasted chicken carcass
sample_steps: Rinse veggies thoroughly and roughly chop in half.
Throw everything in a stockpot.

meta.description:
pov: it's time for a new batch of chicken stock!

I love sipping on this in the morning before coffee and after my long run for recovery! Tastes great with some salt and fantastic for enhancing any recipe! 🍲

Ingredients:
4 leg quarters or a whole roasted chicken carcass
6-8 unpeeled carrots (sweeter stock)
4-5 celery stalks (the leafier, the better)
1 medium onion (skin on)
8 whole garlic cloves (minimum)
10ish or a little palm full of whole black peppercorns
1 tsp sea salt (season more later to taste)
Fresh herbs - I love lots of Thyme and a few Bay leaves, Oregano and Sage are great too!

Rinse veggies throughly, you'll be using all of the parts. Roughly chop in half so everything fits nicely.

Throw everything in a stockpot. 
*This one I'm using is my ride or die that I bought from Macy's when my husband and I got our first apartment 15ish years ago. 🥹 It's an 11 quart farberware Stockpot I for all my soups and sauces. Sadly I've since lost the lid but I still use it every week 🥲*

Cover the veggies and chicken with 16ish cups of water (or up to the handle). I like to add a little more just to cover the contents as it really does simmer down quite a bit.

Heat on high until boiling then bring down to a simmer.

Now, there's a couple different ways to do this depending on if you're cooking your meat to start or just using a leftover carcass.

Here I start by simmering for 40 minutes to cook the leg quarters, they'll usually float. Then I will remove and let cool before removing the skin and most of the meat! Drizzle those bones with some olive oil and bake for about 45 minutes on 450 degrees, until nice and crispy and golden brown. 

If using a carcass, skip and keep simmering.

Once done, throw everything back in your simmering pot (all bits from the pan included) and continue to simmer on low, mostly covered, for 8 to 12 hours! I usually start this early am on a work from home day and let this simmer until after dinner.

Double and triple strain! Then store in mason jars in the fridge, 5-6 days, or in the freezer a few months.

Enjoy! 🩷

summary.name: Bone Broth
sample_ingredients: variety (marrow, knuckles, joints, feet, oxtail) bones
to soak bones apple cider vinegar
sample_steps: Rinse bones first to remove dust, blood, and impurities that cloud the broth.
Blanch for the clearest broth: place raw bones in cold water, bring to a boil, drain, and rinse before starting.

meta.description:
- Rinse bones first to remove dust, blood, and impurities that cloud the broth
- Blanch for the clearest broth, place raw bones in cold water, bring to a boil, drain, and rinse before starting. Japanese and Chinese broth making always begins here
- Roast at 200 degrees for 30 to 45 minutes, caramelization develops a depth of flavor raw bones cannot produce
- Soak in cold water with apple cider vinegar for 30 to 60 minutes before heat, draws out impurities and starts breaking down the mineral matrix
- Start with cold water and bring up slowly for a clearer more mineral dense broth
- Use a variety of bones, marrow for richness, knuckles and joints for collagen, feet for gelatin, oxtail for depth
- Never boil, a lazy simmer produces something golden and deeply nourishing, low and slow always
- Add kombu and remove before serving, deepens savory quality and adds iodine for thyroid support
- Skim foam in the first 20 minutes for a cleaner clearer broth
- Hardy aromatics go in at the beginning, delicate herbs go in the last hour
- Salt at the very end, it concentrates as the broth reduces
Gel is the goal. If your broth sets like jello in the fridge you did everything right. That gel is collagen converted to gelatin and it is where all the magic lives.
- Save the fat cap, rich in fat soluble vitamins and the most ancestral cooking fat available, scoop into a jar and use all week
- Cool quickly in an ice bath before refrigerating to prevent histamine accumulation and spoilage

recipe.description: vegetarian high protein balanced Illegal Banana Bread.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
In a bowl, mash the 3 overripe bananas.

Add 240 g of all-purpose flour, 200 g of light brown sugar, ½ tsp of baking powder, ½ tsp of baking soda, 2 large eggs, 180 ml of neutral oil, 120 g of Greek yogurt, 1 tsp of vanilla extract, 1 tsp of salt, and ½ tsp of ground cinnamon to the mashed bananas.
Mix until well combined.
Fold in 1/3 cup of mini chocolate chips.
For the topping, arrange enough bananas to cover the bottom of the baking pan.
In a small saucepan, combine 150 g of sugar and 20 ml of water, and heat until the sugar dissolves.
Pour the mixture over the arranged bananas.
Pour the banana bread batter over the bananas in the pan.
Bake for 45-55 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean from the middle.

In a mixing bowl, combine lump crab meat, cream cheese, Kewpie mayo, shredded habanero pepper jack (reserve half for top

meta.description:
A twist on a classic! Who doesn’t love crab rangoons. The addition of Cajun seasoning, bell peppers, smoked paprika and hot sauce took it to another level! Here is the recipe! 

Cajun Crab Rangoon Dip

Ingredients

* 8 oz lump crab meat (can sub imitation crab)
* 6 oz cream cheese, softened
* 1/4 cup Kewpie mayo
* 1/2 cup shredded habanero pepper jack (half for dip and half for topping)
* 1 tbsp Cajun seasoning
* 1 tsp garlic powder
* 1 tsp onion powder
* ½ tbsp hot sauce
* 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce
* 1/2 cup bell pepper, finely diced
* Smoked paprika to taste
* Chives 

For Serving

* Fried wonton chips
* Ritz crackers

Can be served cold but best served warm bake in the oven for 10 mins at 350F. Best severed with wonton chips but crackers or bread can be used. The Cajun seasoning used is from Gator Dust in Louisiana! 🐊

recipe.description: low carb keto gluten free balanced Cajun Crab Rangoon Dip.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F.

In a mixing bowl, combine lump crab meat, cream cheese, Kewpie mayo, shredded habanero pepper jack (reserve half for topping), Cajun seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, hot sauce, Worcestershire sauce, and finely diced bell pepper.
Mix until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with the reserved shredded habanero pepper jack.
Bake in the oven for 10 minutes.
Serve warm with fried wonton chips or Ritz crackers.

Video by nahlahrsl
meta.title: Video by nahlahrsl

recipe.description: vegetarian high protein balanced Caramel Tres Leches.
instructions: Preheat the oven and prepare the baking dish.
Separate the egg yolks and whites.
Whisk the egg yolks with caster sugar until pale.
Add vegetable oil and whole milk to the egg yolk mixture.
Sift in the cake flour and add vanilla extract. Whisk until silky smooth.
In a separate bowl, beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Gently fold the egg whites into the cake batter.
Pour the batter into the prepared baking dish and bake until golden.
Once baked, let the cake cool.
Prepare the tres leches mixture by combining condensed milk, evaporated milk, and whole milk.
Poke holes in the cooled cake and pour the tres leches mixture over it.
Chill the cake in the refrigerator.
For the caramel, melt sugar until golden, then add butter and cream.
Stir until smooth and add vanilla and sea salt.
Pour the caramel over the chilled cake before serving.
recipe.name: Caramel Tres Leches
notes: Vanilla sponge cake soaked with three types of milk
Topped with caramel sauce

recipe.description: vegetarian Strawberry Marble Shortbread Cookies.

ingredients.name: ruby chocolate (may replace with white chocolate)

instructions: Step 1: Preheat your oven and prepare two 8” x 8” pans.
Step 2: In a mixing bowl, combine cold salted butter, icing sugar, milk powder, and all-purpose flour. Mix until well combined.
Step 3: Divide the dough into two portions.
Step 4: Melt the white chocolate compound and mix with one portion of the dough.
Step 5: Melt the ruby chocolate and mix with the other portion of the dough along with the butter/shortening/coconut oil and strawberry flavouring.
Step 6: Layer the two doughs in the prepared pans and swirl them together to create a marble effect.
Step 7: Bake in the preheated oven until golden.
Step 8: For the marble drizzle, melt the white chocolate compound and mix with the butter/shortening/coconut oil and food colouring.
Step 9: Drizzle the melted mixture over the cooled cookies.
recipe.name: Strawberry Marble Shortbread Cookies

recipe.description: Clásica torta tres leches.

ingredients.name: harina de trigo todo uso (sin leudante)

instructions: Precalentar el horno a 170 grados.
En un bol, mezclar la harina, el azúcar y el polvo para hornear.
Agregar los huevos y la vainilla, y batir hasta obtener una mezcla homogénea.
Verter la mezcla en un molde y hornear de 20 a 25 minutos.
Mientras se hornea, preparar la mezcla de tres leches combinando la leche condensada, leche evaporada, crema de leche, vainilla, leche en polvo y canela.
Una vez que el bizcocho esté listo, sacarlo del horno y dejar enfriar.

Verter la mezcla de tres leches sobre el bizcocho, asegurándose de que se empape bien.
Para la decoración, batir la chantilly con el azúcar y la vainilla.
Cubrir el bizcocho con la chantilly y decorar al gusto.

meta.description:
Espresso martini cheesecake ☕️

Echt een perfect herfst dessert! Een knapperige koekjes bodem met een zachte espresso martini cheesecake laag en extra veel cacao, dat wil je! 

Dit heb je nodig: (voor 2 personen)
☕️ 4 Speculaas koekjes
☕️ 125 gram roomkaas
☕️ 80 milliliter slagroom
☕️ 1 espresso (afgekoeld)
☕️ 15 milliliter vodka
☕️ 50 gram poedersuiker
☕️ 30 gram cacao poeder

Zo maak je het:
1️⃣ Doe de speculaas koekjes in een zakje en sla hier op met een lepel tot dat het fijne kruimels worden.
2️⃣ Klopt de slagroom stijf samen met de poedersuiker.
3️⃣ Klop in een andere kom de roomkaas voor 2 minuten op een hoge stand.
4️⃣ Voeg de slagroom toe aan het roomkaas baslag en meng dit voorzichtig met een spatel. 
5️⃣ Als laatste voeg je de espresso en de vodka toe. Dit meng je ook heel kort met een spatel.
6️⃣Verdeel het cheesecake mengsel over 2 glaasjes.
7️⃣ Maak het af met cacaopoeder en een koffieboontje. Laat het een uur opstijven in de koelkast en het is helemaal klaar! 😍

- Once cooled wrap in foil and store in the fridge or freezer
- To reheat from the fridge, unwrap from the foil and airfry for for 4-5 minutes  at 200°C till
Crispy and lightly puffed again 
- to reheat from the freezer unwrap from the foil, airfry at 200° for 10-12 minutes to get crispy and light puffed

summary.name: Garlicky schnitzel salad
sample_ingredients: enough to cover garlic in pan oil
sample_steps: Step 1: In a pan, combine 12 cloves of garlic and 1 cup of olive oil with a sprig of rosemary.
Step 2: Heat the oil gently until the garlic softens and turns sweet, and the rosemary crisps.

meta.description:
Garlicky schnitzel salad. Full recipe is up on my website–link in bio. 

Few things in food are as satisfying as the contrast between a hot, crispy schnitzel and a cool, bright salad. It’s a pairing built on balance. This dish leans into that idea completely, but then you just hit it with garlic from all angles. 

It all begins with garlic — lots of it. A dozen cloves go into a pan of cold oil along with a sprig of rosemary. As the oil gently comes up to temperature, the garlic softens and turns sweet, the rosemary crisps, and the oil itself becomes infused with that goodness. This lays the foundation for everything else in this dish. Nothing here goes to waste: the garlic, the rosemary, and the oil all reappear later in different forms.

Some of that confit garlic gets thrown into a vinaigrette with anchovies, Dijon, and champagne vinegar. It’s bright and slightly sweet. The perfect pairing are bitter greens like arugula, fennel, red onion, and radicchio. 

The rest of the garlic and rosemary are chopped down and folded into a creamy mayo with capers, gherkins, Worcestershire, and a touch of hot sauce. It’s briny, tangy, and a little spicy — the perfect condiment for dunking some schnitzel into.

The result is a plate that’s fresh and crisp, savory and rich — satisfying on every level.

Video by cheffinwithzach
meta.title: Video by cheffinwithzach

recipe.description: low carb gluten free balanced Garlicky schnitzel salad.

ingredients.name: oil
ingredients.quantity: enough to cover garlic in pan

instructions: Step 1: In a pan, combine 12 cloves of garlic and 1 cup of olive oil with a sprig of rosemary.
Step 2: Heat the oil gently until the garlic softens and turns sweet, and the rosemary crisps.
Step 3: Remove some confit garlic and blend it with 2 anchovies, 1 tablespoon of Dijon mustard, and 2 tablespoons of champagne vinegar to make a vinaigrette.
Step 4: In a bowl, combine 2 cups of arugula, 1 cup of fennel, 1/2 red onion, and 1 cup of radicchio.

Step 5: In another bowl, chop the remaining garlic and rosemary, and mix with 1/2 cup of mayonnaise, 2 tablespoons of capers, 2 gherkins, 1 teaspoon of Worcestershire sauce, and 1 teaspoon of hot sauce.
Step 6: Serve the schnitzel with the salad and the creamy garlic mayo on the side, garnished with a lemon wedge.
recipe.name: Garlicky schnitzel salad
notes: Use all parts of the garlic, rosemary, and oil for different components of the dish.
The dish balances hot, crispy schnitzel with a cool, bright salad and garlicky flavors.

recipe.description: vegetarian Banana Cake with Caramel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170 degrees Celsius fan forced.
In a mixing bowl, combine self raising flour, white castor sugar, salted butter, milk, egg, vanilla, and sea salt flakes.
Mix until well combined.
Fold in the mashed banana and thick sliced bananas.
Pour the batter into a greased baking pan.
Bake for 40-50 minutes or until golden brown and a skewer comes out clean.
In a saucepan, melt unsalted butter and brown sugar over medium heat, stirring until combined.
Add a big pinch of sea salt flakes to the caramel mixture.
Serve the cake warm with pouring cream and drizzle with caramel.

meta.description:
🌽 Saigon Street Corn made with @chinsu_usa 

RECIPE

3 ears corn, kernels removed
2 tbsp butter
3 stalks scallions, thinly sliced (whites and greens separated)
1 tbsp dried shrimp
1 salted egg yolk
2 tbsp bacon bits
2 tsp CHINSU Phu Quoc Fish Sauce
1 tsp sugar
1 tbsp fried shallots
Mayonnaise, to garnish
CHINSU Hot Sauce, to garnish

In a pan over medium heat, melt the butter and add the corn kernels and scallion whites.
Saute for about 30 seconds until fragrant then add the salted egg yolk, dried shrimp, and bacon bits.
Mash up the salted egg yolk and thoroughly mix the ingredients. Saute for about 1 minute.
Turn the heat down and add the sugar and fish sauce.
Continue cooking for about 30 seconds until the flavors have melded.
Plate and garnish with fried shallots, mayonnaise, and hot sauce.

summary.name: 肉絲炒麵
sample_steps: 1️⃣柳脢切條，加入醃肉調味料拌勻。
2️⃣花菇切條。

meta.description:
#肉絲炒麵 《肉絲腍滑不嚡口 少油版煎麵 外脆內軟不油膩 港式脆麵家中做法分享》

很好吃的肉絲炒麵，其實自煮並不困難。首先煮滾一鍋水，熄火才放下蛋麵餅，用筷子鬆開，麵條要放涼風乾，無濕氣，再去煎。

肉絲我喜歡選用肉質腍滑的柳脢，切條後，用基本調味料去醃味。少許油，花菇和肉絲煎香，雞湯煮滾，鹽、糖調味，最後已雞湯生粉水埋芡，芡汁要濃稠一點，而快速翻炒過的芽菜和韭黃回鑊，快手拌勻。

我更喜歡家中做法的肉絲炒麵，食材豐富，還可加入大量芽菜和韭黃。

食譜分享📝
材料:
柳脢 246g
花菇 2隻 52g
韭黃 54g
芽菜 162g
蛋麵餅 2個
雞湯 350g
鹽 5g
糖 3g
紹興酒 20g
生粉 30g

醃肉調味料：
柳脢 246g
生抽 5g
蠔油 5g
糖 1g
生粉 2g
胡椒粉 少許
水 7g

做法：
1️⃣柳脢切條，加入醃肉調味料拌勻。
2️⃣花菇切條。
3️⃣韭黃切小段。
4️⃣雞湯、鹽、糖拌勻備用。
5️⃣煲滾一煲水，水要大滾，熄火，放下蛋麵餅，用筷子鬆開，瀝乾水，放涼，吹乾。
6️⃣適量油，放下蛋麵煎至金黃色，再反轉另一面，再煎至金黃色。
7️⃣適量油，快炒芽菜盛起。
8️⃣適量油，快炒韭黃盛起。
9️⃣適量油，炒香花菇，再煎香肉條，加入雞湯、鹽、糖煮滾（留起少許加生粉水打芡）。
🔟最後雞湯生粉水埋芡，再放下芽菜和韭黃拌勻，放在脆麵上即成。

烹調心得：
蛋麵餅切勿耐煮，浸熱水，用筷子鬆開便要立即盛起，放涼風乾，麵條無濕氣，才去煎。

鮮腐竹粒 170g
布包豆腐 2件
薑 3片
菇粉 2茶匙
香菇素蠔油 30g
鹽 半茶匙
糖 半茶匙
麻油 少許
生粉 少許
老抽 少許
熱水 500ml

做法：
1️⃣花菇浸軟，切半。
2️⃣雪耳浸軟去除硬蒂，用手搣成小塊。
3️⃣雲耳浸軟。
4️⃣甘筍用模具吸成蝴蝶花。
5️⃣珍珠筍斜切。
6️⃣布包豆腐一開四件，廚紙吸乾水備用。
7️⃣雪耳、雲耳、甘筍花、甜豆仁、珍珠筍和鮮腐竹粒快快氽水，瀝乾水備用。
8️⃣適量油，煎香豆腐盛起。
9️⃣適量油，煎香薑片，炒香花菇，然後加入已氽水雪耳、雲耳、甘筍花、甜豆仁、珍珠筍及香菇素蠔油一起炒香。
🔟放下鮮腐竹粒再次拌勻，加入熱水煮滾，煎香豆腐回鍋，鹽、糖、香菇粉調味。滾起後，吸蓋轉小火炆煮。
1️⃣1️⃣最後放下少許老抽調色，少許生粉水埋芡，麻油增添香氣，即成。

烹調心得：
炆煮菜式，建議早上或中午煮好，晚上翻熱會更入味更好吃。

meta.description:
#釀尖椒 《加料魚肉釀尖椒 比酒樓更好吃 簡易版甜豉油做法分享》

微辣爽脆尖椒搭配豐富的魚肉餡，還有自製甜豉油拌食，味道即時提升。

天氣持續炎熱，微辣的尖椒更能增進食慾。鯪魚肉餡我喜歡加些蝦米、陳皮和芫荽，吃下每一口都感到很豐富，魚肉餡融合了鹹鮮香氣，好吃好吃。

食譜分享📝
釀尖椒材料：
尖椒 10隻
鯪魚肉 12 両 454g
蝦米 40g
陳皮 12g
芫荽 48g
生抽 10g
糖 3g
胡椒粉 少許
生粉 少許

釀尖椒做法：
1️⃣陳皮、芫荽切碎。
2️⃣蝦米冲洗乾淨，瀝乾水。
3️⃣鯪魚肉加入蝦米、陳皮、芫荽、生抽、糖和胡椒粉，以順時針方向攪拌，攪拌至有黏性，備用。
4️⃣切去尖椒頂部，再打直切為一開二，去籽，放上少許生粉，釀入鯪魚肉。
5️⃣燒熱油，放下尖椒煎至鯪魚肉一面熟透，再反轉另一面煎幾十秒。
6️⃣最後淋上自製甜豉油，即可食用。

甜豉油材料：
薑 26g
蔥 22g
乾蔥 71g
芫荽頭 4個
生抽 20g
老抽 10g
冰糖 15g
水 50g
豬油 少許

甜豉油做法：
1️⃣薑拍鬆。
2️⃣蔥切斷。
3️⃣乾蔥切片。
4️⃣豬油煎香薑，再加入蔥、乾蔥、芫荽頭一起爆炒，加入冰糖略炒，加水煮滾，煮至水收乾，然後加入生抽、老抽拌勻，即成。

烹調心得：
尖椒內壁薄薄放上生粉，讓鯪魚肉與尖椒黏合，煎煮時魚肉餡不容易脫掉。

meta.description:
#冬瓜眉豆生熟薏米祛濕湯 《清熱祛濕 消暑解毒 炎夏家常好湯水分享》

冬瓜清熱，眉豆、薏米健脾祛濕，蓮子、百合滋陰潤肺，是炎夏湯水最經典的搭配。灰皮冬瓜肉質較厚，很適合用來煲老火湯，耐煮不易爛，建議連皮一起煲湯，具有清熱利尿，祛濕等功效。

食譜分享📝
材料：
灰皮冬瓜 884g
粟米 434g
紅蘿蔔 433g
眉豆 50g
蓮子 40g
生薏米 37g
熟薏米 10g
陳皮 1角
椰棗 5粒
瘦肉 326g
水 2500ml
鹽 適量

做法：
1️⃣灰皮冬瓜去囊去籽，切大件。
2️⃣粟米、紅蘿蔔切片。
3️⃣眉豆、蓮子、生熟薏米分別用清水浸泡，蓮子去芯備用。
4️⃣陳皮用水浸軟，浸陳皮水留起一起煲湯。（年份較淺陳皮，浸軟後刮囊。）
5️⃣瘦肉凍水氽水，再沖洗乾淨。
6️⃣煲滾2500 mL水，放下所有材料（鹽除外），中大火煲10分鐘，然後再用小火再煲1小時50分鐘，合共2小時。
7️⃣適量鹽調味即成。

烹調心得：
眉豆和蓮子建議提前用水浸泡後才煲湯，讓豆類吸飽水份，更容易煲至粉糯軟綿才好吃。

meta.description:
#花旗參石斛麥冬象拔蚌乾螺頭湯 《滋陰清熱 養胃生津 鮮甜潤肺養生靚湯水分享》 

花旗參清熱生津，石斛、麥冬滋陰潤肺、益胃，搭配擁有天然海味鮮味的螺頭和象拔蚌乾一起煲湯，此湯味道鮮甜，具有滋陰補腎功效。

乾貨食材建議用水沖洗乾淨，清水略浸。蓮子芯雖然有藥用價值，但味道極苦，去掉才煲湯較好。

食譜分享📝
材料：
花旗參 17g
鐵皮石斛  20g
野生麥冬  20g
象拔蚌乾  77g
美國螺頭  238g
海玉竹 39g
建寧蓮子 37g
龍牙百合 25g
圓肉 20g
陳皮 1角
椰棗 5粒
豬𦟌 368g
水2500ml
鹽 適量

做法：
1️⃣象拔蚌乾清水浸軟，連同解凍後的螺頭，豬𦟌，凍水一起氽水，螺頭用小刀刮乾淨表面，去掉內臟，沖洗乾淨，備用。
2️⃣花旗參、鐵皮石斛、野生麥冬、海玉竹、龍牙百合、圓肉，用水沖洗乾淨，略浸，花旗參切半。
3️⃣蓮子用水浸至漲大，去芯。
4️⃣陳皮用水浸軟，浸陳皮水留起一起煲湯。（年份較淺陳皮，去囊。）
5️⃣煲滾2500 mL水，放下所有材料（鹽除外），中大火煮10分鐘，然後用小火再煲1小時50分鐘，合共2小時。
6️⃣下鹽調味即成。

烹調心得：
凍水氽水，才能徹底逼出血水和雜質。

meta.description:
#麥冬桔餅雪梨蘋果乾沙參玉竹無花果水 
《滋陰潤肺 止咳化痰 生津止渴 舒緩口乾舌燥 清甜不膩 養生好湯水分享》

麥冬好處多，有養陰生津，潤肺清燥熱等功效。搭配桔餅、雪梨乾、蘋果乾、沙參、玉竹、百合、南北杏和無花果，味道清甜好喝。

如果經常覺得口乾，即使補充大量水份也無法緩解，已經檢查過並不是有糖尿病，即表示身體津液不足。呢個養生經典湯水，還有理氣化痰，止咳潤肺，多喝滋陰潤燥湯水都有幫助。

食譜分享📝
材料：
野生麥冬 30g
桔餅 2個 77g
雪梨乾 60g
蘋果乾 25g
沙參 25g
玉竹 25g
百合 30g
南北杏 12g
無花果 4粒
水2000ml

做法：
1️⃣所有乾貨食材用清水沖洗乾淨，清水浸大約10分鐘。
2️⃣桔餅切半。
3️⃣雪梨乾、蘋果乾去核。
4️⃣無花果用剪刀剪開。
5️⃣煲滾2000 mL水，放下所有材料，中大火煲10分鐘，然後用小火，再煲1小時即成。

烹調心得：
不需要再添加冰糖，蘋果乾、雪梨乾、桔餅和無花果，已經含有豐富的天然果糖，此湯水已帶有清香甜味，非常滋潤。

#西洋菜粟米鮮肉餃 《西洋菜獨有的香氣搭配清甜爽口粟米 餡料滿滿不鬆散 家常餃子做法分享》

很喜歡吃餃子，自己做的餃子餡料滿滿，超好吃。西洋菜有獨特的香氣，搭配清甜爽口的粟米，還有帶點肥的新鮮免治肉，豬肉的油脂，與清甜多汁的西洋菜和粟米，簡直是完美的組合。

西洋菜 1斤 604g

白色方形餃子皮 42張
生抽 34g
蠔油 20g

麻油 適量

做法:
1️⃣煮滾一鍋水，水要大滾，放下洗乾淨西洋菜，煮至軟身，立即撈起，放入凍水內降溫，然後揸乾水，切碎。
2️⃣鮮粟米粒，煮數分鐘，廚紙吸乾水份。（如用急凍粟米，解凍後，都需要吸乾水份。）
3️⃣切碎西洋菜，粟米和免治肉，放入大碗內，加入所有調味料拌勻(有時間可放入雪櫃冷藏片刻）。
4️⃣適量餡放入白色方形餃子皮中間，餃子皮邊位沾水，對接成長方形，然後向後屈，沾水封口。
5️⃣煲滾一鍋水，水要大滾，放下餃子，再次滾起後，倒入一碗水，煮至餃子浮起，浮起後，大約煮多30-40秒。
6️⃣煮滾現成雞湯，放下煮熟西洋菜粟米餃即成。

烹調心得：
灼軟的西洋菜，必須要擠乾水，才切碎，仍帶有水份，會影響餃子餡的口感。

meta.description:
#香茅豬扒 《香茅料頭水醃豬扒 鬆軟又好吃 香煎豬扒技巧
超簡易蔥油做法分享》

家人很愛吃豬扒，這次用了香茅、魚露去醃味，吃下啖啖肉，有陣陣香茅味，又鬆軟的香茅豬扒，超滿足呀。而且做法簡單，相信少下廚的你哋都能做到。蔥油和香茅豬扒簡直是絕配，豬扒煎至金黃色，配上香氣四溢的蔥油，實在太好吃了。

食譜分享📝
材料：
新鮮脢頭帶骨豬扒 4塊 568g
香茅 2條
乾蔥 22g
蒜頭 21g
魚露 10g
生抽 10g
蠔油 6g
糖 6g
鹽 1g
生粉 20g
水 100g

做法：
1️⃣豬扒洗乾淨，抹乾水，切斷白色筋位，刀背輕力揼鬆，備用。
2️⃣香茅切去少許頂部，去掉第一層外皮，刀背揼鬆，切碎。
3️⃣乾蔥去皮，切半。
4️⃣蒜頭去衣。
5️⃣香茅、乾蔥、蒜頭和100g水，放入食物處理器內攪拌，隔渣，香茅乾蔥蒜頭水備用。
6️⃣魚露、生抽、蠔油、糖、鹽、生粉、30g香茅乾蔥蒜頭水一起拌勻。
7️⃣豬扒放入做法6️⃣調味料拌勻，醃8小時。
8️⃣適量油，煎至豬扒熟透，拌上蔥油即成。

烹調心得：
豬扒白色筋位必須要切斷，可防止烹煮受熱時捲曲，及白色筋位非常韌，切斷筋膜，肉質吃起來更好吃。

summary.name: 黑虎掌菌雞湯
sample_steps: 1️⃣黑虎掌菌沖洗乾淨，用水浸軟，浸菌水留起一起煲湯。
2️⃣雞殼和瘦肉一起放入凍水氽水，然後再沖洗乾淨，雞殼去除內臟、血塊、雞皮，瀝乾水備用。

meta.description:
#黑虎掌菌雞湯 《珍貴美味黑虎掌菌香氣濃郁 肉質嫩滑 含有人體多種氨基酸 有助降低膽固醇 增強免疫力 養生好湯水分享》

黑虎掌菌香氣濃郁，含豐富氨基酸及多醣體，有降低膽固醇，健脾和胃，增強免疫力的功效。適合煲湯、炆煮，爆炒等多種烹調方式。

黑虎掌菌的香氣非常濃烈，很適合搭配肉類一起煲湯，緊記保留浸泡水，加入湯中烹煮，更增添香氣。

食譜分享📝
材料：
黑虎掌菌 50g
雞殼 2個
雞髀 2隻
瘦肉 473g
紅棗 86g
薑 54g
水 1500ml
浸黑虎掌菌水 1000ml
鹽 適量

做法：
1️⃣黑虎掌菌沖洗乾淨，用水浸軟，浸菌水留起一起煲湯。
2️⃣雞殼和瘦肉一起放入凍水氽水，然後再沖洗乾淨，雞殼去除內臟、血塊、雞皮，瀝乾水備用。
3️⃣雞髀斬件後，少許鹽醃味。
4️⃣紅棗去核。
5️⃣薑切片。
6️⃣黑虎掌菌水和水一起煲滾，放下所有材料（雞髀、鹽除外），中大火煲10分鐘，然後小火煲1小時50分鐘，合共2小時，下鹽調味。
7️⃣大火煮滾，放下雞髀肉，再次滾起後，蓋上蓋，小火煮大約2分鐘，不用開蓋，浸焗10分鐘，即成。

烹調心得：
黑虎掌菌沖洗幾次，去掉泥沙，
保留浸泡水，加入湯中同煮，能增添香氣及營養。

summary.name: 節瓜瑤柱螺頭竹笙湯
sample_steps: 1️⃣節瓜用小刀刮去表皮，切大件。
2️⃣瑤柱用水浸軟，浸瑤柱水留起一起煲湯。

meta.description:
#節瓜瑤柱螺頭竹笙湯 
《消暑清熱 滋陰補腎 竹笙營養價值高 瑤柱 螺頭鮮味十足 正氣家常中式湯水分享》

味道清淡的節瓜正氣，清熱消暑，是炎夏煲湯的好材料。搭配瑤柱和螺頭，此湯鮮味十足。

野生竹笙顏色帶微黃，選購時要觀看竹笙和菌群整個完整，肉質厚實且乾身，沒有霉味為最佳。
中醫認為，竹笙能降低膽固醇及血脂等功效。含多醣體的竹笙，有助增強免疫力，多吃有益。

食譜分享📝
材料:
節瓜 2條
瑤柱 54g
螺頭 231g
竹笙 4條
鐵棍淮山 29g
豬𦟌 378g
陳皮 1角
椰棗 3粒
水 2500ml
鹽 適量

做法：
1️⃣節瓜用小刀刮去表皮，切大件。
2️⃣瑤柱用水浸軟，浸瑤柱水留起一起煲湯。
3️⃣螺頭解凍後，連同豬𦟌一起凍水氽水。螺頭去掉內臟，用小刀刮乾淨表面。
4️⃣竹笙清水浸軟，去掉硬蒂。
5️⃣鐵棍淮山，沖洗乾淨，備用。
6️⃣陳皮清水浸軟，陳皮水留起一起煲湯，年份較淺陳皮去囊。
7️⃣煲滾2500 mL水，放下所有材料（竹笙、鹽除外），中大火煮10分鐘，用小火再煲1小時30分鐘。然後放下竹笙，再煲20分鐘 ，合共2小時。
8️⃣適量鹽調味即成。

烹調心得：
浸陳皮水非常有益，建議一起煲湯，年份較淺的陳皮，可按個人喜好，浸軟後，刮掉內囊。

sample_steps: 1️⃣排骨頭凍水氽水，沖洗乾淨，瀝乾水，備用。
2️⃣蕃茄切件。

meta.description:
#濃蕃茄薯仔排骨湯 《超好喝 超香甜 超濃蕃茄排骨湯 排骨頭煲湯極鮮甜 肉質有少量脂肪 筋膜和軟骨 烹煮後肉質不乾不嚡 超好吃》 

「蕃茄薯仔排骨湯」是由細吃到大的家常湯水，百喝不厭。而且材料和做法非常簡單，我喜歡用排骨頭，連骨帶肉特別好吃，肉質有少許脂肪，帶有筋膜和軟骨，煲煮後不乾不嚡，配上辣椒豉油很好吃。

除了用蕃茄外，我還會加入車厘茄，令蕃茄味更香濃。搭配有天然甜味的洋蔥和紅蘿蔔，足料家常靚湯很好喝。

食譜分享📝
材料:
蕃茄 786g
車厘茄 250g
洋蔥 313g
薯仔 828g
紅蘿蔔 585g
排骨頭 690g
薑 4片
熱水 2000ml
鹽 少許

做法：
1️⃣排骨頭凍水氽水，沖洗乾淨，瀝乾水，備用。
2️⃣蕃茄切件。
3️⃣車厘茄切半。
4️⃣洋蔥切件。
5️⃣紅蘿蔔切細件。
6️⃣薯仔切件。
7️⃣煎香薑片，炒香所有蔬菜和排骨，然後加入熱水煮滾，中大火煮10分鐘，然後轉小火，再煲1小時。
8️⃣最後放下薯仔，再煲20分鐘，少許鹽調味，即成。

烹調心得：
1️⃣炒過的食材，相比水煮會更香。
2️⃣ 中大火煮10分鐘（滾起狀態）非常重要，作用是讓食材出味，家常湯才好喝。

summary.name: 星洲炒米
sample_steps: 1️⃣叉燒切條。
2️⃣虎蝦解凍後，廚紙吸乾水，備用。

meta.description:
#星洲炒米 《超惹味 香濃咖喱足料星洲炒米粉 港式風味 在家自煮做法分享》

惹味的星洲炒米是港式經典料理，在港式茶餐廳和粵菜中菜館都經常吃到。這道料理特色在於濃郁的咖喱香氣，米粉要乾爽，吸飽香料味，不太油膩的星洲炒米，才好吃。

自煮當然食材豐富，除了叉燒、虎蝦和雞蛋处，配菜也不可馬虎了事，有洋蔥、青椒、紅椒、肥嘟嘟芽菜、韮黃和蔥。調味我會加些魚露，有提鮮的作用。

食譜分享📝
材料：
叉燒 139g
虎蝦 6隻
雞蛋 2隻
紅椒 42g
青椒 40g
洋蔥 71g
韭黃 51g
肥嘟嘟芽菜 107g
蔥 3棵
蒜頭 2瓣
米粉 3個
咖喱醬 42g
咖喱粉 6g
黃薑粉 少許
魚露 20g
生抽 10g
鹽 3g
糖 5g

做法：
1️⃣叉燒切條。
2️⃣虎蝦解凍後，廚紙吸乾水，備用。
3️⃣雞蛋少許鹽，拌勻成蛋液。
4️⃣紅椒、青椒、洋蔥切條。
5️⃣韭黃切小段。
6️⃣蔥分開蔥綠和蔥白，切小段。
7️⃣蒜頭剁成蓉。
8️⃣米粉用清水浸軟，瀝乾水。
9️⃣咖喱醬、咖喱粉、黃薑粉拌勻，備用。
🔟適量油，洋蔥、青椒、紅椒、蔥白和蒜蓉一起炒香，盛起。
1️⃣1️⃣蛋液炒成碎蛋，盛起。
1️⃣2️⃣虎蝦少許鹽、少許胡椒粉煎香，盛起。
1️⃣3️⃣叉燒煎香盛起。
1️⃣4️⃣適量油，炒香咖喱醬、咖喱粉及黃薑粉，然後放下米粉拌勻，再放回雞蛋、虎蝦和叉燒，魚露、生抽、鹽、糖調味。
1️⃣5️⃣洋蔥、青椒、紅椒、蔥白回鍋，最後肥嘟嘟芽菜、韭黃和蔥綠拌勻，即成。

烹調心得：
建議使用筷子輔助鑊鏟去翻炒，這樣能有效地把米粉鬆開，同時米粉也不容易折斷。

summary.name: 海椰BB沙參玉竹無花果湯
sample_steps: 1️⃣海爺BB用刀拍裂表面硬殼，取出椰肉，椰殼放入茶袋。
2️⃣沙參、玉竹、百合沖洗乾淨，清水浸15至20分鐘，玉竹用刀切開。

meta.description:
#海椰BB沙參玉竹無花果湯 《非洲海椰BB  海椰皇  迷你椰子 滋陰潤燥 潤肺止咳 清甜滋潤好湯水分享》

天氣持續炎熱，養生湯水絕對不可以少。

非洲海椰BB體型細小，像迷你椰子。搭配沙參、玉竹、百合、南北杏及無花果，此湯有滋陰潤肺，止咳功效，經常感到口乾舌燥，也可以舒緩喉嚨乾癢。

無花果、紅蘿蔔、粟米都擁有天然清甜味，而無花果更有潤腸通便功效，不需要加椰棗，味道已經很香甜滋潤。

食譜分享📝
材料：
非洲海椰BB 300g
沙參 37g
玉竹 83g
紅蘿蔔 1條 628g
粟米 1條 258g
百合 38g
南北杏 18g
無花果 6粒
陳皮 1角
瘦肉 618g
水 2500ml
鹽 適量

做法：
1️⃣海爺BB用刀拍裂表面硬殼
，取出椰肉，椰殼放入茶袋。
2️⃣沙參、玉竹、百合沖洗乾淨，清水浸15至20分鐘，玉竹用刀切開。
3️⃣紅蘿蔔、粟米，切件。
4️⃣無花果用剪刀剪開。
5️⃣陳皮清水浸軟，浸陳皮水留起一起煲湯。(年份較淺陳皮去囊）
6️⃣瘦肉凍水氽水，再沖洗乾淨。
7️⃣煲滾2500 mL水，放下所有材料（鹽除外），中大火煲10分鐘，然後用小火，再煲1小時50分鐘，下鹽調味即成。

烹調心得：
海爺BB性質平和，很適合用來煲湯，如搭配蘋果和雪梨，能潤肺解燥等效用。

summary.name: 香煎腐皮卷
sample_steps: 金菇切去尾段，用手搣開備用。
冬菇浸軟後，切條。

meta.description:
#香煎腐皮卷 《超豐富蔬菜腐皮卷 無肉一樣好吃 清爽又解膩 酒樓點心家中簡易做法》

自己做的腐皮卷，材料一定很豐富，也可隨自己喜歡搭配任何食材，都非常好吃。

首先煎香薑片，再炒蔬菜，可調和蔬菜的寒涼。我還會加少許蒜蓉，來增添香氣，再以醬油調味，蔬菜腐皮卷吃起來清爽又解膩。

食譜分享📝
材料：
腐皮 2張
金菇 2包
冬菇 8隻
西芹 2條
馬蹄 8粒
甘筍 半條
珍珠筍 5條
乾木耳絲 20g
薑 2片
蒜蓉 21g
蠔油 30g
生抽 20g
鹽 5g
糖 3g
香菇粉 10g
胡椒粉 少許
麻油 少許

麵粉漿材料及做法：
1湯匙麵粉和2湯匙水拌勻成糊狀

做法：
1️⃣金菇切去尾段，用手搣開備用。
2️⃣冬菇浸軟後，切條。
3️⃣西芹泡去表面纖維，斜切件。
4️⃣馬蹄去皮，切片。
5️⃣甘筍去皮，切條。
6️⃣珍珠筍斜切件。
7️⃣乾木耳絲用水浸軟。
8️⃣珍珠筍木耳絲氽水備用。
9️⃣適量油，煎香薑片，放下所有食材炒至軟身（腐皮除外），然後加入調味料拌勻，放涼備用。
🔟腐皮用濕布抹乾淨，腐皮對接，把硬邊剪去。（硬邊可留起煲粥或煲糖水）腐皮對接成半圓形，用剪刀在邊位𠝹開，如此類推，一張腐皮可分成8張三角形腐皮。
1️⃣1️⃣放上適量餡料在腐皮上，向前捲起，左右兩邊腐皮向內收入，再向前捲到尾，沾上麵粉漿收口。
1️⃣2️⃣燒熱適量油，小火或中小火煎至兩面金黃色即成。

烹調心得：
煎腐皮卷時，要用小火或中小火去煎，煎至餡料熱，腐皮香脆便可以，大火去煎很容易焦燶。

meta.description:
🍚 搬了新家，第一餐一定要有家的味道✨

對我來說，最有儀式感的事情，不是把家佈置得多漂亮 🏠✨
而是回到家，打開飯煲，就有一鍋熱騰騰的飯等著自己🤍
這道雜菌菇雞扒炆飯有肉🥩、有菜🍄🥕、有飯🍚，
一鍋完成，簡單卻特別暖心❤️✨

🍄雜菌菇雞扒炆飯 Mushroom Chicken Rice🍚
材料及份量（2-3人份）：
📌去骨雞扒 (Boneless Chicken Thigh) 2塊
📌白米 (Jasmine Rice) 2杯
📌雜菇菌 (Mixed Mushrooms) 150-200克
📌紅蘿蔔 (Carrot) 1/3條
📌洋蔥 (Onion) 半個
📌蒜頭 (Garlic) 2瓣
📌蔥花 (Spring Onion) 適量
雞扒醃料 Marinade：
🥢生抽 (Light Soy Sauce) 1湯匙
🥢蠔油 (Oyster Sauce) 1茶匙
🥢砂糖 (Sugar) 半茶匙
🥢胡椒粉 (Ground White Pepper) 少許
🥢粟粉 (Corn Starch) 1茶匙
🥢麻油 (Sesame Oil) 1茶匙
炆飯調味汁 Seasoning Sauce：
✔️生抽 (Light Soy Sauce) 1.5湯匙
✔️老抽 (Dark Soy Sauce) 半茶匙
✔️料理米酒 (Cooking Rice Wine) 1湯匙

做法：
① 先將雞扒醃20分鐘
② 洋蔥、紅蘿蔔切粒，蒜頭切碎，菇菌切好；白米洗淨瀝乾
③ 雞扒煎至金黃盛起
④ 炒香洋蔥、蒜蓉、紅蘿蔔及雜菇，加入白米及調味汁拌勻
⑤ 放入電飯煲，加水後鋪上雞扒，啟動煮飯模式
⑥ 完成後將雞扒切件，撒上蔥花及辣椒即可享用

✨ TOSHIBA RC-DS18K 真空壓力IH磁應電飯煲(1.8L)
✔️ 日本製造 🇯🇵，品質令人更安心
✔️ 真空浸泡技術，以真空泵抽走電飯煲內的空氣，以水取代空氣渗透入米粒核心，令粒粒米都水潤飽滿 ✨
✔️ 壓力烹調，唔同模式下可自動調節壓力釋放時間，無需預先浸泡白米/糙米/雜穀米，煮出有光澤、口感更煙韌的米飯🍚
✔️ IH磁應加熱，均勻加熱每一粒米，讓米飯口感更出色🔥
✔️ 5mm 鑽石銅鍋，受熱更均勻，鎖住米飯香氣與水分✨
✔️ 不論日常煮白飯、一鍋炆飯，甚至雜穀飯都同樣輕鬆方便🥘
✔️ 一鍵完成料理，忙碌日子都可以輕鬆煮出充滿家的味道❤️🏠

meta.description:
🔥一撞即凝‼️薑汁撞奶成功關鍵公開🫚用錯薑一定唔得😳

《糖水研究日記｜第六集》
今天教大家做薑汁撞奶🍵
唔係求快，係求「一撞即凝」✨
一定要用小黃薑，辣度先夠、酵素先夠💯
先可以令牛奶完美凝固，滑到似豆腐‼️

🥛薑汁撞奶Ginger Milk Curd🫚
材料及份量（3人份）：
📌小黃薑（Young Ginger） 60克 
📌全脂牛奶（Full Cream Milk） 600毫升
📌砂糖（Sugar） 60克

做法：
①將小黃薑洗乾淨去皮再磨薑蓉，用紗布或隔篩榨出薑汁，平均倒入碗中備用
②牛奶加入砂糖，小火加熱至約70–80°C（見微微冒煙即可，唔好滾）
③將熱牛奶由高處快速沖入薑汁碗中（關鍵動作🔥）
④沖好後唔好攪拌，靜置10分鐘等待自然凝固
⑤完成後表面平滑凝結，用匙羹輕壓有彈性即成功

【牛奶挑選關鍵】
成功率取決於牛奶的蛋白質與脂肪含量，請檢查包裝背後的「營養標籤」（每 100ml）：
🗯️蛋白質 (Protein)： 需>3.3g
🗯️脂肪 (Fat)： 需>3.5g (推薦使用 3.8g 的特濃全脂奶)

meta.description:
家庭簡易版港式咖喱四寶✊超好食❗️超簡單‼️

來過香港的人肯定吃過街頭咖喱吧🇭🇰
你們知道四寶是那四寶嗎🤫
就是魚蛋 魷魚 豬皮和蘿蔔🎶
再加教你一比一還原港式街頭味道故事💯
記得點讚收藏 以後隨時可以做來吃🫶 

🇭🇰港式咖喱四寶Hong Kong Street Food Curry🥘
材料及份量：
主料 (Main Ingredients)：
📌豬皮(Pork Skin) 1大片
📌魚蛋(Fish Balls) 80克
📌蘿蔔(Radish) 1條
📌魷魚(Squid) 100克
咖喱料 (Curry Ingredients)：
🥢順發孖記・純咖喱膽(Curry Sauce) 2勺
🥢順發孖記・火鍋沙爹醬(Satay Sauce) 1.5勺
🥢順發孖記・柱候醬(Chi Hou Sauce) 1勺
🥢薑黃粉(Turmeric Powder) 5克
🥢紅椒粉(Cayenne Pepper) 5克
配料 (Additional Ingredients)：
✔️蒜蓉(Minced Garlic) 2瓣
✔️乾蔥(Shallots) 2粒
✔️辣椒仔(Chili) 2隻
✔️冰糖(Rock Sugar) 5克
✔️清水(Water) 700毫升
✔️料酒(Cooking Wine) 適量
✔️生粉水(Potato Starch Water) 適量

做法：
①將豬皮汆水煮5分鐘，然後撈起，再將其切成一塊塊
②將魷魚飛水煮1分鐘，然後再撈起，將鬚切成一條條，然後魷魚肉先打斜切出花紋，再切成一塊塊
③魚蛋在滾水淥一淥，就撈起備用
④將蘿蔔㓟皮，再切成適當的大小，然後放入滾水中，再加入冰糖，煮大約5分鐘就撈起備用
⑤準備港式純咖喱膽、火鍋沙嗲醬和炆肉柱侯醬，再加入薑黃粉和紅椒粉，然後攪拌均勻備用
⑥熱鑊落油，再加入紅蔥頭碎、蒜蓉碎和辣椒粒，然後炒一下，再加入秘製咖喱膽，然後一直用小火炒，炒香之後再加入花雕酒，再略炒一下
⑦然後加入蘿蔔、魷魚、魚蛋和豬皮，並一直炒至上色，接着加入700毫升清水，然後冚蓋煮20分鐘，最後加入生粉水打芡
⑧等咖喱濃稠之後，就可以上碟享用了

大人小孩都超級愛吃👅根本完全停不下來💫
想知道怎麼做就一定要看👀

㊙️秘製蜜汁叉燒Secret Barbecue Pork🐷
材料及份量：
📌順發孖記叉燒醬(Char Siu Sauce) 3湯匙
📌順發孖記頭遍生抽王(Superior Light Soy Sauce) 2湯匙
📌順發孖記頭遍老抽王(Superior Light Dark Soy Sauce) 1湯匙
📌梅頭肉(Pork Shoulder) 半斤(300克)
📌蠔油(Oyster Sauce) 1湯匙
📌蜂蜜(Honey) 1茶匙
📌玫瑰露(Rose Wine) 1茶匙
📌白胡椒粉(White Pepper) 1茶匙
📌薑片(Ginger Slices) 適量
📌蔥段(Scallions) 適量

做法：
①將梅頭肉洗乾淨，然後印乾水份，再用叉一直戳孔方便等一下醃入味
②準備醃製，加入叉燒醬、生抽、老抽、蠔油、玫瑰露、蜂蜜、白胡椒粉、薑片和蔥段，再戴手套抓拌均勻，然後包上保鮮紙醃最少30分鐘
③烤盤墊上一張烘焙紙，然後準備網架，再將醃好的梅頭肉放上去
④放入焗爐進行三個步驟：第一步200度焗14分鐘封皮、第二步搽蜜糖加翻面 200度焗14分鐘烤熟、第三步搽蜜糖加翻面 220度焗4分鐘焦化
⑤焗好後取出斬件，就可以擺盤享用了

🏡家庭簡易版傳統蘿蔔糕Homemade Traditional Turnip Cake💮
材料及份量(2底6吋)：
📌李祥和蘿蔔糕預拌粉(Radish Cake Premix) 1盒(300克)
✔️白蘿蔔(Turnip)（⅔刨絲 ⅓切粗條）2條 約1600克
✔️臘腸(Preserved Meat Sausage) 2條 約100克
✔️臘肉(Preserved Meat) 0.5條 約75克
✔️蝦米(Dried Shrimp) 20克
✔️冬菇(Chinese Mushroom) 5粒
✔️乾瑤柱(Dried Scallops) 20克
✔️紅蔥頭(Shallot) 1粒
⭕️水(Water)(包括浸泡乾材料的水) 500毫升
⭕️鹽(Salt) 2克
⭕️白胡椒粉(White Pepper Powder) 適量
🥢順發孖記・蒜香風味辣醬(Chilli Sauce) 適量
🥢順發孖記・極尚XO醬(辣)(Deluxe XO Sauce) 適量

做法：
①準備切碎了的冬菇、蝦米、臘腸、臘肉、乾瑤柱和紅蔥頭
②浸過材料的水留起，再加清水至500毫升
③準備白蘿蔔，先將蘿蔔去皮，將⅓ 蘿蔔切粗條，⅔ 蘿蔔刨絲備用
④準備李祥和蘿蔔糕預拌粉，再加入浸過材料的水，然後攪拌均勻備用
⑤熱鑊落油，再倒入臘腸及臘肉炒一下，然後加入蝦米、乾瑤柱和冬菇，繼續爆炒，然後盛起備用，記得留一點放上面做裝飾的
⑥同一隻鑊再加油，倒入紅蔥頭爆炒一下，然後倒入蘿蔔條和蘿蔔絲，再加白胡椒粉和鹽，然後冚蓋煮10分鐘
⑦蘿蔔軟身之後就倒入爆香了的材料，然後再炒一下，再倒入粉漿並慢慢推至杰身
⑧將粉漿倒入糕盤內，再鋪上¼剩下的材料，並用大火隔水蒸約40分鐘
⑨放涼冷卻之後，就可以切成一塊塊，然後用小火慢慢煎香，配上辣醬或者XO醬就可以享用了

🐷黯然銷魂飯Char Siu Egg Rice🥚
材料及份量：
📌蜜汁叉燒(Secret Barbecue Pork) 10塊
📌青菜(Greens) 5條
📌太陽蛋(Sunny-side-up Egg) 2隻
📌白飯(Rice) 1碗
📌蔥花(Chopped Green Onion) 適量
淋面醬汁：
🥢順發孖記頭遍生抽王(Superior Light Soy Sauce) 2湯匙
🥢蜂蜜(Honey) 1湯匙
🥢菜油(Rapeseed Oil) 1湯匙
🥢清水(Water) 2湯匙

做法：
①先準備好秘製蜜汁叉燒，詳細食譜可以看我之前的影片
②煮幾條青菜，煮熟之後撈起
③熱鑊落油，煎兩隻太陽蛋，然後盛起備用
④將飯煲熟，然後放入瓦煲裏
⑤準備一個食神級數的淋面豉油(生抽+蜂蜜+菜油+清水)，然後煮滾就可以了
⑥最後放上叉燒，再放上太陽蛋，然後加兩條青菜，灑上蔥花，再淋上秘製豉油，就可以邊看食神邊吃了

meta.description:
媽媽👩‍🍼母親節快樂🫶我愛你❤️
快到母親節了🎶
不知道送什麼的請看過來👀

🤱母親節抱抱曲奇Mother’s Day HugHug Cookie💝
材料及份量(10塊)：
📌李祥和低筋麵粉(Cake Flour) 70克
📌士多啤梨粉(Strawberry Powder) 8克 
📌奶粉(Milk Powder) 8克 
📌無鹽牛油(Unsalted Butter) 45克
📌糖粉(Caster Sugar) 30克
📌全蛋液(Whole Egg Liquid) 30克 

做法：
①將牛油放置室溫至軟化，然後加入糖粉，並打發至蓬鬆泛白
②將全蛋液分次加於內，並繼續打發均勻方式拌至均勻，再用手揉成粉糰
④將低筋麵粉，奶粉和草莓粉過篩於內，並用膠刮刀以切拌方式拌勻，再用手揉成粉糰，然後將⅓粉糰留起備用
⑤將麵糰放在烘焙紙上，並再鋪上烘焙紙，擀薄至5毫米厚度後，再放於冰箱冷藏10分鐘
⑥留起的粉糰再加入紅麴粉，再揉成較深色的粉糰，然後亦擀薄至5毫米厚度後，再放於冰箱冷藏10分鐘
⑦準備兩個心形的模具，一個大點一個小一點
⑧取出淺色的麵糰，用大一點的模具壓出心形 ，再放上焗盤上並用小一點的模具壓走一部份
⑨然後取出深色的麵糰，再用小一點的模具壓出心形，接着組裝一下
⑩放入焗爐中層以170度上下火焗約15分鐘，最後5分鐘時蓋上一張錫紙
⑪焗好後取出並用朱古力裝飾一下，畫上眼睛和嘴巴，在畫出抱抱的手勢，然後就可以送給媽媽了

材料及份量：
📌順發孖記・頭遍生抽王(Superior Light Soy Sauce) 30毫升
📌順發孖記・頭遍老抽王(Superior Light Dark Soy Sauce) 20毫升
📌雞蛋(Egg) 12個
📌清水(Water) 600毫升
📌八角(Star Anise) 5粒 
📌香葉(Bay Leaves) 6片 
📌桂皮(Cinnamon) 2塊
📌小茴香(Fennel) 3克
📌普洱茶葉(Pu‘er Tea) 10克
📌冰糖(Rock Sugar) 15克
📌鹽(Salt) 5克

做法：
①將雞蛋放入煲內，倒入清水，再煮10分鐘，煮滾後冚蓋焗5分鐘，然後放入凍水冷卻
②再用湯匙輕輕敲裂蛋殼，每個面都敲一下，裂紋比較均勻
③準備順發孖記頭遍生抽王，加入碗中，準備順發孖記頭遍老抽王，亦加入碗中，再加入鹽和清水備用
④準備香料，倒入鑊中，再加入冰糖，和調配好的豉油，然後用小火煮滾，煮滾後冚蓋焗5分鐘
⑤將雞蛋放入煲內，再放入茶葉滷水汁，再放入電飯煲，然後撳煲湯的掣，時間到就看一下，然後浸過夜會比較入味
⑥想吃的時候放入小煲內，然後小火煮滾就可以享用了

meta.description:
CHAR SIEW (aka BBQ PORK)

When I first moved to Australia, the char siew here made me cry. Red, dry, bland pieces of sadness.

That's when I decided I had to take matters into my own hands and make proper char siew – the Malaysian kind. Charred, gnarly, fatty, melt-in-your-mouth flavour explosions.

Over the years I tried different cuts of pork, different methods of cooking. Now I've unlocked what one person describes as "the best char siew he's had in his life". But he has just under 30 years of life experience under his belt, so we'll take it with a grain of salt.

Regardless, here's the definitive guide to making my version of crowd-pleasing Malaysian-style char siew.

First, choose the right cut of pork! Not shoulder. Not neck. Not belly. But pork jowl. Repeat after me: pork jowl!

Next the marinade. This is for 1kg of pork jowl.

● 5 tbsp light soya sauce
● 2.5 tbsp dark soya sauce
● 2.5 tbsp Chinese rice wine
● 4.5 tsp Hoisin sauce
● 5g five spice powder
● 2 tbsp honey
● 2 tbsp sugar
● 1/4 salt
● Pinch of white pepper

As you know by now my style of cooking is agak-agak (meaning guesstimation) so please adjust the marinade to taste.

Marinade the pork overnight. Then roast in a 160°C oven for 1hr 30mins plus an additional 15-30mins at 220°C on grill setting to get a nice char.

Baste the char siew with the remaining marinade a few times when you're cooking it. And I like to give the char siew a final torch to finish to get that perfect char.

#thehousehusbandofsouthyarra #charsiu #charsiew #bbqpork

meta.description:
BORN & BRED, Seoul

If you only have one chance to eat Korean BBQ in Seoul, make @bornandbredkorea it. Here they specialise in Hanwoo, the highly prized Korean beef that is rarely found outside of the country. Think of it as Korea's equivalent to wagyu – but with less fat and finer marbling lending a more robust and beefier taste yet remaining supremely tender. 

More importantly, they treat Hanwoo with the greatest precision and utmost respect from start to finish. Born & Bred didn't start out life as a restaurant. Rather the business actually has its roots as a butchery in Seoul's Majang meat district. So they know meat. Specifically Hanwoo.

Housed over three floors, you're first greeted by the butchery and waiting area on the ground floor. Next floor up is the casual dining room offering an a la carte menu while the top floor is the private dining space featuring a tasting menu. Oh, and there's actually also a basement, an exclusive, 10-seat counter in a speakeasy space for those of you who really want to splurge.

@melysash and I dined at the 1st floor casual dining room and ordered from the a la carte menu — yukhoe, steak cut tenderloin and Korean cut ribeye.

First came the banchans. And even more banchans. Some familiar ones, others not so like tangpyeongchae (a traditional royal court dish made with mung bean jelly), steamed white kimchi and pickled garlic leaves. We loved them all.

Then came the yukhoe, Korea's version of beef tartare. I can safely say it's the best raw beef dish I've come across. It was the purest expression of Hanwoo – clean flavours, exceptionally tender chuck tender seasoned simply with salt, sesame oil, sesame seeds, spring onion and topped with some pear. I could eat this by the bucket-loads.

Next the tenderloin and ribeye charcoal grilled at the table. Again seasoned simply with salt and pepper. Each bite as amazing as the previous. Perfectly cooked, tender, beefy with accompanying condiments for you to season, flavour and enjoy any which way you prefer. Bliss.

#thehousehusbandofsouthyarra #seoulrestaurant
#hanwoo

Mix thoroughly until well combined.
Flatten the mixture and roll it out into a bag, removing all excess air.
Let it ferment at room temperature for about 2-3 days, adjusting time based on your climate.
recipe.name: Nem Chua - Raw fermented pork
notes: Nem chua requires about 2-3 days to ferment at room temperature. Adjust time based on your climate!
Always use fresh, high-quality lean pork since this is a raw preparation.

•절인 배추는 물에 헹궈 채반에 받친 다음 1시간동안
물을 오래 뺀다
•믹서기에 분량의 재료를 모두 넣어 곱게 갈아준다

meta.description:
NEM CHUA RECIPE 🥵❤️‍🔥

Nem Chua aka Fermented Pork aka Pickled Pork aka Vietnamese Salami. Cured meat with a sour, garlicky, spicy kick. One of my favorite snacks! I always used to pick it up at the Vietnamese Deli but now that I know how to make it, there’s no going back. Traditionally it is made with ground pork, but I used ground beef. I also add EXTRA freshly cracked black pepper for that punch!

-1lb raw ground beef (I used 90/10)
-9oz cooked sliced pork skin (Bi Tuoi)

-1tbsp freshly minced garlic
-1thai chili, chopped
-1tbsp freshly cracked black pepper
-1tbsp sugar
-1tbsp fish sauce (@datuputiph Brand)

TOPPINGS:
-thinly sliced garlic cloves

-rau ram aka vietnamese coriander leaves

meta.description:
지금은 청귤로 김장하는 시기!

제가 김치는 못담구는데
과일청 김장하는건 좋아하거든요!
설탕 들어가는거 보면 어마무시한데
오래 보관하고 먹을거라 1:1로 했어요.
금방 드실건 설탕양을 좀 줄이셔도 될 것 같아요!

👉 청귤 5kg 사서 슬라이스+즙내니까 과육만 3kg 넘게 나왔어요!

[제가 만든 양과 재료] 청귤 슬라이스 2.1kg, 청귤즙 700ml, 라임즙 150ml, 설탕 3kg, 소금 1t 

⑴ 청귤 세척/손질하기
- 베이킹소다나 과일세정제로 깨끗이 세척하기
- 청귤 양끝은 잘라내고 0.5cm 두께로 자르기
- 청귤 슬라이스 2/3, 청귤즙 1/3의 비율로 만듦

⑵ 설탕버무리기
- 큰 볼에 청귤 슬라이스, 청귤즙, 라임즙, 설탕, 소금 넣어
- 설탕이 녹도록 잘 저어주기
- 설탕은 약 1:1 비율로 했고, 황설탕2 백설탕 1로 했어요.

⑶ 유리병 열탕 소독하기
- 소독 후 물기 없는 유리병에 청귤청 담기
- 실온에 하루 정도 놔두고 냉장보관하고 일주일 후 부터 먹기

⑷ 소분하기
- 대용량으로 만든 경우 소분해서 냉동보관하기
- 종이호일을 덮어 공기접촉을 막아 뚜껑 닫아 보관
- 일년내내 푸릇푸릇한 색상 유지

✅ 저는 반은 생강즙을 넣어 냉동해 겨울에 따뜻한 차로 마셔요!
휴롬에 갈아도 되는데 휴롬이 너무 힘들어해서 이번에는 따로 사서 했어요!

✅ 라임즙 넣는건 @lilybrown81 카페 대표님이 올려주신거 참고했고요!
호일 덮어 냉동 보관하는것도 알려주셔서 그렇게 보관하니 일년내내 푸릇푸릇해요! 

저는 그럼 다음타자 백향과청으로 돌아올게요!
이것은 청귤에 비해 뭐 할게 없슴! 😆

meta.description:
𝗗𝗿𝘆 𝗵𝗮𝗶𝗿? 𝗗𝘂𝗹𝗹 𝘀𝗸𝗶𝗻?
Maybe it’s not just about what you put on your body… but what you put into it.

𝗜𝗻 𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗱𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗖𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘀𝗲 𝗽𝗿𝗮𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗲, 𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗿𝗲’𝘀 𝗮 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗽𝘁 𝗰𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗱 以黑补黑: 𝗻𝗼𝘂𝗿𝗶𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗯𝗹𝗮𝗰𝗸 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗯𝗹𝗮𝗰𝗸.
Ingredients like black sesame, black beans, and black rice have long been used to support hair health, while red dates, goji berries, and dried longan are often linked to better circulation and that healthy glow.

𝗕𝘂𝘁 𝗹𝗲𝘁’𝘀 𝗯𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗹… 𝗺𝗼𝘀𝘁 𝗼𝗳 𝘂𝘀 𝗱𝗼𝗻’𝘁 𝗵𝗮𝘃𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘁𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝘁𝗼 𝗽𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹 𝘁𝗵𝗲𝘀𝗲 𝗱𝗮𝗶𝗹𝘆.
That’s why I like simple, practical options like 𝗤𝘂𝗮𝗸𝗲𝗿 𝟱-𝗕𝗹𝗮𝗰𝗸 𝗠𝘂𝗹𝘁𝗶-𝗚𝗿𝗮𝗶𝗻 and 𝗤𝘂𝗮𝗸𝗲𝗿 𝟱-𝗥𝗲𝗱 𝗠𝘂𝗹𝘁𝗶-𝗚𝗿𝗮𝗶𝗻, combining multiple grains and ingredients into something you can enjoy in just a few minutes.

meta.description:
Batch 6 of making Bánh Mì baguettes like they do in Vietnam. My baking notes for reference but adjustments to come in Batch 7. Any improvement suggestions accepted!

450g bread flour
260g water
1 egg
8g yeast 
2g salt
4g sugar
10g bread improver

Looked a bit drier than batch 5,
(Added some drops of oil and water)

Knead like my pizza, rest 20 mins, ball, rest 20, divide to triangles. Makes 6 bánh mi (130g each). Oil hands to not stick. Smack thick and smooth side down on table, push and flatten with palm, roll and tuck tightly, taper ends, seam side down on rack. Spray, proof till doubled, rest on counter for 10  to form skin, score, spray and straight into oven.

Bake at 450, 8 minutes with steam (tray of boiling water below), open to release and flip, bake for another 5ish until golden. Better ovens may omit flipping.

Form into a ball and rest for another 20 minutes.

Smack the thick and smooth side down on the table.

🥩 Classic Steak Tartare 🇫🇷 No grinder, no shortcuts — this is how it’s really made 🔪

Ingredients (serves 2): 🥩 Meat: 🔪 300g beef tenderloin, very fresh, hand-cut

🌿 Aromatics: 🌱 10g chives, finely chopped 🧅 1 medium shallot (30g), finely diced 🫒 20g capers, finely chopped 🥒 4-6 cornichons (30g), finely diced

🧂 Seasoning: 🌶️ A few dashes Tabasco 🍶 A few dashes Worcestershire sauce 🟡 2 tsp Dijon mustard 🫒 2 tbsp olive oil

🍳 Topping: 🥚 2 egg yolks

Tips: 1️⃣ Best cut: filet (tenderloin) for that classic buttery, ultra-tender bite. Rumsteck (rump) if you want more flavor and don’t mind a touch more chew. 2️⃣ Pop the meat in the freezer for 15 minutes before cutting — it firms up just enough to get clean, precise cuts by hand instead of the knife dragging through it. 3️⃣ This is eaten raw, so quality isn’t optional — get the freshest cut your butcher has. 4️⃣ Want it creamier? Mix the egg yolk directly into the tartare instead of just topping it — coats every bite, and it’s how some regions in France actually serve it.

Step 2: In a large pot, brown the beef with tomato paste – tip 1: really let it brown until you get a dark fond on the b

meta.description:
Here are some easy and simple tips and tricks to improve your box Japanese curry 🍛

Ingredients (serves 4):
~800g chuck steak
3 carrots
2 potatoes
1 onion
1 red apple, grated
1 heaped tbsp tomato paste
Water
Worcestershire sauce, a splash
1 pack (92g) S&B Golden Curry roux cubes

1. Cut chuck steaks, carrot, onion, and potato into bite-size pieces. Grate a red apple.
2. In a large pot, brown the beef with tomato paste – tip 1: really let it brown until you get a dark fond on the bottom of the pot. This is where all your depth of flavour comes from.
3. Add in the veg once that fond is deep and dark.
4. Pour in water until everything is just covered, then stir in grated red apple – tip 2 for natural sweetness. The liquid will deglaze that delicious fond.
5. Add a splash of Worcestershire sauce – tip 3 for umami depth that makes it taste slow-simmered, not boxed.
6. Simmer covered for about 45 minutes until the veg are fully softened.
7. Stir in your curry cubes.
8. Final tip: stir it way longer than the box says – until the potato starts breaking down and thickening the whole sauce. 

#japanesecurry #easyrecipe #healthyrecipe #asiancooking

meta.description:
Yunnan Small Pot Rice Noodles丨小锅米线

Episode 2 of Around China in Noodles!

You might know Yunnan’s famous Cross the Bridge Noodles, but Xiaoguo Mixian (small pot rice noodles) is a local favorite in the capital city, Kunming. The dish gets its name from how it’s traditionally served: fresh noodles are cooked in a small copper pot, usually as a single serving. You can choose from various toppings, with ground pork being one of the most classic options. While some say it’s hard to replicate the flavors without Yunnan’s unique ingredients, I’ve found ways to bring the rich tastes to life.

Find the full recipe and tips in my upcoming newsletter!

Ingredients 
100g dried rice noodles 
90g ground pork with fat 
1/2 tbsp ginger, finely minced
1/4 tsp salt 
1/8 tsp white pepper
2 tbsp water
1 tsp vegetable oil 
2 tsp doubanjiang
1 tsp huang dou jiang (soy bean paste)
500ml chicken or pork bone broth 
30g garlic chives
30g leafy vegetables (pea shoots, napa cabbage or bean sprouts) 
1 tbsp Chinese sweet soy sauce
1 tbsp light soy sauce
1-2 tbsp suan cai pickle
1 tbsp chili oil with sediments, more to add

summary.name: Rosé Tteokbokki with Jumeokbap
sample_steps: Step 1: Cook the bacon in a pan until crispy.
Step 2: In a bowl, mix Gochujang, minced garlic, white sugar, soy sauce, and mirin.

meta.description:
This dish is called Rosé Tteokbokki (pronounced “Roh-Jeh” in Korean), “Rosé” referring to the pinkish color that results from adding cream to the Gochujang sauce, and it’s one of many amusing dishes in Korea which combines western and Korean food in novel ways suited to the Korean taste.

But this dish is not just an amusing novelty, adding cream mellows out the spiciness of traditional Tteokbokki which makes this dish easy and addictive to eat. It also creates an unctuous sauce, similar to a pasta, which makes it an excellent base for adding fried foods such as Tonkatsu on top.

Here I’m also serving the  Rosé Tteokbokki with Korean rice balls called “Jumeokbap” which literally means “fist rice” in Korean. In Korea it’s common to eat Jumeokbap with foods that have a Gochujang based sauce such as Tteokbokki and spicy stir-fried squid or pork.

It’s easy to confuse Jumeokbap with Japanese Onigiri, but they are quite different from each other. Not only are Jumeokbap spherical (as opposed to the triangular shape of Onigiri), they are much smaller in size, small enough to fit into your mouth in one bite. This allows you to dip the rice balls into the Tteokbokki sauce and pop it into your mouth whole.

Let me say that experiencing Jumeokbap dipped into Tteokbokki sauce is like that moment in the movie Ratatouille where Remy eats cheese and strawberry together for the first time and experiences a whole new world of flavors.

Jumeokbap can be made in many different ways, but I would consider the salt, sugar, sesame oil, and seaweed as essential seasonings. The flying fish egg can be omitted or replaced with minced pickled radish (danmuji).

Rosé Tteokbokki
- 500g Korean rice cake sticks
- 2 Strips of bacon
- 30g Gochujang (Korean red pepper paste) (add more if needed or add Korean red pepper powder)
- 4g Minced garlic
- 10g White sugar
- 15g Soy sauce
- 20g Mirin
- 150g Heavy cream
- 75g Whole milk
- Water as needed
- Toppings: Grated parmesan, tonkatsu, melted mozzarella, minced Italian parsley

Jumeokbap
- Cooked Korean rice
- Salt
- White sugar
- Sesame oil
- Crumbled seaweed sheet
- Flying fish egg
- Kewpie mayo

#떡볶이 #로제떡볶이 #koreanfood #tteokbokki #dinner

sample_steps: Blend the scallions, onion, Asian pear, garlic, soy sauce, sugar, water, sesame oil, sesame seeds, and black pepper unti

meta.description:
One of the best cooking hacks we ever learned was that the easiest way to slice steak super thin is to do it while it’s still slightly frozen. #butcherboxpartner

This came in handy tonight when we decided to throw a farewell party for our closest friends who are moving to Portugal. We invited 30 of our friends over for a Korean barbecue themed dinner party, which is always a crowd pleaser!  We grabbed some frozen steaks out of our @butcher_box and let them slightly thaw for about 15 minutes. That’s just enough time for the meat to soften so you can get those super thin, even slices you want for bulgogi, while still being firm enough to slice easily. 

Then slice up the steaks, and toss them in our homemade marinade, which we’re sharing below. We seared them hot and fast until the edges were caramelized and sticky, and it turned into such a beautiful dinner — and an even more special farewell to our dear friends.

BEEF BULGOGI — serves 4, 45 min total

• 1 lb ButcherBox ribeye, thinly sliced 
• 4 garlic cloves, minced
• 2 scallions, chopped
• ½ yellow onion, roughly chopped
• ½ Asian pear, peeled and roughly chopped
• 2 tbsp soy sauce
• 2 tbsp sugar
• 3 tbsp water
• 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
• 1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds
• ½ tsp black pepper

Blend the scallions, onion, Asian pear, garlic, soy sauce, sugar, water, sesame oil, sesame seeds, and black pepper until smooth. Add the beef, coat well, and marinate for 30+ minutes.

Sear in a hot pan or on a flat top until caramelized and cooked through, about 3–4 minutes. #steak #koreanbbq #dinnerparty #cookinghacks

meta.description:
Steak and chimicurri sauce…… everyone has their own recipe and this is mine. If you’re not willing to share your recipe then we don’t wanna hear it. Go ahead and fight for your life on the comment section like your azz is getting paid to do so. I do wanna know who the hell is paying ya for doing unpaid booshit though. 

Recipe for sauce:
•1 tablespoons finely chopped of garlic
•2 tablespoon finely chopped red onion 
•1 tablespoon finely chopped cilantro (leaves only)
•1/4 cup finely chopped fresh parsley (leaves only)
•1/2 tablespoons dried crushed chili 🌶 flakes 
•1/2 teaspoon ground pepper or black pepper
•1 teaspoons dried oregano 
•1/2 teaspoon salt (more if prefer)
•1/4 cup olive oil 
•1 tablespoon red wine vinegar 
•1 teaspoon fresh lemon 🍋 juice. 
*Mix well, taste and adjust. Let set for 15-20 minutes before serving. Refrigerate if not use right away. 
Sauce is good up to 3 days. Make just enough. Always best when it’s fresh. 
*You can put all the ingredients in a chopper and do it at the same time. I prefer hand chopped because it gives better texture. Remember no stem from parsley or cilantro. It will make the sauce kinda slimy.

meta.description:
Restaurant quality food at home always——and this Tuscan Marry Me Salmon will always win BIG. 🤌🏾🔥

FOLLOW @shanikagrahamwhite FOR MORE FOOD + FAITH‼️

YOUR GROCERY LIST:

🥘Salmon. I like to use wild-caught Sockeye salmon for a tastier flavor. However, you can use Atlantic salmon.
🥘Olive oil. Extra fat to this dish that adds additional flavor.
🥘Garlic. I recommend fresh, but you could use ½ teaspoon granulated garlic.
🥘Tuscan seasonings. You can purchase my Tuscan Marry Me Blend for great ease and authentic feel or make your own homemade blend.
🥘Parmesan cheese. You could also use pecorino romano. For a vegan option, dairy-free cheese shreds tastes great.
🥘Tomatoes. You can use sundried tomatoes or add as many tomatoes as you’d like to fill this dish. I used grape tomatoes, however, heirlooms, roma, etc. works too! Just chop them up into nice bite-sized pieces or make your own roasted tomatoes.
🥘Tomato paste. This adds additional flavor + color to the dish.
🥘Vegetable or Seafood stock. Use low-sodium store-bought or make your own. You can also use chicken stock if desired.
🥘Heavy cream. I recommend organic–always! You can sub with full-fat coconut milk/cream for a DF option!
🥘White wine. Choose a dry wine that you like the taste of. You can omit and sub with more stock.
🥘Lemon juice. You can use store-bought or freshly-squeeze juice from an actual lemon.
🥘Kale. Use fresh for best results, but frozen also works! Ensure that it’s chopped.

recipe.description: high protein low carb keto gluten free balanced Tuscan Marry Me Salmon.

ingredients.name: Garlic (fresh or ½ teaspoon granulated garlic)
Parmesan cheese (or pecorino romano or dairy-free cheese shreds)
Vegetable or Seafood stock (low-sodium or homemade)
Heavy cream (or full-fat coconut milk/cream for dairy-free)

instructions: Step 1: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C).
Step 2: In a skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat.
Step 3: Add minced garlic and sauté until fragrant.
Step 4: Stir in Tuscan seasonings and cook for another minute.
Step 5: Add chopped tomatoes and cook until softened.
Step 6: Mix in tomato paste and stir well.
Step 7: Pour in vegetable or seafood stock and bring to a simmer.
Step 8: Add heavy cream and white wine, stirring until combined.
Step 9: Squeeze in lemon juice and add chopped kale.

ingredients.name: washed long grain sella basmati rice

instructions: Marinate the chicken with salt, ground cumin, garlic powder, garam masala, curry powder, cayenne pepper, yogurt, and lemon juice. Let it sit for at least 30 minutes.
In a large pot, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the diced onion and sauté until translucent.
Add minced garlic and grated ginger, cooking until fragrant.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for a few minutes.
Add the tomato puree, paprika, cayenne pepper, curry powder, ground cumin, garam masala, chicken bouillon powder, salt, and sugar. Mix well.
Pour in the chicken stock and water, bringing the mixture to a simmer.
Add the marinated chicken and cook until the chicken is fully cooked.
Stir in the heavy cream and let it simmer for a few more minutes.
Add the washed basmati rice, mixing it into the sauce. Adjust water as needed.
Cover and cook on low heat until the rice is tender and has absorbed the liquid.
Garnish with chopped cilantro or parsley before serving.

Huge respect to everyone who keeps a sourdough starter alive—you all are amazing! But at this stage of my life, working full-time and balancing everything else, I found it hard to keep up with the maintenance.

Right now, active dry yeast just fits my lifestyle better. It’s quicker, easier, and still gives us the soft, fluffy sandwich bread my family reaches for every week. Maybe I’ll be back to sourdough someday... but for now, this recipe is my go-to.

recipe.description: vegetarian low carb keto balanced Andy's No Knead Cheese Bread.
instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, combine 3 cups of all purpose flour, 1 tsp of salt, and 1/2 tsp of dry active yeast.
Step 2: Add 1 1/2 cups of warm water (95F-105F) to the dry ingredients and mix until combined.
Step 3: Fold in 1 1/2 cups of cheddar cheese, 1 cup of thinly sliced chives, and 3 tbs of fresh thyme.
Step 4: Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let it sit at room temperature for 12-18 hours.
Step 5: After the dough has risen, dust a clean surface with 1/4 cup of flour and pour the dough out onto it.
Step 6: Shape the dough into a ball and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Step 7: Preheat the oven to 450°F and place a Dutch oven inside to heat.
Step 8: Carefully transfer the dough into the hot Dutch oven, cover it, and bake for 30 minutes.
Step 9: Remove the lid and bake for an additional 15-20 minutes until golden brown.
recipe.name: Andy's No Knead Cheese Bread

meta.title: Video by dasliderguy

recipe.description: vegetarian Copycat Texas Roadhouse Dinner Rolls with Cinnamon Butter.
instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine the instant yeast, warm milk, and sugar. Let it sit for a few minutes until frothy.
Step 2: In a large mixing bowl, combine the all purpose flour and salt.
Step 3: Add the yeast mixture, melted butter, and room temperature egg to the flour mixture. Mix until a dough forms.
Step 4: Knead the dough on a floured surface for about 5-7 minutes until smooth.
Step 5: Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let it rise in a warm place until doubled in size, about 1 hour.
Step 6: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Step 7: Punch down the risen dough and divide it into equal pieces. Shape each piece into a roll.
Step 8: Place the rolls in a greased baking dish and let them rise again for about 30 minutes.
Step 9: Bake the rolls for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
Step 10: While the rolls are baking, mix the softened butter, cinnamon, and vanilla in a bowl to make the cinnamon butter.
Step 11: Serve the rolls warm with cinnamon butter.
recipe.name: Copycat Texas Roadhouse Dinner Rolls with Cinnamon Butter
notes: The flour quantity is 3.5 cups, not 2.5 cups as mistakenly shown in the video.

Depois mistura o restante dos ingredientes até ficar homogêneo. Fica uma massa bem grudenta, melhor mexer com uma colher

meta.description:
Focaccia fácil e deliciosa!

Ingredientes:
500g de farinha de trigo
420g de água morna (tolerável ao toque)
6g de fermento biológico instantâneo
20g de mel
15g de azeite
10g de sal

Recheio:
Tomate cereja
Alecrim e manjericão frescos
Orégano
1 dente de alho bem picado
Azeite a gosto

• Mistura a água com o mel, umas duas colheres da farinha e o fermento, e deixa por uns 20 minutos (até formar bolhas)
• Depois mistura o restante dos ingredientes até ficar homogêneo. Fica uma massa bem grudenta, melhor mexer com uma colher de pau.
• ⁠Cobre e reserva por 15 a 30 minutos
• ⁠Faça 10 dobras (puxando do fundo e “colando” em cima) e deixe descansando por 15 a 30 minutos
• ⁠Repita as 10 dobras e o descanso de 15 a 30 minutos por mais 3 vezes.
• ⁠Deixe fermentar por 1 hora e meia e passe para uma travessa bem untada com azeite, dobre os 4 cantos, vire para baixo e descanso por mais 1 hora e meia ou 24 horas na geladeira.
• ⁠Faça buracos com os dedos, adicione o recheio e observe a massa. Se ela estiver tensionada, espere mais 20 minutos, quando você “chacoalha” a travessa ela tem que balançar e ter formado bolhas, isso é sinal de uma boa fermentação.
• ⁠Faça uma mistura de azeite e água (20g de cada) e pincele a massa, finalize com flor de sal, sal grosso batido ou sal de parrilha e leve ao forno pré aquecido em 230° por mais ou menos 35 minutos.

Essa vai ser a focaccia mais gostosa que você já comeu!

recipe.description: vegetarian high protein balanced Pumpkin cream cheese muffins.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350F.
In a bowl, mix together the pumpkin purée, oil, milk, eggs, and vanilla bean paste.
Add the granulated sugar, brown sugar, pumpkin spice, cinnamon, flour, baking powder, and baking soda to the mixture and combine well.
In another bowl, beat the cream cheese, powdered sugar, and vanilla until smooth.
Scoop the muffin batter into muffin liners, filling them halfway.
Add a spoonful of the cream cheese mixture on top of the batter in each liner.
Top with more muffin batter until the liners are about 3/4 full.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.

meta.description:
No canning required!

I grow cucumbers specifically for refrigerator pickles. Salty, briny, dill, garlic and crisp. There is nothing better.

Here is my recipe:
3 cups water
6TBS vinegar
2-3 TBS coarse kosher salt (NOT table salt)
Crushed garlic
Fresh dill

Allow to sit in the refrigerator at least 24 hours. The longer the better. They keep a couple months in the fridge if they last that long.

This is a base recipe but adjust to your preference.

I use 3TBS COARSE salt but I love salt. If you use fine salt it will be too salty. My rec is start with 2 TBS COARSE SALT and add more to taste.

I usually add 2 garlic cloves and plenty of dill.

Save to use later and share with anyone who loves pickles 🥒

meta.description:
CROQUETAS DE JAMÓN 🔥

Han pasado dos años desde que me hice viral con esta receta de croquetas de jamón, así que la vuelvo a subir para que todas las personas nuevas que os habéis unido a esta comunidad (¡ya somos más de 400.000! 🤍) la tengáis actualizada y siempre a mano en el perfil.

os subiré si queréis tambien  la parte 2, porque es la que siempre me pedís y muchas veces no la encontráis.

Os he dividido la receta en dos partes ya que hacer croquetas es un proceso laborioso; en esta parte os enseño la creación de la masa.

Las cantidades, dependiendo del número de croquetas que queráis hacer, las tenéis al final del vídeo.

El procedimiento para hacerlas lo tenéis en el vídeo, pero os lo detallo mejor a continuación:

* Infusionar el hueso de jamón en la leche, llevar a ebullición, bajar el fuego al mínimo e ir desespumando. Cuanto más tiempo esté infusionando el hueso en la leche, mejor. Como mínimo, dejadlo dos horas.
* Dorar el jamón durante 4-5 minutos a fuego medio-alto en la sartén para potenciar aún más su sabor. Apartar y reservar.
* Derretir a fuego bajo la mantequilla y agregar poco a poco la harina. Es muy importante que la harina se cocine bien; tiene que coger un tono dorado. Cuando esté cocinada, agregar el jamón que teníamos reservado y cocinar todo junto un par de minutos. De esta forma, la harina también coge el sabor del jamón.
* Agregar poco a poco la leche infusionada caliente, mezclando sin parar con unas varillas. Al principio cuesta un poco, pero con paciencia quedará perfecta.
* Probar para ver si hace falta algún toque de sal (yo no creo que haga falta porque el jamón ya está salado). Forrar una bandeja con film, agregar la masa encima (para evitar que se quede pegada a la bandeja) y cubrir con film a piel. Dejar refrigerando toda la noche.
* La masa tiene que estar bien fría para poder bolear las croquetas correctamente.

¿Queréis la segunda parte? 😍👇#croquetas

Na batedeira, coloca o açúcar e adiciona os ovos. Bate muito bem até obteres uma mistura clara e volumosa.

meta.description:
Grand Gateau cremoso e delicioso, de crescer água na boca, perfeito para compartilhar! 🤤🤎

Já sabes, se gostaste desta receita deixa o teu ❤️, partilha com teu amigo viciado em chocolate, e guarda para fazeres mais tarde, beijinhos 😘

Ingredientes 

• 150gr de manteiga
• 200gr de chocolate @chocolatespantagruel
• 5 ovos
• 150gr de açúcar
• 2 c. sopa de farinha de trigo
• 1 pitada de sal
• 2 colheres de chá de extrato de baunilha 
• Cacau em pó para polvilhar

Preparação 

Num recipiente , junta a manteiga e o chocolate  em pedaços. Leva a derreter (pode ser em banho-maria ou no micro-ondas com cuidado para não queimar).
Na batedeira, coloca o açúcar e adiciona os ovos. Bate muito bem até obteres uma mistura clara e volumosa.
Vertes a mistura do chocolate derretido sobre o preparado de ovos e açúcar, envolvendo suavemente.
Junta uma pitada de sal e extrato de baunilha de seguida, peneira a farinha de trigo por cima da mistura. Envolve com cuidado para não perder a textura.
Verte a massa para uma forma redonda previamente untada com manteiga e forrada com papel vegetal.
Leva ao forno previamente aquecido a 200º durante 15 a 20 minutos.
Polvilha com chocolate em pó corta uma fatia ainda morna e desfruta desta textura incrível, fica perfeito acompanhado por uma bola de gelado de baunilha!🍨🤎
Bom Proveito!

Video by kennethtebogomiddleton
meta.title: Video by kennethtebogomiddleton

recipe.description: high protein low carb keto balanced Chicken and Mushroom Pies.
instructions: Step 1: In a pan, heat 2 tbsp of butter and 1 tbsp of olive oil.
Step 2: Season 400g of chicken thighs with salt and black pepper, then add to the pan.
Step 3: Cook the chicken until golden brown, then remove and set aside.
Step 4: In the same pan, add 1 medium onion and 2 cloves of garlic, sauté until softened.
Step 5: Add 250g of mushrooms and cook until they release moisture.
Step 6: Stir in 1 tsp of fresh thyme leaves and 1 tsp of Dijon mustard (if using).
Step 7: For the béchamel, melt 3 tbsp of butter in a saucepan, then whisk in 3 tbsp of flour.
Step 8: Gradually add 1 cup of room temperature milk and ½ cup of chicken stock, whisking until smooth.
Step 9: Stir in ½ cup of grated cheese and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Step 10: Combine the chicken mixture with the béchamel sauce.
Step 11: Preheat the oven and prepare 3 sheets of thawed puff pastry.
Step 12: Fill the pastry with the chicken and mushroom mixture, then seal.
Step 13: Brush with 1 beaten egg for an egg wash.
Step 14: Bake until golden brown and puffed.
recipe.name: Chicken and Mushroom Pies

🇩🇪 Ein sehr einfaches Rezept, mit dem ihr auch altbackenes Brot wunderbar verwerten könnt. Ihr könnt es nach Belieben mit Oliven, Tomaten, Sucuk oder anderen Zutaten verfeinern.

Tost ekmeği dilimleri veya herhangi bir ekmek dilimleri
3 adet yumurta
50 ml süt (yarım çay bardağı)
50 ml sıvı yağ (yarım çay bardağı)
Bir tutam tuz
İnce kıyılmış maydanoz
Bir tutam pul biber

Üzeri için:
Rendelenmiş @gazi kaşar peyniri
Kırmız toz biber

Hazırlanışı:
Bir kasede yumurtaları, sütü, sıvı yağı, tuzu, pul biberi ve ince kıyılmış maydanozu çırpın. Ekmek dilimlerini bu karışıma batırıp yağlı kağıt serili fırın tepsisine dizin.

Rendelenmiş kaşar peynirini biraz kırmızı toz biber ile harmanlayıp (çok daha güzel kızarmasını sağlıyor) ekmeklerin üzerine ekleyin. Önceden ısıtılmış 190 derece alt-üst ayar fırında, üzerleri kızarana kadar pişirin.

🇹🇷 Tulum Peynirli Domates Carpaccio

Malzemeler:
2 domates
4–5 yemek kaşığı zeytinyağı
2 yemek kaşığı balzamik krema
Bir tutam tuz
4–5 yaprak taze fesleğen
Roka
@gazi tulum peyniri

Hazırlanışı:
Domatesleri ince dilimler halinde doğrayın. Geniş bir tabağa zeytinyağını, balzamik kremayı, tuzu ve ince kıyılmış taze fesleğeni ekleyip karıştırın.

Domates dilimlerini üzerine dizip ters çevirin. Üzerine tulum peyniri ve roka ekleyerek servis edin.

meta.description:
RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ 

I used to say I “wasn’t a breakfast person” which was quite literally a lie 🙈 pre-Covid, when I was in the office 5 days a week, I would stop at Pret most mornings for a coffee and a croissant before dashing into work

So apparently I was a breakfast person. I just wasn’t a make breakfast at home at 6am person 😂

This has been my go-to breakfast on repeat lately because it takes me about 2 minutes to actually make, then I shove it in the oven for 25 minutes while I shower and get ready, and I’ve got breakfast sorted for the next 3 days.

It’s really simple, filling, high in fibre and higher in protein, and most importantly, I don’t have to think about breakfast every morning.

Baked oats recipe 

• 100g oats 
• 1tbs chia seeds
• 2 medium eggs
• 2 tbsp cottage cheese
• 2 bananas
• a little honey
• almond milk - just enough to get it to a thick pancake-batter consistency
• handful of blueberries in each dish

Blend everything together, pour it into glass containers and bake at 200°C fan for around 25 minutes, or until set in the middle.

I split mine into 3 or 4 portions and either eat it before I leave, or take it with me if I’m in a rush! 

I also like to add a spoonful or two of authentic Greek Yogurt or Sheep’s Yogurt with a sprinkle of seeds

Honestly, this is exactly the kind of thing I mean when I say eating well needs to actually fit into your life.

Because if breakfast requires me to start cooking properly at 6am every day, it is simply not happening 🙃

Save this one for later, and send it to the friend who definitely needs to break up with the coffee-and-croissant breakfast routine 🙊

sample_steps: Step 1: Brew a strong ginger tea by simmering 1/2 cup chopped ginger in 4 cups water for 15 minutes.
Step 2: Let the ginger tea cool.

meta.description:
Told you the recipe was coming 🫚🍻
Here’s what that ginger bug from my last post can actually do - delicious ginger beer with no special equipment or suspect ingredients.
To start, brew a strong ginger tea by simmering 1/2 cup chopped ginger in 4 cups water for 15 minutes.
Let cool, then add:
- The juice of 2 limes or lemons
- 1/2 cup honey or sugar of choice (sugar feeds the fermentation, so don’t skip this)
- 1/2 cup active ginger bug (pinned in comments here, or see my last post)
Let sit at room temp for a few days in a swing-top bottle, burping daily until your desired carbonation is reached. You can always add more sugar to increase the fermentation action.
Chill and enjoy 🍻
I had no idea how easy this would be to do at home, letting wild yeast do its thing, making delicious bubbles without a factory. That’s Almost Ancestral - you don’t need to go full-on homestead to benefit from the wisdom of ancestral practices. Start with one thing that intrigues you, and go from there. For me this week, that’s homemade ginger beer, the way was meant to be 🫧.
Would you make this?
#slowliving #fermentation #gingerbeer

recipe.description: vegetarian Matar Paneer Malai Kofta.
instructions: Step 1: Prepare the kofta mixture by mashing paneer, matar, chilli, ginger, garlic, cornflour, kasoori methi, and salt.
Step 2: Shape the mixture into small balls and set aside.
Step 3: Heat oil in a pan and fry the koftas until golden brown. Remove and drain on paper towels.

meta.description:
COBBLER DE FRUTOS ROJOS ❤️
Durante años pensé que era simplemente una torta medio desarmada 😂, hasta que descubrí que tenía nombre y mucha historia: Cobbler.
Los colonos británicos llevaron a Estados Unidos sus preparaciones de frutas y masas, pero al no contar con los mismos ingredientes y utensilios que tenían en Inglaterra, tuvieron que adaptarlas y hacerlas más simples. Así se popularizó el cobbler, un postre de fruta con una cubierta rústica de masa, fácil y sin demasiadas vueltas.
Y esta es mi versión de frutos rojos.
Horno precalentado a 170 grados 
Recipiente para horno y servir de 18 cm
Para la fruta: 300 g de frutos rojos congelados, 50 g de azúcar, 30 g de harina, o fécula de maíz, ralladura de limón y 1 cucharada de jugo de limón.
Para la cubierta: 180 g de harina, 70 g de azúcar, 8 a 10 g de polvo de hornear, 80 g de manteca fría, 120 ml de leche, con una cuchara de jugo de limón canela, y 1 pizca de sal.
Para esta receta usé los recipientes de vidrio @jovifeloficial y lo mejor es que hice todo en el mismo recipiente.
Primero coloqué los frutos rojos congelados, el azúcar, la harina, la ralladura y el jugo de limón. Mezclé todo y reservé.
Para la cubierta hice un arenado con la harina, el azúcar, la canela y la manteca bien fría. Agregué el polvo de hornear y una pizca de sal.
Incorporé la leche y el jugo de limón y mezclé apenas hasta formar una masa húmeda y rústica. No hay que amasar.
Con dos cucharas fui colocando porciones de masa sobre los frutos rojos, dejando algunos espacios para que la fruta asome y burbujee durante la cocción.
Llevé a horno precalentado a 180 °C hasta que la cubierta quedó doradita , introduce un palillo si sale limpio está cocida la masa ,los frutos rojos tienen mucha humedad y puede quedar cruda , unos 40 minutos .
Y listo ❤️ Preparé, horneé y serví todo en el mismo recipiente @jovifeloficial . Del horno directo a la mesa, sin ensuciar de más.
Un postre fácil, rústico y delicioso. ❤️
#cobler #reel #postre

recipe.description: Cobbler de frutos rojos.
instructions: Precalentar el horno a 170 grados.
En un recipiente, colocar los frutos rojos congelados, el azúcar, la harina, la ralladura y el jugo de limón. Mezclar todo y reservar.
Para la cubierta, hacer un arenado con la harina, el azúcar, la canela y la manteca bien fría.
Agregar el polvo de hornear y una pizca de sal.
Incorporar la leche y el jugo de limón, y mezclar apenas hasta formar una masa húmeda y rústica. No amasar.
Con dos cucharas, colocar porciones de masa sobre los frutos rojos, dejando algunos espacios para que la fruta asome y burbujee durante la cocción.
Llevar al horno precalentado a 180 °C hasta que la cubierta esté doradita. Introducir un palillo; si sale limpio, la masa está cocida. Cocinar durante unos 40 minutos.
recipe.name: Cobbler de frutos rojos
notes: No amasar la masa para la cubierta, solo mezclar hasta formar una masa húmeda y rústica.

Se puede usar harina o fécula de maíz para la mezcla de la fruta.

recipe.description: Rosca nuvem de coco.
instructions: Misture a água morna, o leite morno e o fermento biológico seco.
Adicione o açúcar, os ovos, a manteiga ou margarina, o óleo e o sal.
Misture bem e adicione a farinha de trigo aos poucos até obter uma massa homogênea.
Deixe a massa descansar até dobrar de volume.
Modele as rosquinhas de aproximadamente 80g cada.
Coloque em uma forma untada com margarina.
Asse em forno pré-aquecido a 200° por 35 minutos.
Enquanto as rosquinhas ainda estão quentes, finalize com a cobertura de leite condensado, creme de leite, leite de coco e margarina.
Finalize com coco ralado a gosto.
