RECEPT 👇 EIERPOTJES UIT DE AIRFRYER

Zo simpel, maar zó lekker! 😍 Deze eierpotjes maak je met maar een paar ingrediënten en zijn perfect als ontbijt, lunch of als eiwitrijk tussendoortje. En het fijne: je kunt ze zowel in de airfryer als in de oven maken.

Recept voor 1 persoon / 1 eierpotje: 
1 groot ei (L)
klein handje spinazie, grof gesneden
1 stengel bosui, in dunne ringetjes
Half plakje (achter)ham
2 snoeptomaatjes, in plakjes
peper en zout
 ½ tl knoflookpoeder
2 mini-mozzarellabolletjes, gehalveerd
1 el geraspte 30+ kaas

Bereiding:
Pak een klein ovenbestendig schaaltje (ramekin) en breek het ei hierin. Kluts het ei los met peper, zout en knoflookpoeder.

Voeg vervolgens de spinazie, tomaat, bosui,stukjes ham, en mini-mozzarella toe. Verdeel als laatste de geraspte kaas erover.

Airfryer: bak het eierpotje ongeveer 15–18 minuten op 170°C, totdat het ei mooi gestold is.

Oven: bak het eierpotje ongeveer 20–25 minuten op 180°C in een voorverwarmde oven. Houd het de laatste paar minuten even in de gaten, want iedere oven en elk schaaltje is anders.

Voedingswaarden per eierpotje:
160 kcal | 14 g eiwit | 3 g koolhydraten | 9 g

sample_steps: Batir la mantequilla con el azúcar Glass hasta cremar.
Añadir el huevo y la vainilla e integrar.

meta.description:
GALLETA DE MANTEQUILLA DE OTOÑO | RECETA TRADICIONAL DE GALLETAS 
(Un chocolate, una tarde de otoño y una masa de galletas…te gusta el plan?)

Hola…hola…aunque no lo parezca ya estamos en Otoño y hoy os traigo esta receta de galletas tradicionales de mantequilla, las de la niñez…con un toque otoñal en su forma…pero con el sabor de siempre.

Quédate la receta, hazla con los peques de la casa o simplemente prepáralas para darte un capricho con el café, chocolate o el té de media tarde. Yo te dejo la receta…tú pones el plan!!

INGREDIENTES (Salen muchas galletas, depende el cortador. Puedes hacer masa y la que sobre congelar para otra vez) 
✨500 gr Harina @harinassanchezpalencia
✨250 gr Mantequilla Pomada @canadarealsoria 
✨150 gr Azúcar Glass 
✨1 pizca sal
✨1 cdta Extracto de Vainilla @glotomania_com 
✨1 huevo batido @demillo_huevos

ELABORACIÓN:
✔️Batir la mantequilla con el azúcar Glass hasta cremar.
✔️Añadir el huevo y la vainilla e integrar.
✔️Agregar la harina tamizada y la sal, mezclar y amasar.
✔️Estirar la masa (el grosor que veis en el vídeo) en un tapete de silicona de o papel de horno y llevar a la nevera a enfriar 1 h.
✔️Sacar, ir cortando con el cortador de galletas, sello o vaso (lo que tengamos a mano) (Veis en el vídeo como hago las de las caras con un tenedor y una cucharilla) y poner en una bandeja de horno con tapete de silicona. (Repetir hasta acabar la masa, yo lo hice de dos veces, tener la masa fría)
✔️Llevar a la nevera 30’ para que mantengan bien la
torma.
✔️Hornear, horno a 180 gr, calor arriba y abajo precalentado. Durante 15’ (estar pendiente si son pequeñas) o hasta que se empiecen a dorar.
✔️Sacar y pasar rápido a una rejilla y dejar enfriar 

Ya tenemos unas galletas increíbles, con el sabor de la mantequilla y ese toque otoñal de su forma de hoja…y las caritas sonrientes que os parecen? ✨

Feliz Día ✨

#galletasdemantequilla #galletascaseras #butterbiscuits #recetastradicionales #galletasartesanales

recipe.description: Galleta de Mantequilla de Otoño.
instructions: Batir la mantequilla con el azúcar Glass hasta cremar.
Añadir el huevo y la vainilla e integrar.
Agregar la harina tamizada y la sal, mezclar y amasar.
Estirar la masa en un tapete de silicona o papel de horno y llevar a la nevera a enfriar 1 h.
Sacar, ir cortando con el cortador de galletas, sello o vaso y poner en una bandeja de horno con tapete de silicona.
Llevar a la nevera 30’ para que mantengan bien la forma.
Hornear a 180 gr, calor arriba y abajo precalentado, durante 15’ o hasta que se empiecen a dorar.
Sacar y pasar rápido a una rejilla y dejar enfriar.

summary.name: Heidelbeer-Zitronen-Focaccia mit Streuseln
sample_ingredients: 100 g (optional, ansonsten Trockenhefe auf 4g erhöhen) aktiver Sauerteigstarter
sample_steps: Wasser, Sauerteigstarter, Hefe und Zucker miteinander verrühren.
Mehl dazugeben und alles zu einem Teig vermengen.

meta.description:
Heidelbeer-Zitronen-Focaccia mit Streuseln 🫐🍋

credits: @cybelewells 

Für den Teig:

* 500 g backstarkes Weizenmehl
* 380 g Wasser
* 100 g aktiver Sauerteigstarter (optional, ansonsten Trockenhefe auf 4g erhöhen)
* 2 g Trockenhefe
* 30 g Zucker
* 12 g Salz
* 20 g geschmolzene Butter

Für die Heidelbeersoße:

* 500 g frische Heidelbeeren
* 70–90 g Zucker
* 1 EL Zitronensaft
* Abrieb von ½ Bio-Zitrone
* 1 Prise Salz

Für die Streusel:

* 80 g Mehl
* 50 g kalte Butter
* 40 g Zucker
* 1 Prise Salz

Für die Zitronenglasur:

* 80 g Puderzucker
* ca. 1½–2 EL Zitronensaft
* frische Zitronenzeste

Wasser, Sauerteigstarter, Hefe und Zucker miteinander verrühren. Mehl dazugeben und alles zu einem Teig vermengen. Anschließend Salz und geschmolzene Butter einarbeiten.

Den Teig abgedeckt ca. 2–3 Stunden bei Raumtemperatur gehen lassen. Währenddessen 2–3-mal dehnen und falten, bis er zunehmend glatt und luftig wird.

Für die Heidelbeersoße alle Zutaten bis auf den Zitronenabrieb in einen Topf geben und ca. 10–15 Minuten einkochen, bis eine dickliche, marmeladenartige Konsistenz entsteht. Einige Heidelbeeren dabei zerdrücken. Zum Schluss den Zitronenabrieb unterrühren und die Soße vollständig abkühlen lassen.

Den Teig in eine gebutterte Form geben und vorsichtig auseinanderziehen. Einen Teil der Heidelbeersoße auf dem Teig verteilen und leicht einarbeiten. Anschließend weitere 45–60 Minuten gehen lassen.

Für die Streusel Mehl, kalte Butter, Zucker und Salz mit den Händen zu groben Streuseln verkneten.

Mit den Fingern Mulden in die Focaccia drücken, die restliche Heidelbeersoße darauf verteilen und mit den Streuseln toppen.

Bei 200 °C Ober-/Unterhitze ca. 25–30 Minuten goldbraun backen.

Kurz abkühlen lassen. Puderzucker mit Zitronensaft zu einer dickflüssigen Glasur verrühren, über die Focaccia geben und zum Schluss frische Zitronenzeste darüberreiben.

recipe.description: high protein Shepherd’s Pie.

ingredients.name: potatoes, peeled and cut into 1 inch cubes

instructions: Step 1: Heat olive oil in a skillet and add chopped onion, cooking until softened.
Step 2: Add ground beef or lamb and cook until browned.
Step 3: Stir in dried parsley, rosemary, thyme, salt, black pepper, Worcestershire sauce, and minced garlic.
Step 4: Sprinkle in flour and tomato paste, mixing well.
Step 5: Pour in beef broth and add frozen peas and carrots, stirring to combine.
Step 6: Set the meat filling aside.
Step 7: Boil potatoes in salted water until tender, then drain.
Step 8: Mash potatoes with butter, cream, garlic powder, and salt until smooth.
Step 9: Spread the meat filling in a baking dish and top with mashed potatoes.
Step 10: Sprinkle parmesan cheese and paprika on top.

Once cooked, fluff the rice and garnish with chopped spring onion and fried shallots.

sample_steps: Brown the butter for the cookies until it has a nutty aroma.
In a large bowl, combine the browned butter, pumpkin puree, granulated sugar, and brown sugar.

meta.description:
🎃 Soft and chewy brown butter pumpkin oatmeal cookies are always a must-make for me in the fall... packed with pumpkin, oats, spices, and brown butter. Always love seeing when readers try these... and Jennifer Garner was one of them! 🤯 @jennifer.garner 

Comment SEND and we’ll dm you the full recipe with extra notes. I also published this recipe in Sally’s Baking 101 if you have a copy! Grab these ingredients to get started ⬇️

Ingredients
-1 and 1/4 cups (285g) canned pumpkin puree
-1 cup (16 Tbsp; 226g) unsalted butter, cut into pieces
-2 cups (170g) old-fashioned whole rolled oats
-1 and 2/3 cups (208g) all-purpose flour
-1 tsp baking soda
-1/2 tsp salt
-1 and 1/2 tsp cinnamon
-2 tsp pumpkin pie spice
-1 cup (200g) granulated sugar
-2/3 cup (133g) brown sugar
-1 egg yolk, at room temperature
-2 tsp pure vanilla extract

Brown Butter Glaze
-1/4 cup (4 Tbsp; 56g) butter, cut into pieces
-1 and 1/2 cups (180g) confectioners’ sugar
-3 Tbsp (45ml) milk
-1/4 tsp pure vanilla extract

https://sallysbakingaddiction.com/brown-butter-pumpkin-oatmeal-cookies/

Video by sallysbakeblog
meta.title: Video by sallysbakeblog

recipe.description: vegetarian high fiber balanced Soft and Chewy Brown Butter Pumpkin Oatmeal Cookies.
instructions: Brown the butter for the cookies until it has a nutty aroma.
In a large bowl, combine the browned butter, pumpkin puree, granulated sugar, and brown sugar.
Mix in the egg yolk and vanilla extract until well combined.
In another bowl, whisk together the flour, oats, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, and pumpkin pie spice.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined.
Scoop the dough onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 10-12 minutes or until the edges are golden.
For the glaze, melt the butter and mix with confectioners’ sugar, milk, and vanilla extract until smooth.
Drizzle the glaze over the cooled cookies.
recipe.name: Soft and Chewy Brown Butter Pumpkin Oatmeal Cookies
notes: Recipe also published in Sally’s Baking 101.
Video by sallysbakeblog.

From white Spots to Cake getting Cracked to Dome formation all issues are covered in this video 

Ingredients::
Chocolate Sheet Cake - 9 × 13 inch
Dry
• 180 g all-purpose flour
• 60 g unsweetened cocoa powder
• 180 g granulated sugar
• 1 tsp baking powder
• ½ tsp baking soda
• ¼ tsp salt

•••
Wet Ingredients::
• 3 large eggs
• 80 g plain Greek yogurt
• 120 ml milk
• 50 g melted butter, cooled
. 40 ml olive oil 
• 1 tsp vanilla

Chocolate/coffee
• 100 ml hot water
• 1½ tsp instant coffee

Easy Ganache::
250 g Dark and milk chocolate 
250 ml Hot (simmering) Cream
1 tbsp unsalted butter 

Baking Time ⏰

Video by elie.daily
meta.title: Video by elie.daily

recipe.description: vegetarian high protein balanced Decadent Chocolate Cake.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170°C (340°F) for conventional or 160°C (320°F) for fan/convection.
In a bowl, sift together the all-purpose flour, cocoa powder, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
In another bowl, whisk together the eggs, Greek yogurt, milk, melted butter, olive oil, and vanilla.
Combine the wet and dry ingredients until just mixed.
Dissolve the instant coffee in hot water and add to the batter, mixing until smooth.
Pour the batter into a greased 9 × 13 inch baking pan.
Bake in the preheated oven for the specified time until a toothpick comes out clean.
For the ganache, combine dark and milk chocolate with hot cream and stir until smooth.
Add unsalted butter to the ganache and mix until fully incorporated.
Let the cake cool before pouring the ganache over the top.
recipe.name: Decadent Chocolate Cake

This salad is not only absolutely gorgeous on the table, it’s healthy, refreshing and SO delicious too. The longer it marinates in the dressing, the better it gets. Add the walnuts right before serving for extra crunch, but honestly even after they soften a little throughout the week… it’s still incredible. Chop the fresh dill.
Mince the garlic cloves.

meta.description:
Blaubeere Fruit Cakes wie von Cedric Grolet🫐  • Für die Creme: - 250g kalte Mascarpone - 200ml kalte Schlagsahne - 3 EL gezuckerte Kondensmilch - 300ml Milch - 2 Vanilleschooten - 1 TL Vanilleextrakt - 3 Eigelb (M) - 100g Zucker - 30g Mehl - 2 TL Sanapart Milch, Zucker, Eigelb, Mehl & Vanilleschoten in den Topf, verrühren →> unter Rühren bei mittlerer Hitze aufkochen, bis Pudding entsteht Vom Herd nehmen, in Teller füllen, Folie drauf & min. 5 Std. in den Kühlschrank. Mascarpone und die gezuckerte Kondensmilch ür 10 Sekunden mit einem Handmixer verrühren und gleich danach die Sahne dazugießen, gleich hinterher Sahnesteit dazu und tür etwa 1 Minute cremig aufschlagen. Den kalten Pudding 1-2 Minuten cremig schlagen, dann zu der Mascarpone Sahne Creme geben und bei niedriger Stufe kurz miteinander verrühren. •Für die Fruchtfüllung - 500g gefrorenen Blaubeeren  - 250g frische Blaubeeren  - 3 EL brauner Zucker - Saft einer ganzen Zitrone Für die Heidelbeerfüllung gefrorene Blaubeeren mit braunem Zucker im Topf leicht karamellisieren lassen - also einfach erhitzen, bis sie weich werden und richtig schön süß duften. Dann alles fein pürieren und frische, klein geschnittene frische Heidelbeeren unterheben. Die Masse kommt dann in die Silikonform und wird für mindestens 3 Stunden eingefroren. •Für die Glasur: - 150g Kakaobutter - 150g weiße Kuvertüre - Navy + schwarz gemischt fettlösliche Lebensmittelfarbe von Colormill Schokolade + Kakaobutter in der Mikrowelle schmelzen (alle 30 Sek.rühren) Temperatur: 38 °C Gefrorene Blaubeeren aufspießen ,2x eintauchen, Messer vorsichtig abziehen. Für die Fertigstellung wird zuerst etwas von der Creme in die Silikonform gegeben und gleichmäßig verteilt. Darauf kommen die gefrorenen Blaubeerkugeln aus der ersten Form. Anschließend wird wieder eine Schicht Creme darübergegeben. Das Ganze kommt dann für mindestens 4-5 Stunden in den Gefrierschrank, bis alles komplett durchgefroren ist. Nach dem Herausnehmen werden die gefrorenen Blaubeerfrüchte mit Schokolade überzogen. Damit die Füllung im Inneren später schön weich und leicht cremig ist, lässt man die fertigen Früchte anschließend etwa 2Stunden im Kühlschrank auftauen, bevor sie serviert werden. Das Rezept ergibt ca 12 Blaubeeren.  Gutes Gelingen.

Temperatur auf 38 °C bringen.
Gefrorene Blaubeeren aufspießen, 2x eintauchen und Messer vorsichtig abziehen.
Etwas von der Creme in die Silikonform geben und gleichmäßig verteilen.
Gefrorene Blaubeerkugeln aus der ersten Form darauflegen und wieder eine Schicht Creme darübergeben.
Das Ganze für mindestens 4-5 Stunden in den Gefrierschrank stellen, bis alles komplett durchgefroren ist.

recipe.description: high protein low carb keto balanced Osso Buco.
instructions: Dust the beef shank with flour and season with salt and pepper.
In a pot, heat olive oil and sear the beef shank until browned on all sides.
Remove the beef shank and set aside.
In the same pot, add chopped onion, carrots, celery, and garlic. Sauté until softened.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for a few minutes.
Add red wine and scrape the bottom of the pot to deglaze.
Return the beef shank to the pot and add tomato sauce, chicken stock, and thyme.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook on low heat for 2-3 hours until tender.
For the gremolata, mix parsley, lemon zest, and sea salt in a bowl.
Serve the osso buco topped with gremolata.

instructions: Step 1: Marinate the flank steak with baking soda, 2 tbsp soy sauce, cornstarch, oyster sauce, black pepper, and 2 tbsp water. Let it sit for 30 minutes.
Step 2: In a bowl, mix 4 tbsp soy sauce, brown sugar, minced garlic, grated ginger, 1 tbsp cornstarch, and 2 tbsp water to create the sauce.

Step 4: Add 2 garlic cloves and 2 tsp minced ginger to the pan and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Step 5: Add the broccoli and stir-fry until tender.
Step 6: Pour the sauce over the beef and broccoli, stirring to coat evenly.
Step 7: Serve over white rice and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

recipe.description: Pinchos de Pollo con Salsa de Ajo y Queso Parmesano.
instructions: 1. Remoja los palillos de madera en agua tibia por 10 minutos para evitar que se quemen. Mientras tanto, en un bol, combina los cubos de pollo con aceite de aguacate, paprika, ajo en polvo, sal, cebolla en polvo y pimienta negra. Deja marinar mientras se remojan los palillos.
2. Ensarta los trozos de pollo sazonado en los palillos remojados, presionando las piezas bien juntas. Esto asegura que la carne quede más jugosa al evitar que el pollo se seque durante la cocción.
3. Coloca los pinchos en la cesta de la freidora de aire y cocina a 400°F por 5 minutos. Voltea los pinchos y cocina por otros 5 minutos.

4. Mientras se cocina el pollo, prepara la mantequilla de ajo y parmesano: combina la mantequilla derretida, ajo picado, perejil picado, sal, parmesano rallado y hojuelas de chile rojo molido (si lo usas) en un bol pequeño.

5. Después de los primeros 10 minutos de cocción, unta generosamente los pinchos de pollo con la mezcla de mantequilla de ajo y parmesano. Regresa a la freidora de aire por 4 minutos finales hasta que el pollo esté completamente cocido y dorado.
recipe.name: Pinchos de Pollo con Salsa de Ajo y Queso Parmesano

meta.description:
#nobakecheesecakefilling #philadelphiacheesecakefilling #tipsandtricks #foryoupage #fyp                                                     * 16 oz cream cheese at room temperature (two 8 oz packages) * 1/2 cup granulated sugar * 2 teaspoons vanilla extract * 1 cup heavy cream cold In a large bowl, using an electric hand mixer (or a stand mixer), mix cream cheese and granulated sugar together until smooth and well combined. Scrape the sides and mix again to ensure there are no lumps. Stir in vanilla extract. With the mixer on, add cream in four increments, letting it whip into the cream cheese after each addition. Whip 1 minute until thick and light. Scrape the sides and bottom to ensure even mixing and whip again if needed. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours to overnight, and up to 5 days. Or freeze for up to 3 months. To thaw, place in refrigerator overnight or on counter for 1 hour. When ready to use, serve in a graham-cracker crust as a traditional no-bake cheesecake, use as a dessert topping, layered parfaits, fruit dip and more!

instructions: Preheat oven to 375F.
Cube & season chicken.
Cook chicken in avocado oil over medium heat until fully cooked.
Remove chicken from pot & set aside.
Add onions to pot & cook until translucent.
Stir in garlic & sauté until fragrant.
Stir in heavy cream & place heat on medium/low.
Once at a low simmer, add boursin cheese.
Use wooden spoon to break down boursin cheese & stir until mixture is smooth.
Stir in Parmesan cheese, spinach & then season to taste.
Remove about 1.5-2 cups of sauce & set aside.
Add chicken back to pot then stir until evenly combined.
To a bowl, add ricotta, eggs, parm cheese, basil, parsley & seasoning then stir until combined.
To a large baking dish add a layer of sauce, lasagna noodles, ricotta mixture, chicken & shredded cheese; repeat until baking dish is full (reserved sauce is ONLY for top & bottom layers).
For the final layer you’ll just do lasagna noodles, sauce & mozzarella cheese.
Cover with aluminum foil & bake for 45-50 mins.
Remove lasagna from oven, turn broiler on high, remove aluminum foil & then broil for 3-4 mins (just long enough for top to get golden brown & bubbly).
Let sit for 10-15 mins before cutting & serving.
recipe.name: White Chicken Lasagna

recipe.description: high protein low carb keto gluten free balanced Chicken Alfredo Lasagna.
instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Step 2: Season the pounded chicken breasts with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, Italian seasoning, salt, black pepper, lemon juice, and chili powder.
Step 3: Cook the seasoned chicken in a pan until fully cooked.
Step 4: In a separate pan, melt the butter and sauté the minced garlic until fragrant.
Step 5: Add the heavy cream and bring to a simmer.
Step 6: Stir in the shredded parmesan cheese and Italian seasoning, and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Step 7: In a bowl, mix the ricotta, mozzarella, shredded parmesan, egg, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Step 8: In a baking dish, layer the lasagna sheets, followed by the ricotta mixture, cooked chicken, and Alfredo sauce.
Step 9: Repeat the layers until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of mozzarella on top.
Step 10: Bake in the preheated oven for 30-35 minutes or until bubbly and golden.

meta.description:
Homemade pretzels! this recipe makes 8 soft, delicious pretzels. 4 1/2 cups all purpose flour  1 1/2 cups warm water 1 TBS sugar 2 tsp salt 4 TBS butter melted 2 1/4 tsp instant yeast  baking soda water: 2.5 qts water  2/3 cup baking soda egg wash (1 egg scrambled) pretzel salt or sea salt and butter for the top  mix the dough ingredients until incorporated then knead for 5 minutes. cover with a damp towel and place somewhere warm to rise for 1 hour until doubled in size combine water and baking soda in a large pot and bring to a boil when dough is almost ready. oil your countertop, place dough onto counter and divide into 8 even sections  roll each section into a long rope and set off to the side. continue with each section. take the first one and roll again until it reaches about 24 inches and shape as shown. place on parchment lined baking sheet  boil a few at a time for 20 seconds in baking soda mixture, remove with slotted spatula and place back on parchment lined baking sheet  brush with egg wash and bake at 450° for 6 minutes  remove and brush again with egg wash, top with pretzel salt/or sea salt bake again for 6 minutes (upper middle to add color) brush with melted butter when done, let cool and enjoy!! #pretzel #homemade #delicious #baker #easyrecipe

recipe.description: vegetarian Homemade Pretzels.
instructions: Mix the dough ingredients until incorporated then knead for 5 minutes.
Cover with a damp towel and place somewhere warm to rise for 1 hour until doubled in size.
Combine water and baking soda in a large pot and bring to a boil when dough is almost ready.
Oil your countertop, place dough onto counter and divide into 8 even sections.
Roll each section into a long rope and set off to the side.
Take the first one and roll again until it reaches about 24 inches and shape as shown.
Place on parchment lined baking sheet.
Boil a few at a time for 20 seconds in baking soda mixture, remove with slotted spatula and place back on parchment lined baking sheet.
Brush with egg wash and bake at 450° for 6 minutes.
Remove and brush again with egg wash, top with pretzel salt or sea salt.
Bake again for 6 minutes (upper middle to add color).
Brush with melted butter when done, let cool and enjoy!

recipe.description: vegetarian high protein balanced Easy Refreshing Lemon Zucchini Bread.

ingredients.name: grated zucchini, do not squeeze out excess liquid
ingredients.quantity: 2 cups (280 g), about 2 to 2 1/2 medium zucchinis

instructions: Preheat the oven and prepare the baking pan.
In a mixing bowl, combine the sugar and lemon zest.
Add the eggs, canola oil, vanilla extract, and lemon juice to the bowl and mix well.
Fold in the grated zucchini.
In another bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, baking powder, and salt.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top.
Bake until a toothpick comes out clean.
While the bread is baking, prepare the glaze by mixing the sugar, lemon juice, melted butter, and sea salt.
Once the bread is done, drizzle the glaze over the top while it's still warm.

Bandnudel Schmorbraten 🥘 Teil 33 | Kinderrezepte  Anzeige | eigene Gewürze 🌿 Zutaten 4 Personen: ✳️900 g Rinderkeule ✳️4–5 große Zwiebeln ✳️1 komplette Knoblauchknolle ✳️3–4 Karotten ✳️2–3 EL Tomatenmark ✳️1,6 LRinderbrühe ✳️Salz ✳️Etwas Öl zum Anbraten ✳️Joe’s Pasta Buddy oder italienische Kräuter ✳️500g Bandnudel  ✳️Frisch geriebener Parmesan Zubereitung 1. Die Zwiebeln schälen und klein schneiden. Die Knoblauchknolle schälen und die einzelnen Zehen halbieren. Die Karotten schälen und in mundgerechte Stücke schneiden. 2. Das Rindfleisch in vier möglichst gleich große Stücke schneiden und von allen Seiten mit Salz würzen. 3. Etwas Öl in einem großen Topf erhitzen und das Fleisch von allen Seiten scharf anbraten. Anschließend herausnehmen und beiseitestellen. 4. Zwiebeln, Knoblauch und Karotten in den Topf geben und einige Minuten anschwitzen. Das Tomatenmark hinzufügen, gut verrühren und kurz mit anrösten. 5. Das Fleisch zurück in den Topf legen und alles mit Rinderbrühe auffüllen, bis das Fleisch gut bedeckt ist. 6. Das Ganze bei mittlerer Hitze etwa 3½ bis 4 Stunden schmoren lassen, bis das Fleisch butterzart ist. 7. Kurz vor Ende der Garzeit die Nudeln nach Packungsanweisung kochen. 8. Das fertige Fleisch aus dem Topf nehmen und mit zwei Gabeln zerpflücken. Anschließend wieder in die Soße geben. 9. Mit Joe’s Pasta Buddy oder alternativ italienischen Kräutern abschmecken. 10. Die gekochten Nudeln direkt aus dem Kochwasser zur Soße geben, alles gründlich vermengen und zum Schluss frisch geriebenen Parmesan unterrühren. #schmorbraten #nudel #kinderrezepte #fürdich #viral

sample_steps: Gently melt the cacao butter until fully liquid. Do not overheat.
In a mixing bowl, add cacao butter, honey, and cocoa powder gradually, whisking continuously to prevent lumps.

meta.description:
Chocolate Bar Recipe ⬇️ Is anyone else tired of spending so much on store-bought chocolate? Finding clean chocolate especially without refined sugars can cost $6-$9 per bar/ bag or more. Why not try making your own at home? It’s an easy, affordable swap that lets you control the ingredients going into your food.  Plus, it’s a fun activity—your toddler will love helping out! Homemade Bar Recipe: Ingredients: -2/3 cup cacao or cocoa powder (unsweetened) -1/3 cup honey  -1/2 cup cacao butter or coconut oil  (melted) -Gently melt the cacao butter until fully liquid. Do not overheat.  -In a mixing bowl, add cacao butter,  honey, and cocoa powder gradually, whisking continuously to prevent lumps. -Pour the chocolate mixture into the mold and spread evenly. -Refrigerate 2-3 hours or freeze for 30–45 minutes until fully set. -Once hardened, remove the chocolate from the mold - Store in an airtight container in the fridge or freezer. Using coconut oil vs cocoa butter: Cacao butter has a higher melting point (93°F to 100°F) compared to coconut oil (~76°F). This means your chocolate bars will stay solid at room temperature and won’t melt as easily. Both ways still work! Coconut oil can be cheaper and easier to grab from any store!  #momoflittles #homesteadingmama #toddlersnacks #toddlermama #homemadesnacks

Step 2: Bread the pork chops by coating them in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs.

meta.description:
The Pork Chop Martini is a unique dish that gets its name from its preparation, not a cocktail. It's a culinary twist that elevates a classic pork chop into a sophisticated meal, famous for its rich flavor and impressive presentation.
What Makes It Unique?
Here are the key elements that set it apart:
1. The "Martini" Sauce
The dish is defined by its flavorful finishing sauce, which often includes:
• Wine Reduction: A base of white wine (or dry vermouth) that deglazes the pan, adding a sophisticated, aromatic layer.
• Aromatics: Garlic and hot cherry peppers for a savory kick.
• Bright Acids: A splash of lemon juice and red wine vinegar to cut through the richness.
• Broiled Cheese: The chops are often topped with Parmesan or Pecorino Romano and broiled until melted.
2. The Cut and Preparation
• Thinly Pounded: The pork chops (usually bone-in) are typically pounded flat to under 1/2 inch thick.
• Breaded: They are breaded—often with a mix of flour, egg, and breadcrumbs—before being fried until golden.
• Quick Finish: Because they are so thin, they are returned to the sauce-filled pan to absorb the flavors, finishing in the oven or on the stovetop.
Origin and Popularity
The dish is widely recognized as inspired by Robkes Northport, an Italian restaurant on Long Island, NY. It has gained significant popularity online for its impressive presentation and rich flavor.
A Visual Taste of the Pork Chop Martini
Variations to Explore
If you're feeling adventurous, you can try a few variations of this dish:
• Chicken Version: You can make a similar dish using Italian chicken cutlets instead of pork.
• Different Sauces: Experiment with sweet vermouth for a richer sauce, or add other herbs like thyme, rosemary, or sage.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
In a bowl, mix the lean ground breakfast sausage with the sausage seasoning and olive oil.
Let the mixture sit for 15 minutes.
In another bowl, combine the egg whites, eggs, cottage cheese, corn starch, and nutritional yeast.
Spread the sausage mixture evenly on a sheet pan.
Pour the blended egg mixture over the sausage.
Top with diced red and green bell peppers and American cheese.
Bake for approximately 30 minutes or until set.
Once cooked, let cool, then cut into portions.
Wrap each portion in a burrito-sized tortilla.
Store in the freezer until ready to eat.

instructions: Step 1: Crush 20 Oreos and mix with 3 tablespoons of melted butter.
Step 2: Press the mixture into the bottom of a pie dish to form the crust.
Step 3: In a bowl, combine 8 ounces of softened cream cheese and 1/2 cup of peanut butter.
Step 4: Gradually add 1.5 cups of powdered sugar and mix until smooth.
Step 5: Fold in 16 ounces of thawed frozen whipped topping.
Step 6: Pour the cream cheese mixture over the crust in the pie dish.
Step 7: In another bowl, mix 1 cup of cold milk with 1 (3.9 ounce) chocolate fudge pudding mix until thickened.
Step 8: Spread the pudding mixture over the cream cheese layer.
Step 9: Top with miniature peanut butter cups.
Step 10: Refrigerate until set before serving.

Add a cinnamon stick or 1/2 tsp cinnamon and 1 tsp vanilla paste or extract.
Bring to a boil and stir until sugars are dissolved.
Let cool and store in bottles.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Prepare the chicken breast by seasoning it with your favorite spices.
Dip the seasoned chicken breast in beaten eggs, then coat with bread crumbs.
Place the chicken on a baking sheet and bake for about 25 minutes, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F.
While the chicken is baking, slice the squash and zucchini.
Toss the squash and zucchini with olive oil and your favorite seasonings.
Spread the vegetables on a baking sheet and roast for about 30 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Top the roasted squash and zucchini with Parmesan cheese before serving.

meta.description:
Homemade pretzels! this recipe makes 8 soft, delicious pretzels. 4 1/2 cups all purpose flour  1 1/2 cups warm water 1 TBS sugar 2 tsp salt 4 TBS butter melted 2 1/4 tsp instant yeast  baking soda water: 2.5 qts water  2/3 cup baking soda egg wash (1 egg scrambled) pretzel salt or sea salt and butter for the top  mix the dough ingredients until incorporated then knead for 5 minutes. cover with a damp towel and place somewhere warm to rise for 1 hour until doubled in size combine water and baking soda in a large pot and bring to a boil when dough is almost ready. oil your countertop, place dough onto counter and divide into 8 even sections  roll each section into a long rope and set off to the side. continue with each section. take the first one and roll again until it reaches about 24 inches and shape as shown. place on parchment lined baking sheet  boil a few at a time for 20 seconds in baking soda mixture, remove with slotted spatula and place back on parchment lined baking sheet  brush with egg wash and bake at 450° for 6 minutes  remove and brush again with egg wash, top with pretzel salt/or sea salt bake again for 6 minutes (upper middle to add color) brush with melted butter when done, let cool and enjoy!! #pretzel #homemade #delicious #baker #easyrecipe

instructions: Step 1: Marinate the flank steak with baking soda, 2 tbsp soy sauce, cornstarch, oyster sauce, black pepper, and 2 tbsp water. Let it sit for 30 minutes.
Step 2: In a bowl, mix 4 tbsp soy sauce, brown sugar, minced garlic, grated ginger, 1 tbsp cornstarch, and 2 tbsp water to create the sauce.
Step 3: Heat 2 tbsp canola oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the marinated steak and cook until browned.
Step 4: Add 2 garlic cloves and 2 tsp minced ginger to the pan, sauté for a minute.
Step 5: Add the broccoli and stir-fry until tender.
Step 6: Pour the sauce over the beef and broccoli, stir to combine, and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Step 7: Serve over white rice and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine 350g warm water, 100g starter, 500g flour, and 8g salt. Mix until well combined.
Step 2: Let the dough rise until doubled in size.
Step 3: In a separate bowl, mix 60g softened butter, 3/4 cup brown sugar, and 1 tbsp cinnamon to create the brown sugar cinnamon mixture.
Step 4: Once the dough has risen, spread it out in a baking dish.
Step 5: Spread the brown sugar cinnamon mixture over the dough.
Step 6: Roll the dough and cut it into pieces, then place them back in the baking dish.
Step 7: Let the dough rise again until puffy.
Step 8: Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and bake for 25 minutes.
Step 9: For the icing, mix 1 cup powdered sugar, 1 teaspoon vanilla bean paste, and 3 tbsp milk until smooth.
Step 10: Drizzle the icing over the baked focaccia.

meta.description:
Parmigiana is one of Italy’s most iconic dishes and an absolute family favourite.🍆🧀🍅 Layers of aubergine, Parmesan, mozzarella and sweet tomato sauce come together to create the ultimate comfort food! AD @Mutti Pomodoro UK  This version is a little lighter than the traditional recipe, where each slice of aubergine is usually breadcrumbed and deep-fried before the dish is assembled. Instead I simply grill them, which is a great way to reduce the cooking time in the kitchen and makes it a little healthier but without compromising on flavour. The key to this recipe is using peeled plum tomatoes and tomato puree, then slowly cooking and reducing them to create a rich, sweet tomato sauce. As soon as the Parmigiana comes out of the oven, let it rest for at least 15 minutes before serving. This helps the layers set, making it much easier to cut and plate. Here’s the ingredient list👇 Or you can find the full written recipe on my website.   Serves 2 1 medium aubergine 125g fresh mozzarella 50g Parmesan 400g MUTTI peeled plum tomatoes and 1 heaped tbsp of tomato puree 1 small shallot 1 garlic clove 2 sprigs fresh basil Fine sea salt Freshly ground black pepper Extra virgin olive oil #DeceptivelySimple #Parmigiana #Summer #Sicily #Tomato

Step 5: Let the dough rise in a warm place for about 30 minutes.
Step 6: Preheat the oven to 450°F (232°C).
Step 7: Shape the dough into pretzels and place them on a baking sheet.

recipe.description: vegetarian Cinnamon Rolls.
instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine warm milk and yeast. Let it sit for a few minutes.
Step 2: Add sugar, melted butter, and egg to the yeast mixture.
Step 3: Gradually mix in the flour and salt until a dough forms.
Step 4: Knead the dough until smooth and elastic.
Step 5: Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let it rise until doubled in size.
Step 6: For the filling, mix brown sugar and cinnamon in a bowl.
Step 7: Roll out the dough and spread softened butter over it.
Step 8: Sprinkle the brown sugar and cinnamon mixture evenly over the buttered dough.
Step 9: Roll the dough tightly and cut into rolls.
Step 10: Place the rolls in a greased baking dish and let them rise again.
Step 11: Bake in a preheated oven until golden brown.
Step 12: For the frosting, beat together cream cheese, vanilla, butter, milk, and powdered sugar until smooth.
Step 13: Spread the frosting over the warm cinnamon rolls.
recipe.name: Cinnamon Rolls

instructions: In a bowl, combine warm milk, yeast, and honey. Let it sit until frothy.
Add egg, egg yolk, sugar, and salt to the yeast mixture.
Gradually mix in bread flour and butter until a dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface until smooth.
Let the dough rise in a warm place until doubled in size.
For the filling, mix softened butter, brown sugar, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
Roll out the dough and spread the filling evenly over it.
Sprinkle diced apples over the filling.
Roll the dough tightly and cut into rolls.
Place rolls in a greased 9x9 inch square pan.
Let the rolls rise again until puffy.
Pour heavy cream over the rolls before baking.
Bake at 350°F for 27-30 minutes or until golden brown.
For the icing, beat together butter, cream cheese, cinnamon, heavy cream, and icing sugar until smooth.
Drizzle icing over warm rolls and top with remaining apple filling.

meta.description:
Apple Pie Cinnamon Rolls 🍎💛🥰 the most moist and tender apple pie cinnamon rolls! Now that apple picking is coming up soon, this recipe is perfect to ring in the fall season!  Makes 9 rolls. Ingredients For the Dough: * 180g milk whole is best * 1 1/8 teaspoons (6 grams) active dry yeast  * 1 teaspoon honey * 1 large egg plus 1 large egg yolk, room temperature * 75g sugar * ½ teaspoon salt * 410g bread flour plus extra for rolling * 60g butter room temperature  For the Cinnamon Sugar Filling: * 64g Unsalted butter, softened * 95g Brown sugar * 2 tsp Ground cinnamon * 1/8 tsp Ground nutmeg For the Apple Pie Filling/Topping (Use only 350-400g for the filling, the remaining filling is for the topping after the rolls are baked): * 650g apples (about 3-4 apples), peel cored and small diced * 3 tbsp butter  * Juice of 1 lemon  * 110g brown sugar, packed  * 1/4 tsp salt * 2 teaspoon cinnamon * Cornstarch slurry: 2 1/2 tsp cornstarch plus 2 1/2 tsp water Classic cream cheese icing: * 56g unsalted butter, room temperature  * 4 oz cream cheese, room temperature * 1/2 tsp cinnamon  * 2-3 tbsp heavy cream or milk * 100g icing sugar  After the rolls have proofed, pour about 1/4 cup heavy cream over the rolls and bake at 350 for 27-30 minutes. Or until the cinnamon rolls have fully baked.  Full detailed recipe also posted on my website. recipe.description: vegetarian Apple Pie Cinnamon Rolls.

ingredients.name: apples
ingredients.quantity: 650g (about 3-4 apples), peeled, cored and small diced

instructions: In a bowl, combine warm milk, yeast, and honey. Let it sit until frothy.
Add egg, egg yolk, sugar, and salt to the yeast mixture.
Gradually mix in bread flour and butter until a dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface until smooth.
Let the dough rise in a warm place until doubled in size.
For the filling, mix softened butter, brown sugar, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
Roll out the dough and spread the filling evenly over it.
Sprinkle diced apples over the filling.
Roll the dough tightly and cut into rolls.
Place rolls in a greased 9x9 inch square pan.
Let the rolls rise again until puffy.
Pour heavy cream over the rolls before baking.
Bake at 350°F for 27-30 minutes or until golden brown.
For the icing, beat together butter, cream cheese, cinnamon, heavy cream, and icing sugar until smooth.
Drizzle icing over warm rolls and top with remaining apple filling.
recipe.name: Apple Pie Cinnamon Rolls
notes: Use a 9x9 inch square pan.
Use only 350-400g of the apple pie filling for the filling; the remaining filling is for the topping after the rolls are baked.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Prepare the tomatoes, shallots, onion, bell pepper, and garlic by cutting them into halves or quarters.
Place all the prepared vegetables on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil, balsamic vinegar, and season with salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes.
Roast in the oven for about 30-40 minutes until the vegetables are caramelized.
In a large pot, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the roasted vegetables to the pot along with the tomato paste and mix well.
Add the Better Than Bouillon paste mixed with water and bring to a simmer.
Stir in the heavy cream and the Boursin cheese until melted and combined.
Blend the soup until smooth using an immersion blender or a regular blender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh basil.

meta.description:
Crunchy Mediterranean Cabbage Salad — This healthy cabbage recipe pulls double duty for your digestion and your complexion. It's my ultimate go-to cabbage salad for a happy gut and glowy skin🙌 Supporting my gut health and getting that natural skin glow from the inside out doesn't have to be complicated. Here's why your body will love this bowl: 🥬 Prebiotic Fiber: Raw cabbage is packed with gut-friendly fiber that feeds your beneficial bacteria. (Fun fact: a balanced, happy gut microbiome is heavily linked to clearer, calmer skin!) ✨ Collagen-Boosting Vitamin C: Bell peppers, tomatoes, and fresh lemon juice deliver a massive dose of Vitamin C, which is essential for natural collagen production and a radiant complexion. 🌿 Antioxidant Power: Fresh herbs like parsley and mint provide powerful plant compounds that fight free radicals, supporting both a healthy digestive system and glowing skin. 🫒 Healthy Fats (with more antioxidants!): Extra virgin olive oil is rich in polyphenols that nourish gut bacteria, while those healthy fats help keep your skin hydrated and plump. The best part? This easy Mediterranean recipe is perfect for meal prep because the crunch holds up beautifully, and the flavors get even better after a few hours in the fridge. 💯 Ingredients: For The Cabbage Salad ▢ 1 cup sliced almonds ▢ 4 cups shredded green cabbage (from about 1/2 head of green cabbage) ▢ 2 cups shredded red cabbage (from about 1/4 head of red cabbage) ▢ 1 cup grated carrots (from about 3 medium carrots) ▢ 2 green onions, trimmed and chopped (both white and green parts) ▢ 1 red bell pepper, cored and cut into thin sticks ▢ 4 radishes, halved and thinly sliced ▢ 1 cup chopped fresh parsley ▢ 1/2 cup chopped fresh dill ▢ Kosher salt ▢ 1 teaspoon sumac For The Dijon-Lime Vinaigrette ▢ 2 tablespoons Dijon mustard ▢ 2 limes, juiced ▢ 2 garlic cloves, minced ▢ 1/3 cup extra virgin olive oil ▢ 1/2 teaspoon sumac ▢ 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes (optional) ▢ Kosher salt ▢ Black pepper Fresh, crunchy, and packed with Mediterranean flavor—this is one easy cabbage recipe you'll want on repeat. 🔁 If you're looking for an easy way to support your gut health, this is a great place to start. The best part? This salad is perfect for meal prep because the cabbage stays crisp, and the flavors get even better after a few hours in the fridge. #fiber #guthealth #mediterraneanfood #cabbage #salad

recipe.description: high protein low carb keto balanced Cheesy Garlic Butter Meatloaf.
instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Step 2: In a large bowl, combine ground beef, onion, garlic, egg, breadcrumbs, milk, Parmesan cheese, Worcestershire sauce, Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Step 3: Mix until well combined and shape into a loaf.
Step 4: Place the meatloaf in a baking dish and bake for 1 hour.
Step 5: In a separate bowl, mix together mozzarella cheese, cheddar cheese, melted butter, minced garlic, parsley, and Parmesan cheese for the topping.
Step 6: After 1 hour, remove the meatloaf from the oven and spread the cheese mixture on top.
Step 7: Return to the oven and bake for an additional 15-20 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Step 8: Let it rest for a few minutes before slicing and serving.

instructions: Step 1: Marinate chicken thighs in honey, garlic, Dijon mustard, soy sauce, and herbs for at least 30 minutes.
Step 2: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Step 3: Cut potatoes into bite-sized pieces and toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Step 4: Spread potatoes on a baking sheet and roast for 25-30 minutes until golden.
Step 5: Trim and halve Brussels sprouts, toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper, and add to the baking sheet for the last 15 minutes of roasting.
Step 6: Cook marinated chicken thighs in a skillet over medium heat until cooked through, about 6-7 minutes per side.
Step 7: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Step 8: Assemble bowls with chicken, potatoes, Brussels sprouts, and drizzle with creamy honey garlic Dijon sauce.

meta.description: I make the monthly drink specials for my bar and my fall mimosas are the biggest sellers every year. My secret is my syrup. 2 cups of apple juice, 1 cup brown sugar, 6 cinnamon sticks, 2 green apples sliced, bring to a soft boil until apples soften, add in vanilla extract after removing from heat and strain. instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Step 2: In a large bowl, combine ground beef, onion, garlic, egg, breadcrumbs, milk, Parmesan cheese, Worcestershire sauce, Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.

instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, and cinnamon.
Step 2: In a blender, mix the cottage cheese, eggs, milk, coconut oil, maple syrup, and vanilla extract until smooth.
Step 3: Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined.

meta.description:
Crispy zucchini Parmesan bites 🥒🧀 Crispy outside, cheesy in the middle, and such a good way to use up zucchini. The MOST important part: squeeze out as much water from the zucchini as you possibly can. That’s what helps these actually get golden and crispy. You’ll need: • 2 medium zucchini, shredded • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 cloves garlic, minced • ¾ cup Italian breadcrumbs • ¾ cup grated Parmesan * ½ cup shredded mozzarella • parsley • salt + pepper Squeeze the zucchini really well, then sauté with olive oil and garlic until softened. Let cool slightly, then mix with the breadcrumbs, Parmesan, mozzarella and seasonings. Roll into balls and bake at 400°F for about 18–22 minutes, until deeply golden. Enjoy! meta.description: I make that all the time only I mix everything together and I put my olive oil on everything and I have a little salt and pepper and I take my garlic clove hole. The entire bulb cut the bottom of it and put it in the center. I cover it with foil and roasted it for 40 minutes and then I blend everything up and I use milk. I don’t use heavy cream because I think it makes it too rich and I opt to leave the basil out because I like the country taste and I usually make this in the summer when I can get fresh tomatoes and I actually can it. Yeah, the old-fashioned way that way I have it all winter long.
meta.title: Recipe by @nick.digiovanni

recipe.description: vegetarian low carb keto gluten free balanced Roasted Tomato Garlic Soup.
instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Step 2: Cut the tomatoes in half and place them on a baking tray.
Step 3: Cut the yellow bell pepper and onion into wedges and add them to the tray.
Step 4: Take a whole bulb of garlic, cut the bottom off, and place it in the center of the tray.
Step 5: Drizzle olive oil over the vegetables and season with salt and pepper.
Step 6: Cover the tray with foil and roast in the oven for 40 minutes.
Step 7: After roasting, blend the mixture until smooth.
Step 8: Add milk to achieve the desired consistency.
recipe.name: Roasted Tomato Garlic Soup
notes: Do not use heavy cream to avoid making it too rich.
Basil is omitted to keep a country taste.
Usually made in summer with fresh tomatoes and canned for winter use.

instructions: Step 1: Season your Chicken with your favorite BBQ Rub and in the @Weber Grills Searwood at 350 degrees until the internal temperature reaches 155 degrees. (Undercook since it will continue to cook in Hot Pocket)
Step 2: In a skillet on medium heat add butter and onions and sauté until soft then add in garlic and sauté until fragrant.

Step 3: Then add Sun Dried Tomatoes, Tomato Paste, Lemon Zest and the juice of the Lemon, Alfredo Sauce, Paprika, Red Pepper Flakes, Italian Seasoning, Parmesan, and chopped Parsley (Sauté until creamy and well incorporated).
Step 4: Turn off the heat and let cool for 30 minutes.
Step 5: Lay out Sheet of Puff Pastry and add in the Marry Me filling topped with Colby Jack Cheese. Then topped with another layer of Puff Pastry sheet. (Lattice sheet on top is optional).
Step 6: Use an egg wash and top with Pork Grinds and Parmesan for an added flavor and texture.
Step 7: Set the Weber Searwood to 400 degrees and cook for about 30 minutes until the Puff Pastry is golden brown and flaky.
recipe.name: Marry Me Chicken Hot Pocket

meta.description:
Caramel Pie
50 caramels
1/4 cup water
16 oz whipped topping
8 oz sour cream
2 graham cracker crusts
In microwaveable bowl, place caramels and water. Start with 90 seconds and stir. Then microwave 60 seconds and stir, microwave one final time around 60 seconds until creamy and thin. Adjust the intervals according to your microwave. While caramel mixture is cooling, mix sour cream and whipped topping. After caramel has cooled enough, mix it with the sour cream/whipped topping. Pour into pie crusts and refrigerate over night or several hours. Can top with additional whipped topping, if desired, and caramel bits for garnish.
This recipe can be divided if you only want one pie. Because there are fewer caramels, be sure to adjust your microwave times if you do.

instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine warm water, active dry yeast, and sugar. Let it sit for a few minutes until frothy.
Step 2: In a mixing bowl, combine all purpose flour and salt.
Step 3: Add the yeast mixture and melted butter to the flour mixture.
Step 4: Knead the dough until smooth and elastic.
Step 5: Let the dough rise in a warm place until doubled in size.
Step 6: Preheat the oven to 450°F.
Step 7: Shape the dough into pretzels and place them on a baking sheet.
Step 8: Bake for 12 minutes or until golden brown.

summary.name: Not Your Average Tomato Sandwich
sample_steps: Step 1: Slice the tomatoes and marinate them with salt, pepper, oregano, and chili flakes.
Step 2: Add red wine vinegar to the marinated tomatoes.

meta.description:
Not your average tomato sandwich. Full recipes at www.cheffinwithzach.com (in bio).  I’m annoyed. The second September hits, everybody starts posting cozy fall recipes. I love a cozy soup or stew, but I’m not ready for that just yet. First of all, summer technically ends September 21st, let’s get that straight. Second, tomato season ends in October, and I think this is a more accurate representation of when Summer should end than where the Earth currently is in orbit. So as far as I’m concerned, we have at least another month of summer. I am a tomato lover, and I have been obsessed with those juicy little red guys for as long as I can remember. Every morning, if my eggs aren’t cooked with tomatoes, then I’ll have them on the side. I have tomatoes every single day, and that’s my dad’s fault–he was the one that would always serve us tomatoes, and his obsession transferred over to me. Generational trauma? No, generational tomato obsession. Tomato sandwiches are a popular way to enjoy a delicious summer tomato; traditionally just sliced and seasoned tomatoes on untoasted white bread smeared with a little mayonnaise. It’s good, but I think there is so much more potential to explore here. So, I made my own version and turned it into something great. First, I marinate my tomatoes in a simple mix of salt, pepper, oregano and chili flake for excitement, then red wine vinegar enhances that bright acidity and sweetness of the tomato. Then, I just douse it in a ton of olive oil because, well, tomatoes and olive oil are best friends. Instead of plain mayo, I made my own from scratch, adding garlic, dijon mustard, and miso paste to enhance the tomato’s umami. Also in the sandwich: anchovies to drive that umami even further, then basil because it’s also a tomato’s best friend. All of that in between two layers of sourdough toasted in olive oil. Much more depth of flavor there, plus better for structural integrity. While tomatoes are still in season, I will be making this tomato sandwich on repeat. Hope you enjoy your next month of summer!

Step 6: Layer the marinated tomatoes, anchovies, and basil between the slices of bread.
Step 7: Toast the sandwich in olive oil until golden brown.

recipe.description: vegetarian low carb keto gluten free balanced Peach Cobbler Latte.
instructions: Step 1: Add chopped peaches and brown sugar together over medium heat.
Step 2: Let simmer for 5 minutes to extract peach juices.
Step 3: Add water and bring to a boil, then simmer on low for 10 minutes.
Step 4: Strain and cool, keeping the mushy peaches aside for the cold foam.
Step 5: Blend 2-3 tbsp of the strained peaches with 2 tbsp of milk.
Step 6: In a separate mixer, whisk the peach/milk mixture with 1/2 cup of heavy cream on medium until it thickens and becomes bubbly.
Step 7: Add 3 tbsp of powdered sugar and whisk on high until light and fluffy.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
In a mixing bowl, cream together the butter, sugar, and brown sugar.
Add the egg and vanilla extract, mixing until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined.
Fold in the Cinnamon Toast Crunch cereal.
Using a small cookie scoop, drop dough onto a baking sheet for small cookies, or use a large cookie scoop for larger cookies.

meta.description:
The 1905 salad is a staple in our house for good reason. We’ve had the Columbia Restaurant cookbook since I was a kid and the 1905 salad page has been through it! Here is my version of it: VINAIGRETTE 3 cloves garlic, grated on microplane 1/2 teaspoon oregano 1/2 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce 1-2 tablespoons fresh squeezed lemon juice 1/4 cup white wine vinegar 3-4 green Spanish olives, chopped 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil 1/3 cup Pecorino Romano cheese, grated on microplane Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste Combine everything except oil and mix will. Slowly drizzle in olive oil while whisking vigorously to create an emulsion. Set aside and dip Cuban bread in it because you can.  1905 SALAD 1 head iceberg lettuce, chopped 1/2 cup white onion (this was half an onion for me), thinly sliced 1 cup tomatoes, chopped 1/2 cup green Spanish olives, chopped 3/4 cup Tavern ham, rind cut off, julienned 1/2 cup Swiss cheese, julienned 1/3 cup Pecorino Romano, grated on microplane Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste  Cuban bread for dipping  Combine all ingredients and add dressing, mixing well. When serving, add to bowl and add another small drizzle of dressing, more Romano cheese, and warm Cuban bread. Follow along for more free recipes! ps I LOVE YOU @The Columbia Restaurant for creating this stunning salad!!!

recipe.description: low carb keto balanced 1905 Salad.
instructions: Combine garlic, oregano, Worcestershire sauce, lemon juice, white wine vinegar, chopped olives, and grated Pecorino Romano cheese in a bowl.
Mix well and slowly drizzle in olive oil while whisking vigorously to create an emulsion. Set aside.
In a separate bowl, combine chopped iceberg lettuce, thinly sliced white onion, chopped tomatoes, chopped olives, julienned Tavern ham, julienned Swiss cheese, and grated Pecorino Romano cheese.
Add the dressing to the salad mixture and mix well.
When serving, add to a bowl and drizzle with more dressing, additional Romano cheese, and serve with warm Cuban bread.

meta.description:
VIRAL DATE CARAMEL APPLE 🍎🍯✨ Episode 5 of HEALTHY FALL RECIPES, where I’m sharing 25 of my must-make recipes this fall! 🍂🤩 I saw this viral idea for making a healthier caramel apple using DATES, and I had to try it! Dates are naturally sweet with the perfect chewy, caramel-like flavor, and they taste SO GOOD wrapped around a crisp apple! 😍 It’s such a fun and easy fall treat made with just 2 main ingredients! You can also dip it in chocolate and add your favorite toppings! 🙌 Full recipe below or find a printable version on my blog linked in bio... Recipe 👇 Ingredients: - 9 Medjool dates - 1 large Honeycrisp apple, or any crisp apple - 1/4 cup dark chocolate chips (optional) - 1 tsp coconut oil (optional) - Sprinkles, crushed pretzels or shredded coconut (optional) How to: - Pit the dates, if needed, and place them between two sheets of plastic wrap. - Use a rolling pin to flatten the dates into one sheet. - Wrap the flattened dates around the apple until it’s completely covered. -If desired, melt the chocolate chips with the coconut oil, dip the apple in the chocolate and add your favorite toppings. - Refrigerate for 15–20 minutes to set. - Slice into wedges and enjoy! Follow so you don’t miss any delicious fall recipes! 😋

instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Step 2: In a large bowl, combine ground beef, onion, garlic, egg, breadcrumbs, milk, Parmesan cheese, Worcestershire sauce, Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Step 3: Mix until well combined and shape into a loaf.
Step 4: Place the meatloaf in a baking dish and bake for 1 hour.
Step 5: In a separate bowl, mix together mozzarella cheese, cheddar cheese, melted butter, minced garlic, parsley, and Parmesan cheese for the topping.
Step 6: After 1 hour, remove the meatloaf from the oven and spread the cheese mixture on top.
Step 7: Return to the oven and bake for an additional 15-20 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Step 8: Let it rest for a few minutes before slicing and serving.

recipe.description: vegetarian Copycat Texas Roadhouse Dinner Rolls with Cinnamon Butter.
instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, combine warm milk and instant yeast. Let it sit for a few minutes until frothy.
Step 2: Add sugar, melted butter, room temperature egg, and salt to the yeast mixture. Mix well.
Step 3: Gradually add all purpose flour, mixing until a dough forms.
Step 4: Knead the dough on a floured surface until smooth and elastic.
Step 5: Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let it rise until doubled in size.
Step 6: Punch down the dough and divide it into equal pieces. Shape into rolls.
Step 7: Place rolls in a greased baking dish and let them rise again until doubled.
Step 8: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Step 9: Bake for 15-18 minutes or until golden brown.
Step 10: For the cinnamon butter, mix softened butter, cinnamon, and vanilla until smooth. Serve with rolls.
recipe.name: Copycat Texas Roadhouse Dinner Rolls with Cinnamon Butter
notes: The flour quantity is 3.5 cups, not 2.5 cups as previously misstated.
Run the egg under warm water for 2 minutes to bring to room temperature.

Honeycrisp apples, celery, extra-sharp cheddar, toasted pecans, dates and shallot all get chopped together and tossed with a sweet and tangy maple Dijon vinaigrette. And yes, we’re serving it with chips because salads can be fun too. Every scoop gets a little bit of everything and the texture is 10/10. Add shredded chicken if you want to make it a meal, or serve it as-is for the perfect snacky lunch, side dish or happy hour situation. Full recipe: https://healthyishfoods.com/chopped-apple-salad/ Chopped Apple Salad 2 medium Honeycrisp apples, cored and roughly chopped 5–6 celery stalks, roughly chopped 4 ounces extra-sharp white cheddar cheese ½ cup toasted pecans, option to use candied  ⅓ cup pitted dates, roughly chopped about 5-6 dates  1 small shallot, roughly chopped Kettle-style potato chips, for serving Maple Dijon Vinaigrette ¼ cup extra-virgin olive oil 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar 1 tablespoon pure maple syrup 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard ½ teaspoon kosher salt Freshly cracked black pepper, to taste

instructions: Chop the Honeycrisp apples, celery, cheddar cheese, toasted pecans, dates, and shallot.

Pour the vinaigrette over the chopped salad and toss to combine.
Serve with kettle-style potato chips.

sample_steps: Paso 1: Calienta 1 litro de leche hasta que hierva.

meta.description:
como hacer yogurt Si tu yogur casero siempre queda aguado, no es tu culpa: es un paso que casi nadie explica. No se trata de la marca de la leche ni del recipiente. Se trata de lo que pasa DENTRO de la leche cuando la calientas: al hervirla, las proteínas del suero se despliegan y se enganchan a la caseína. Esa unión es la que arma la estructura del yogur y la que impide que suelte suero. Después, la cucharada de yogur natural siembra bacterias vivas (Lactobacillus bulgaricus y Streptococcus thermophilus) que se comen el azúcar de la leche y sueltan ácido láctico. El pH baja de 6,7 a 4,6 y, justo en ese punto, la caseína se enlaza y atrapa toda el agua. Eso es, literalmente, el momento en que cuaja. Resultado: un yogur firme, con probióticos vivos, calcio aprovechable y menos lactosa que la leche de partida. Hecho en tu cocina. 👉 Guárdalo para cuando lo vayas a preparar. ¿Lo habías intentado antes y te quedó líquido?

El resultado es un yogur firme, con probióticos vivos, calcio aprovechable y menos lactosa que la leche original.

Once you’ve made a batch, the fun really begins, drizzle it over ice cream, swirl it through brownies, spoon it onto cheesecake, layer it into cakes, dunk apples into it, or top your favourite cookies with it for decoration like my Brown Sugar Cookies (posted last week). instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine chicken thighs, chipotle peppers, adobo sauce, honey, lime juice, garlic, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
2. Marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes.
3. Cook the marinated chicken in a skillet over medium heat until fully cooked.
4. For the cheese pull, add reduced-fat mozzarella on top of the cooked chicken and let it melt.
5. Prepare the tacos by placing the chicken mixture in low-cal tortilla wraps.
6. Top with cilantro and pico.
7. For the Insane Green Goddess Sauce, blend nonfat Greek yogurt, cilantro, lime juice, pickled jalapeño, garlic, salt, pepper, and a splash of water until smooth.
8. Serve tacos with the sauce on the side.

🥣 DIY Cooking Day One: Greek Yoghurt… On the palate, Greek yoghurt is luxuriously creamy and smooth, with a bright, pleasant tang that lingers without being aggressively sour. It can range from mild and custardy in full fat versions to a firm, slightly tart bite in low fat varieties. The texture gives a satisfying mouthfeel that makes it equally at home alongside honey and fruit  or starring in my savoury tzatziki recipe. Making it at home is brilliant, and all it takes it two ingredients. Now I don’t think anyone should be running out to hit yoghurt with cultures so we use a very small amount of existing greek yoghurt to get the milk going and the result is a infinite glitch, where you can keep using the same batch for as long as the cultures live on. meta.description:
🎄Christmas Recipes DAY 4/12: Cheesy Potato Gratin… Potato gratin is a classic French dish made by layering thinly sliced potatoes with cream, garlic, and cheese, usually Gruyère, then baking it until the top turns golden and crispy while the inside becomes delectably soft and creamy. The combination of tender potatoes soaked in rich, savoury cream and melted cheese creates an irresistible comfort food that’s perfect alongside roast meats or as a standalone indulgence.  My version tries to steer clear of cream, and instead creates a loose bechamel sauce that it gets cooked in. This way I am able to flavour the milk with dijon mustard, bay leaf and lots of fresh thyme, whilst also cooking down some shallot in white wine which is my secret trick to getting a more balanced tray bake. The bright acidity of the cooked out white wine, cuts through the richness and the dijon mustard brightens it all up. the result is a deeply creamy gratin, and one that’s not watery in the slightest. FOR THE RECIPES: Head to creamyconfusion.com.au (link in bio). . . . #christmasrecipes #potatogratin

meta.description:
🍦NO CHURN ICE CREAM🍦 (VANILLA & BERRY RIPPLE) Welcome to DAY ELEVEN of 12 days of summer recipes and I wanted to give you a no churn ice cream. The berry ripple brings it altogether and it looks gorgeous. Highly recommend this one and all you need is a whisk and bowl. Berry Ripple 500gm frozen berries (defrosted) 1/2 cup caster sugar 1/2 lemon (juice) Pinch salt In pot add in berries, sugar and salt, and bring to high simmer, stirring as you do. When high simmer reaches, lower to a gentle simmer and let it bubble away for 15 minutes. When its a minute aways from being done, add in lemon juice and stir through. Leave to side to cool. 395gm condensed milk 1/2 cup greek yoghurt 1 tbl sp vanilla bean paste 1 tbl sp liqor 43 Pinch salt 600ml thickened cream (cold) 	1.	In one bowl add in condensed milk, greek yoghurt, vanilla bean paste, liquor 43 and salt and whisk together to homogenous. 	2.	In second bowl add thickened cream and whip until you soft peaks. The cream should hold itself and when you pull away with your beater create a gorgeous peak on itself. 	3.	In two batches pour your first bowl onto cream and fold through gently, important to not lose too much air. Once folded through, grab a bread baking tin and pour in a third of the ice cream. Spoon on top a third of your berry mix and create a ripple affect with a pointy object. Repeat this process two more times. 	4.	Cover tightly with glad wrap and pop into the freezer overnight. . . . #icecream #nochurn #berryripple #vanilla #nochurnicecream #eats #dessert #summer #hotweather

instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven and prepare a baking sheet with cooking spray.
Step 2: Peel and cube the sweet potatoes, then place them on the baking sheet.
Step 3: Season the sweet potatoes with garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Step 4: Roast the sweet potatoes in the oven until tender.
Step 5: In a skillet, cook the ground beef over medium heat until browned.
Step 6: Add the diced onion and minced garlic to the beef, cooking until the onion is translucent.
Step 7: Stir in the garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, cumin, dried oregano, salt, pepper, tomato paste, beef broth, and Worcestershire sauce.
Step 8: Simmer the beef mixture until heated through.
Step 9: In a bowl, mix together the Greek yogurt, light mayo, parsley, cilantro, grated garlic, lime juice, red wine vinegar, dried oregano, salt, pepper, and water to create the creamy herb sauce.
Step 10: Assemble the bowls by layering the roasted sweet potatoes, beef mixture, and creamy herb sauce on top.
Step 11: Add optional toppings like sliced avocado, green onions, and fresh parsley.

meta.description:
5 small changes that completely transform your cinnamon rolls: I make over 500 cinnamon rolls every week, and these are the 5 tips that make the biggest difference: 1️⃣ Add a bit cornstarch (or a little flour) to your filling. This helps absorb extra moisture and keeps the filling from leaking out while baking. 2️⃣ Sprinkle brown sugar and cinnamon in the bottom of the pan. This creates an extra gooey layer that people go crazy for. 3️⃣ Never skip the second proof. Want soft, fluffy cinnamon rolls? This step is non-negotiable. 4️⃣ Pour heavy cream over the rolls before baking. The dough absorbs it as it bakes, giving you that rich, bakery-style texture. 5️⃣ Check the internal temperature. A golden cinnamon roll can still be underbaked in the center. Temperature is the best way to know they’re done. AIM for 195-200 f. The difference between a good cinnamon roll and an unforgettable one is usually in the little details. What did I miss? What’s the tip / trick you swear by? #creatorsearchinsights  #boston #cinnamonroll #microbakery #baking

recipe.description: vegetarian Copycat Texas Roadhouse Dinner Rolls with Cinnamon Butter.
instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, combine 3.5 cups of all purpose flour, 1 packet of instant yeast, and 2 tsp of salt.
Step 2: In a separate bowl, mix 1 cup of warm milk (105 degrees), 1.5 tbsp of sugar, and 4 tbsp of melted unsalted butter.
Step 3: Add the milk mixture to the flour mixture and mix until combined.
Step 4: Add 1 room temperature egg and knead the dough until smooth.
Step 5: Let the dough rise in a warm place until doubled in size.
Step 6: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
Step 7: Shape the dough into rolls and place them in a baking dish.
Step 8: Bake for 15-18 minutes at 350 degrees.
Step 9: For the cinnamon butter, mix 2 sticks of softened butter, 1 tbsp of cinnamon, and 1 tsp of vanilla.
recipe.name: Copycat Texas Roadhouse Dinner Rolls with Cinnamon Butter

had NO idea everyone would love it so much. 🍞  But honestly... I get it. Thick, custardy brioche...Golden caramelized edges...That crackly brûléed sugar topping.... Recipe Eggs: Eggs create the structure and richness of the custard that soaks into the brioche. • Whole milk: Adds creaminess to the custard without making it overly heavy. • Melted butter: Adds extra richness and buttery flavor to the French toast. • Brown sugar: Adds sweetness and a subtle caramel flavor to the custard. • Vanilla extract: Gives the French toast that classic warm vanilla flavor. Cinnamon: Adds a cozy spice that pairs beautifully with the caramelized sugar. • Kosher salt: Balances the sweetness and enhances the other flavors. • Turbinado sugar: This is the star of the caramelized crust. Its larger crystals create a crisp, crunchy layer as the sugar melts and caramelizes. • Extra Butter: Used for cooking and helps the French toast brown beautifully while adding even more buttery flavor. Recipe Variations • Cinnamon Sugar French Toast: Add an extra ½ teaspoon cinnamon to the custard for an even warmer cinnamon flavor. • Bananas Foster French Toast: Top with warm caramelized bananas and a drizzle of caramel sauce. • Strawberry Shortcake French Toast: Top with macerated strawberries, homemade whipped cream, and powdered sugar. meta.description:
Afrikanisches Fufu ✨🥜 #africanfood #afrika #fufu #fufuchallenge #fyp #mood  Zutaten:  4-5 Hähnchenkeulen 15x Cherrytomaten 2x Rote Zwiebel 1x Knoblauchzehe 1 EL Tomatenmark 2 EL Erdnussbutter etwas Rosmarin Salz, Pfeffer, Paprika Edelsüß 300ml Wasser mit 1x TL Gemüsebrühe 1 EL Zucker Für Fufu: 115g Kartoffelmehl 115g Kartoffelpüree Zubereitung:  1. Öl in einer Pfanne erhitzen und die Hähnchenkeulen darin anbraten 2. 1x Zwiebel kleinschneiden und in der Pfanne hinzugeben 3. Hähchen mit Salz und Pfeffer würzen 4. Währendessen wird die Soße vorbereitet, Tomaten, Paprika, Knoblauch, Zwiebel Tomatenmark, Erdnussbutter, Gemüsebrühe und Gewürze in einem Mixer geben, bis eine cremige Soße entsteht. 5. Soße über die Hähchenkeulen geben und 20 Minuten bei geschlossenen Deckel köcheln lassen 6. Kartoffelpürre und Kartoffelmehl in einem Topf geben, ohne hitze vermengen. 7. Nach und nach Wasser hinzugeben und verrühren (ohne Hitze) 8. Bei mittlerer hitze das Fufu solange umrühren bis es sich selbständig vom Topf löst. 9. Fufu in 2 Bälle formen und auf einem Teller geben, sowie die Hähnchenkeulen und die Soße. Viel Spaß beim nachmachen ✌🏼

instructions: Melt the butter in a pan.
Add the minced onion, garlic, carrots, green bell pepper, and celery leaves. Sauté until softened.
Pour in the evaporated milk and all-purpose cream, stirring well.
Add the grated cheese and water, adjusting the water amount as desired.
Mix in the slurry mixture to thicken the sauce.
Add the chicken cube and stir until dissolved.
Taste and adjust seasonings like salt and pepper to your preference.

recipe.description: vegetarian The One True Cookie.
instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 175 degrees Celsius.
Step 2: In a bowl, combine 115g of unsalted butter, 100g of sugar, and 150g of brown sugar.
Step 3: Add 1 egg and a splash of vanilla essence to the mixture.
Step 4: Sift in 185g of all-purpose flour and 3g of baking soda.
Step 5: Mix until combined and fold in dark chocolate.
Step 6: Scoop the dough onto a baking tray.
Step 7: Bake for 12-14 minutes.

instructions: Step 1: Start by preparing the aubergines. Slice them and sprinkle with salt. Let them sit to draw out moisture.
Step 2: Heat olive oil in a pan and fry the aubergines until golden brown.
Step 3: In another pan, heat olive oil and sauté chopped onion and garlic until fragrant.
Step 4: Add fresh basil and tomato sauce to the onion and garlic mixture. Season with salt and let simmer.
Step 5: Toast the sourdough bread slices.
Step 6: Assemble the bruschetta by layering the fried aubergines, tomato sauce, mozzarella, and parmesan on the toasted bread.
Step 7: Garnish with fresh basil before serving.

recipe.description: vegetarian high protein balanced Egg Pie.
instructions: Step 1: In a bowl, combine 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour and 1/4 tsp salt.
Step 2: Add 1/2 cup butter and rub it together until it turns into fine crumbs.
Step 3: Add 4 tbsp cold water and mix until combined.
Step 4: Press the mixture into a pie dish and set aside.
Step 5: In another bowl, whisk together 4 eggs, 1 cup evaporated milk, 3/4 cup sugar, and 1 tsp vanilla extract.
Step 6: Pour the egg mixture into the prepared pie crust.
Step 7: Bake in a preheated oven until set.

instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 175 degrees Celsius.
Step 2: In a bowl, combine 115g of unsalted butter, 100g of sugar, and 150g of brown sugar.

Kolacja we dwoje, trochę świec, ulubiona muzyka i aromatyczne ragu — idealny przepis na miły wieczór.🫶 Ragu wołowe z makaronem Składniki (4 porcje): 	•	500 g karku wołowego, pokrojonego w kostkę ok. 2 cm 	•	2 łyżki oliwy 	•	1 średnia marchewka, przekrojona wzdłuż i pokrojona w plastry 	•	1 łodyga selera naciowego, pokrojona w plastry 	•	1 czerwona cebula, pokrojona w kostkę 	•	1 łyżeczka kakao 	•	1 łyżka sosu sojowego 	•	100 ml ciemnego piwa 	•	100 ml passaty pomidorowej 	•	100 ml bulionu drobiowego lub warzywnego 	•	sól i pieprz do smaku 	•	350 g makaronu tagliatelle lub pappardelle 	•	3–4 łyżki posiekanej natki pietruszki 	•	parmezan do podania Przygotowanie: Na oliwie obsmaż mięso na złoty kolor. Dodaj warzywa i smaż, aż cebula się zeszkli. Wsyp kakao, wlej sos sojowy i  piwo i gotuj na średnim ogniu około 5 minut. Następnie dodaj passatę i bulion, dopraw solą oraz pieprzem. Duś na małym ogniu 1–1,5 godziny, aż mięso będzie miękkie, a sos gęsty i aromatyczny. Ugotuj makaron al dente, dodaj go do ragu i gotuj razem jeszcze minutę, delikatnie mieszając. Podawaj posypane parmezanem i natką pietruszki. Smacznego 💛 #ragù #dinner #date #love #cooking

meta.description:
Okay you guys ALWAAAAYS ask me about my chip recipe and when I tell you they are so easy to do!!!!  You just need to get your potatoes, I often use a baking potato as you can get a longer chip as they’re bigger if that makes sense 🤣 but Maris Piper potatoes are also chefs kiss x Then you’re gonna slice your potato into THINNNNNN chips, not these big old potatoey things, we want our skin on fries to be skinnnyyyy queens 😌🤏🏼 and the key here is NO PEELING. Leave that skin ON!!!  Throw the fries into a large bowl and add in a drizzle of oil making sure the chips are coated well. Then we’re seasoning generously with salt and pepper and the magic 3: garlic salt, paprika and oregano!!! Don’t hold back 😇 mix everything together so the chips are fully coated  You can cook them how you like, however for maximum crisp I like to airfry mine on 205 degrees celcius for 18 mins or so! Thank me later 🫡  The mini cheese melts are just babybels coated in breadcrumbs, ideally you want to coat them in actual breadcrumbs and not bagels but it’s all I had in I had to improvise 🤣 golden breadcrumbs you buy from the shop are just fine!!! The burgers are 5% fat burgs from Aldi, they’re low cal and high protein. I just smash them down quite thin and grill them. THE TINFOIL TRICK!!!!! I’m sure this is very well known by now but assemble your burger together and wrap in tinfoil then pop into a preheated oven / airfryer for 3-5 mins or so and it comes out amaaaaazing 😍  If you wanna know anything else just comment hunniesss ❤️❤️❤️ #fyp #foryou #foryoupage #burgers #burgernight #homemade #food #recipes

instructions: Step 1: Peel & chop your vegetables & add to your oven dish.
Step 2: Drizzle with olive oil & add all your seasonings, add your garlic bulbs with tops cut off & roast in oven for 50mins at 200°C.
Step 3: Fry off your chorizo & scoop out for later.

Step 4: Once your veg is ready, add it to the pan with your chorizo oil & add ~800ml veg stock (depends on the consistency you like, more stock = more runny/more bowls, less stock = thicker, more of a mouthful).
Step 5: Blend & serve.
Step 6: Top with cream, chilli flakes, chorizo & a crusty roll with lots of butter.

notes: Adjust vegetable stock quantity to desired soup consistency.
Toppings are optional but recommended for extra flavor.

recipe.description: high protein low carb gluten free balanced chicken gnocchi soup.
instructions: Step 1: Chop the onion, garlic, carrots, and celery.
Step 2: In a pot, heat some oil and sauté the chopped vegetables until softened.
Step 3: Add the tomato paste and stir well.
Step 4: Pour in the chicken stock and water to fill the pot.
Step 5: Add half & half and season with garlic powder, dried Italian spices, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Step 6: Bring to a simmer and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Step 7: Stir in the shredded mozzarella and Parmesan until melted.
Step 8: Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.

meta.description:
Basic Vanilla Pastry Cream (crème pâtissière), salah satu isian klasik yang wajib lo kuasain. Gua pake resep dasar bergaya French, dengan aroma vanila yang elegan dan tekstur lembut yang nggak gampang pecah. Cocok banget buat isian kue soes, cream puff, éclair, tart buah, atau bahkan jadi dasar krim lainnya kayak diplomat cream. 📌 RESEP VANILLA PASTRY CREAM   – 250g Susu UHT Full Cream   – 50g Kuning Telur (±3 butir)   – 30g Gula Kastor (bisa disesuaikan sesuai selera)   – 20g Maizena   – 1 sdt Vanilla Bean Paste   – 20g Unsalted Butter 📌 CARA BIKIN   1. Panasin susu dan vanilla bean paste sampai hangat (jangan sampai mendidih).   2. Kocok kuning telur + gula + maizena sampai agak pucat dan ringan.   3. Tuang susu hangat sedikit demi sedikit ke adonan telur sambil diaduk.   4. Masak kembali di atas api kecil, aduk terus sampai mengental dan meletup. Jangan ditinggal ya!   5. Angkat, masukin butter. Aduk rata sampai nyatu. Kalau mau lebih halus, bisa disaring waktu masih panas.   6. Tuang ke wadah, tutup permukaannya pakai plastik wrap (harus nempel ke cream), lalu dinginkan minimal 4 jam — idealnya semalaman, supaya teksturnya lebih stabil dan rasanya lebih keluar. 📹 Video Cream Puff: (akan diupload setelah ini) Pake bahan simpel, hasil pro. meta.description:
Brownies fudgy, moist, shiny crust, tanpa brown butter! Yes, kali ini gua pake melted butter biasa. Tapi tetep dapet tekstur yang rich dan padat kayak truffle. Triknya? Gak ngocok telur sampe ngembang, cukup lelehkan coklat, butter, dan cocoa powder bareng. Dan karena melted butter masih ada kandungan air, cukup sedikit baking powder aja buat bantu naik. Gak butuh aerasi. Hasilnya tetep mewah! Panggang di suhu 170°C selama 20–22 menit. Tergantung oven masing-masing ya. Kalau bagian pinggir udah set tapi tengahnya masih sedikit goyang, itu tandanya pas! Jangan tunggu sampai set total, nanti brownies lo kering 😭😭 Lo ngerasa itu kayak kurang mateng? Coba bandingin ama burnt cheesecake deh! Itu tengahnya malah beneran lumer pas keluar dari oven. Tapi setelah dingin dan masuk kulkas, teksturnya nge-set dan jadi creamy. Nah, fudgy brownies juga gitu cara kerjanya! Jangan takut sama sedikit jiggle di tengah. Pas dingin nanti, justru bagian itulah yang bikin brownies lo lembut, fudgy, dan moist maksimal Fudgy Brownies (Melted Butter Version) : 110g Dark Couverture Chocolate (54%)  85g Unsalted Butter  18g Dutch Cocoa Powder    2g Espresso Bubuk Instan (larutkan dalam 1 sdt air panas)  60g Telur Utuh (suhu ruang) - 1 Butir Besar   17g Kuning Telur - 1 Butir Besar  80g Gula Kastor (Gula Pasir yang lebih halus, BUKAN GULA HALUS)  50g Dark Brown Sugar     1g Garam Halus  ½sdt Vanilla Extract  40g Tepung Protein Sedang    5g  Maizena    ⅛sdt Baking Powder  30g Dark Chocolate Chunk (potong-potong kecil ya, biar pas dingin di kulkas nanti nggak susah motongnya 😄) Pinch of Sea Salt (tabur sebelum panggang) #brownies #fudgybrownies #shinycrust #truffle #Resepbrownies #MoistBrownies #BrowniesMeltedButter#bakinghacks #fypシ #小芬芬
