meta.description:
Caramel Popcorn ala Homemade Premium Bahan Popcorn: 100g Jagung Popcorn Mushroom (jenis ini bentuknya lebih montok & bulat, jadi gampang banget terlapisi karamel secara merata) 1½–2 sdm minyak sayur netral Sedikit garam halus (opsional) **Kalau popcorn butterfly, bentuknya lebih “meledak” acak, ada banyak lekukan dan sayap-sayap. Itu bikin teksturnya ringan dan renyah, tapi justru susah dilapisin karamel rata, karamelnya bakal ngumpul di celah-celah tertentu, jadi nggak glossy merata kayak mushroom. Mushroom popcorn → bulat montok, perfect buat caramel/cheese coating. Butterfly popcorn → lebih cocok buat popcorn asin/seasoning bubuk, karena lapisannya nempel tipis-tipis aja Bahan Karamel Coating 150g Gula Pasir 30g Dark Brown Sugar (rasa lebih dalem + warna cakep) 15g Corn Syrup (bikin karamel stabil & glossy) 80g Unsalted Butter (suhu ruang) 60g Heavy/Whipping Cream (dihangatkan, biar gak pecah pas masuk) ½sdt Garam Halus ½sdt Vanilla Bean Paste (opsional, tapi wangi banget) ¼ sdt baking soda (bikin karamel airy & ringan) Teknik Oven : Popcorn mall/bioskop biasanya punya mesin khusus yang bisa muter & jaga suhu, jadi karamel bisa langsung rata & kering. Nah kalo homemade, oven itu gantinya. Kita panggang di 130°C selama 40 menit, tiap 10 menit popcornnya dikeluarin → aduk → masukin lagi. Tujuannya: karamel bisa melt ulang, nempel rata, dan hasil akhir kering kriuk, bukan lengket. Di adukan ke-3 (menit ke-30), taburin 10–15 g bubuk parmesan. Oven lagi 10 menit terakhir. Jadi ada kontras manis karamel + gurih umami keju. Ini bikin popcorn lo beda jauh dari popcorn mall/bioskop. Notes : Jangan pake butter dingin → bikin karamel pecah/minyak misah. Cream harus hangat, jangan dingin → kalo dingin bisa bikin karamel menggumpal & nyiprat bahaya. Jangan skip oven → popcorn bakal lengket & gampang melempem. Jangan langsung simpan selagi panas → tunggu dingin dulu, baru patah-patahin & simpan di toples kedap. Tips simpan: kalo udah dingin, masukin ke wadah kedap udara, bisa tahan 5–7 hari tetap kriuk. #popcorn #caramelpopcorn #homemadepopcorn #gourmetpopcorn #fypシ゚ #小芬芬

Oven: Signora De Noir Suhu Atas 160°C, Bawah 135°C Rak tengah, panggang 9–10 menit Bahan : 120g Unsalted Butter → hasil brown butter ± 99g 130g Light Brown Sugar 20g Castor Sugar 60g Telur utuh (kocok lepas, jangan sampai berbuih) 1 sdt Vanilla Extract (gua lupa masukin di video wkwk) 140g Tepung Serbaguna (AP Flour) 10g Almond Powder  10g Toasted Milk Powder 2.5g Baking Soda (rekomendasi: Arm & Hammer — lebih stabil dan reaktif) 2g Garam halus (boleh ganti sea salt halus) 150g Dark Couverture Chocolate 70% Kalau gak punya almond powder, boleh skip atau ganti tepung biasa. Tapi teksturnya bakal sedikit lebih padat dan chewy-nya berkurang, karena almond powder ini bantu jaga kelembapan dan kasih rasa nutty yang bikin cookiesnya terasa lebih “premium”. Chill adonan : • Setelah adonan jadi → dinginkan 20 menit, baru scoop/bentuk. • Lalu chill minimal 4 jam sebelum panggang. • Adonan tahan 3 hari di kulkas, atau 3 bulan di freezer. Kalau dari freezer : Diemin adonan 10–15 menit di suhu ruang dulu sebelum masuk oven. Dan selalu panasin oven sampai suhu yang diinginkan sebelum mulai manggang! Tips : Jangan campur butter + gula waktu butternya masih hangat (harus di bawah 35°C). Kalau enggak, adonan bisa misah minyak dan hasilnya jadi greasy, bukan chewy. Ciri khas soft cookies sejati : · Dia gak kering seluruhnya. · Kalau ditekan jari pelan, bagian tengahnya sedikit turun (lentur). · Waktu digigit, lo ngerasain kontras: crispy di awal, lalu chewy moist di tengah. · Begitu dingin pun, tekstur tengahnya masih lembut, bukan keras kayak biscuit. #softcookies #chewycookies #cookies #brownbutter #fypシ #小芬芬

meta.description:
🍌 Brown Butter Roasted Banana Bread Banana bread terenak yang pernah gua makan 😭 Moist, fudgy, ada coklat lumer + aroma roasted banana yang bikin nagih. Kalau banana bread lo belum pernah pake roasted banana + brown butter… Lo BELUM tau banana bread sebenernya! (pede banget luh 🫣) 📍 Loyang 10×20 cm tinggi 6–7 cm 📍 Panggang suhu 170°C selama 45–50 menit 👉 Tusuk sate harus keluar dengan remah lembab (bukan basah cair) Roasted Banana (bikin aroma legit dan caramelized) : 250g Pisang Matang Balurin 80g dark brown sugar (sisanya buat adonan basah) Panggang 180°C ±20 menit sampai caramelized & harum Lumat kasar (jangan terlalu halus) Brown Butter (kasi rasa nutty, deep, dan premium vibes) : 170g unsalted butter → dimasak jadi 140g brown butter (biarkan dingin sampe suhu 35-40C) Jangan sampai gosong. Kalau milk solid keburu hitam, saring biar nggak pahit. ** Kalo mau skip proses browning, bisa langsung pakai 140g melted butter (biarkan dingin sampe suhu 35-40C). Tetap moist dan enak, cuma rasanya lebih "clean", ngak ada depth nutty-nya. Bahan Basah : 140g Brown Butter (suhu 35–40°C) Sisa Dark Brown Sugar Pisang Roast yang sudah dilumat kasar 120g Telur (2 butir, suhu ruang)   30g Sour Cream/Plain Greek Yogurt (suhu ruang) 1 sdt Vanilla Bean Paste Bahan Kering : 130g All Purpose Flour (Tepung Pro Sedang)   20g Almond Flour ¾sdt Baking Soda ¼sdt Garam Halus ¼sdt Bubuk Kayu Manis 40g Dark Couverture Chocolate 54% 30g Cashew Nut cincang Topping : 1 pisang → belah 2 memanjang, tata di atas adonan Tabur tipis dark brown sugar di atas pisang & adonan Gua pake pisang brangan, boleh juga ganti pisang raja, pisang uli/ambon lumut, atau cavendish juga oke, tapi kuncinya harus pilih yang udah matang banget sampe kulitnya bintik2 hitam. Soalnya makin mateng, makin tinggi gula alaminya, pisangnya gampang caramelize pas dipanggang, wangi keluar maksimal, dan teksturnya bikin banana bread jadi moist banget Tips : Setelah keluar dari oven, diamkan 30 menit di loyang → keluarkan & dinginkan di suhu ruang minimal 1 jam. Wrap plastik dan simpan semalaman → besoknya auto moist parah & aromanya nyatu banget! #bananabread #brownbutter #roastedbanana

summary.name: Cookie Pie mit Nutella-Füllung
sample_steps: Den Backofen auf 175 °C Ober-/Unterhitze vorheizen.
Eine 26 cm Springform einfetten oder den Boden mit Backpapier auslegen.

meta.description:
Zutaten Für den Cookie-Teig * 250 g weiche Butter * 200 g brauner Zucker * 100 g weißer Zucker * 3 Eier (Größe S) * 2 TL Vanilleextrakt * 420 g Mehl * 1 TL Natron * ½ TL Backpulver * ½ TL Salz * 100 g Zartbitter- oder Vollmilch-Schokodrops Für die Füllung * 6–7 gehäufte EL Nutella Zum Verzieren * 100 g Zartbitter- oder Vollmilch-Schokodrops Tipp: Stellt die Nutella etwa 20–30 Minuten vor der Verwendung in den Kühlschrank. So bleibt sie beim Backen etwas kompakter und läuft weniger aus. (Funktioniert aber auch ohne.) Zubereitung 1. Den Backofen auf 175 °C Ober-/Unterhitze vorheizen. 2. Eine 26 cm Springform einfetten oder den Boden mit Backpapier auslegen. 3. Butter mit braunem und weißem Zucker 2–3 Minuten cremig aufschlagen. 4. Eier und Vanilleextrakt unterrühren. 5. Mehl, Natron, Backpulver und Salz vermischen und nur kurz unter den Teig heben. 6. Zum Schluss 100 g Schokodrops unter den Teig heben. Zusammensetzen * Etwa die Hälfte des Cookie-Teigs gleichmäßig auf dem Boden und leicht am Rand der Springform festdrücken. * Die Nutella darauf verstreichen und dabei rundherum einen 1–2 cm breiten Rand frei lassen, damit sie beim Backen nicht ausläuft. * Den restlichen Teig in kleinen Stücken auf der Nutella verteilen und die Lücken gut schließen. Backen * Den Cookie Pie ca. 35–40 Minuten backen. * Kontrolliert ihn nach etwa 20–25 Minuten. Wird die Oberfläche bereits zu dunkel, deckt sie locker mit Alufolie ab und backt ihn bis zum Ende der Backzeit weiter. * Da jeder Ofen unterschiedlich backt, kann die Backzeit leicht variieren. * Die Oberfläche sollte goldbraun sein. Die Mitte darf beim Herausnehmen noch leicht weich wirken, sollte aber nicht mehr flüssig sein – sie wird beim Abkühlen noch fester. Den Cookie Pie direkt nach dem Backen mit den restlichen 100 g Schokodrops bestreuen. Durch die Wärme schmelzen sie leicht an und haften perfekt auf der Oberfläche. Abkühlen Den Cookie Pie mindestens 45–60 Minuten abkühlen lassen. Lauwarm ist die Nutella im Inneren noch wunderbar cremig. Nach dem vollständigen Auskühlen lässt sich der Cookie Pie sauber schneiden und hat die perfekte Cookie-Konsistenz. #cookies #cookiepie #nutella #chocolate #goviral

recipe.description: high protein Mongolian Beef.
instructions: Cut the beef into thin strips, approximately 3 inches in size.
In a bowl, mix the beef with 2 tbsp oil, 1/2 tbsp salt, 1 tsp baking soda, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp paprika, 2 tbsp corn flour, and 1 tbsp water.
Mix well and leave it to marinate for 30 minutes to an hour.
In a pan, heat 4 to 5 tbsp oil over medium heat.
Add the marinated beef to the pan and cook until caramelized.
Add 5 to 6 cloves of chopped garlic and stir-fry.
Add a handful of chopped spring onions and 1 large white onion, sliced.
Pour in 1/3 cup soy sauce, 1 tsp black pepper, and 1 tbsp sugar.
Stir well and cook until everything is well combined and heated through.
Garnish with a handful of green springs before serving.

summary.name: Christmas Dinner Preparation
sample_steps: Step 1: Prepare the turkey and place it in the oven first.
Step 2: Boil the potatoes, drain them well, and place them in the oven about 2 hours before serving.

meta.description:
Your Christmas dinner timeline 🎄⬇️ Prep: If you have plenty of oven space and you’re a confident cook, you can make everything on the day. If not, you’ll want to get ahead the day before. The cranberry sauce and red cabbage will be just as nice when warmed up the next day, and other prep jobs like chopping veg, wrapping pigs in blankets, and setting the table will save you time, too.  Turkey: On the day, the first thing to go in the oven is your turkey. Don’t worry about timing it to come out perfectly with the rest of the meal — you’re better off cooking it on the early side, then wrapping tightly with foil and covering with a tea towel to keep it warm. The same goes for your pigs in blankets — you’ll want oven space later on, so get them in early then pop them back in the oven to warm up before serving. Potatoes: Once your turkey is in, start the potatoes. They always take much longer than people anticipate to get really golden and crunchy. I’d recommend you boil the potatoes, let them drain well so they’re nice and dry, then pop them in the oven about 2 hours before you want to serve dinner. You can always take them out once they’re golden brown, then pop them back in for 10 minutes before you serve up to make sure they’re still hot and crispy. Better that than have the whole meal ready to go while your potatoes are underdone! Sides: If you’re making everything on the day, this is your time to make the sides, such as cranberry sauce, red cabbage, stuffing etc. and have the rest of your vegetables prepped and ready to boil last minute. Yorkshires: Yorkshire puddings are best served fresh and need a very hot oven. Get most of the roast out of the way first, then start the Yorkshires about 45 minutes before serving. Whisk the batter then put them in the oven for 25-30 minutes. Make sure anything else in the oven can stay put for that time — once the Yorkshires are in, you mustn’t open the door, or they’ll sink!  Final tasks: While the Yorkshires cook, boil your veg, then use the vegetable water to make gravy. Once the Yorkshires are out of the oven, pop back in anything you’d like to warm up, then start serving! . . #cookingfromscratch #christmasdinner

meta.description:
Diese Linsenfladen hier hatten wir als Snack auf einem Ausflug mit und ich find sie einfach super, denn sie schmecken am besten, wenn sie ordentlich durchgezogen sind! Dazu sind sie auch schön handlich!  ➡️ Mein Kochbuch … … mit über 140 vollwertigen sowie pflanzlichen Gerichten. Egal ob für das schnelle Abendessen, Snack für Zwischendurch, die Kaffeetafel oder ein Festtagsessen. In meinem Kochbuch ‘Verwürzt Vegan’ findest du was für jeden Anlass und dazu noch ganz viel Hintergrundwissen. Einfach bestellen auf: auf www.verwürzt.de. 😊 ############# ##   REZEPT    ## ############# ----------------------- Würzig gefüllte Linsenfladen (4 Stück, Ø 24cm) ----------------------- 4 Tortilla-Wraps (Ø 24cm) Linsen: 180g braune Linsen (Berg) 540ml Wasser Optional: 2 Lorbeerblätter Linsenmischung: 1 kleine rote Zwiebel (80g, geschält) 2 Knoblauchzehen (gerieben) 1 EL Tomatenmark 3 EL frisch gehackte Petersilie 1 TL Paprikapulver (geräuchert) 1 TL Paprikapulver (edelsüß) 1 TL Kreuzkümmel (gemahlen) 1 TL Salz 1/2 TL Chiliflocken Salatmischung: 8 Blätter Romanasalat 1 große Rispentomate (140g) 1/3 Schlangengurke (140g) 4 EL frisch gehackte Petersilie 4 TL Zitronensaft Joghurt-Tahin-Sauce: 200g Pflanzlicher Joghurt 30g Tahin 2 EL Zitronensaft 1 TL Zitronenabrieb 1 Knoblauchzehe 1/3 TL Salz 1/3 TL Pfeffer ----------------------- Für die Linsen das Wasser mit Lorbeerblättern (optional) zum Kochen bringen, Linsen hineingeben und 20-25 Minuten kochen. Sie sollten durch, aber nicht matschig sein. Wasser abschütten und Linsen gut ausdampfen lassen. Je weniger Flüssigkeit noch vorhanden ist, desto besser.  Die Zwiebel in feine Würfel schneiden und dann alle Zutaten der Linsenmischung mit den Linsen vermengen sowie gut durchkneten. Es sollte eine streichfeste Masse entstehen. Die Mischung nun auf den Tortilla-Wraps (Ø 24cm) verteilen und glatt streichen. Mit dieser Seite nun in eine leicht eingefettete Pfanne geben und um die 5-6 Minuten auf mittlerer Stufe braten lassen.  Derweil die Sauce aus allen Zutaten anrühren. Gurke und Tomate klein würfeln.  Die fertigen gebratenen Wraps mit je 1 TL Zitronensaft beträufeln. In die Mitte jeweils 2 Salatblätter legen und darauf Gurke, Tomate sowie Petersilie verteilen. Zum Schluss mit der Sauce beträufeln. Zusammenfalten, indem du erst die untere Seite zu 1/3 nach oben klappst und dann rechts sowie links.  Meine Empfehlung: die fertigen Fladen zusammengefaltet im Kühlschrank einige Stunden durchziehen lassen! -----------------------

meta.description:
🌱 Heute gibt's eine cremige Orzo Pfanne mit 80 g Protein! 🥘💪 Den Großteil meines Lebens habe ich viel und gerne Fleisch gegessen. Ich hätte nie gedacht, dass ich mich irgendwann rein pflanzlich ernähren und vegan leben würde. Aber es macht mir sehr viel Spaß, es ist gesünder und ich esse total abwechslungsreich. Vegan zu leben bedeutet auch, dass weniger Tiere leiden müssen und das ist doch eine gute Sache! Zutaten (ca. 3 Portionen): * 200 g Orzo * 1 EL Olivenöl * 1 Zwiebel * 4 Knoblauchzehen * 150 g Cherry Tomaten * 150 g TK Edamame * 150 g TK Spinat * 2 Gläser Kichererbsen (ca. 430 g Abtropfgewicht) * 3 EL Misopaste * 2 EL Hefeflocken * Saft von 1 Zitrone * 1 Kelle Nudelwasser * 1 TL milde Chiliflocken * Salz & Pfeffer nach Geschmack Zubereitung: 1. Zwiebel würfeln und 3 Knoblauchzehen fein hacken. Öl in einer Pfanne erhitzen und beides auf niedriger Hitze glasig anschwitzen. 2. Nach und nach Tomaten, Edamame, Spinat und 1 Glas Kichererbsen (abgetropft) hinzufügen. Alles jeweils ein paar Minuten mitbraten. 3. Währenddessen die Orzo nach Packungsanleitung in Salzwasser kochen. Kurz vor Ende der Garzeit eine Kelle Nudelwasser abschöpfen. 4. Für die Soße: 1 Glas Kichererbsen inklusive der Flüssigkeit in ein hohes Gefäß geben. 1 Knoblauchzehe, Hefeflocken, Miso, Zitronensaft und das Nudelwasser hinzufügen und alles glatt pürieren. 5. Die fertigen Orzo mit in die Pfanne geben, mit der cremigen Soße übergießen und die Chiliflocken dazugeben. 6. Alles gut vermengen, kurz gemeinsam erwärmen und mit Salz und Pfeffer abschmecken. Nährwerte pro Portion (bei 3 Portionen): * Energie: 587 kcal * Protein: 27 g * Kohlenhydrate: 74 g * Fett: 11 g * Ballaststoffe: 15 g 👉 Speichern, ausprobieren und Bescheid sagen, wie’s geschmeckt hat! 🌻

meta.description:
Crispy Quinoa Salat 🥗 Knuspriger Quinoa trifft auf bunten Salat und die cremigste Erdnusssauce der Welt. Sooo lecker. Abspeichern und ausprobieren👇🏼 Du brauchst für eine große Schüssel (2 Portionen) 250 g Quinoa (gekocht) 2 Handvoll Erbsen oder Edamame ½ Gurke 1 Handvoll Radieschen 2 Avocados 2 Frühlingszwiebeln  2 Handvoll Crispy Salat Mix (optional) Frische Kräuter (ich liebe in diesem Salat Minze und Petersilie)  Für die Erdnusssauce 2–3 EL Erdnussmus 1 Schuss Sesamöl oder Olivenöl Saft von 1 Limette 1 Schuss Honig oder Ahornsirup Optional: 1 TL Sambal Oelek Optional: Schuss Sojasauce Kochendes Wasser  So geht’s Den gekochten Quinoa mit Gemüsegewürz auf ein Backblech geben, etwas auseinanderziehen und bei 200 °C ca. 30–40 Minuten backen. Zwischendurch einmal wenden. Währenddessen Gurke, Radieschen und Avocado schneiden und zusammen mit den Erbsen oder Edamame in eine Schüssel geben. Gehackte Kräuter und Frühlingszwiebeln dazu.  Für die Sauce Erdnussmus, Öl, Limettensaft, Honig oder Ahornsirup sowie Sambal Oelek und Sojasauce verrühren. Schluckweise kochendes Wasser dazugeben, bis die Sauce super cremig ist. Crispy Quinoa über den Salat geben, mit der Erdnusssauce toppen und alles gut vermischen. Mit Salz abschmecken.  Wenn du den Quinoa Salat mealpreppen möchtest, würde ich den Salat später frisch dazugeben oder einfach weglassen (auch richtig lecker).  Ich mag den Quinoa am liebsten mittel crunchy – außen leicht crunchy, innen noch weich.  #quinoa #quinoasalat #salatrezept #mealprep #healthyrecipes

meta.description:
Geschnetzeltes alla Tobi 🌱 Ich koche dieses Geschnetzelte aktuell mindestens 1× pro Woche. Die Sauce ist in unter 20 Minuten fertig, es ist proteinreich, macht satt und alle essen es gern. Genau solche Gerichte brauche ich im Alltag. Mit Kids, Arbeit, wenig Zeit und trotzdem dem Wunsch, vernünftig zu essen! Zutaten für 3 Portionen 120g Soja Streifen 250 ml Gemsüebrühe 2 EL Sojasauce 1 EL Olivenöl 150 g Cherry-Tomaten 1 Zwiebel 1 EL Tomatenmark 250 ml Sojasahne light 200 ml Gemüsebrühe 1/2 TL Majoran, getrocknet 1/2 TL Paprikapulver, rosenscharf 1/2 TL Knoblauchpulver Pfeffer nach Geschmack Frische Petersilie Beilage: Spätzle, Gnocchi oder Nudeln Zubereitung Zwiebeln würfeln und Cherrytomaten halbieren. Eine hohe Pfanne ohne Öl erhitzen. Sojastreifen hineingeben und 3–5 Min. trocken rösten, bis sie leicht angebräunt sind. 200 ml heißes Wasser oder Gemüsebrühe zugießen, Hitze reduzieren und 3 Min. schmoren, bis fast keine Flüssigkeit mehr da ist. Sojasauce einrühren. 1 EL Olivenöl und die Zwiebeln in die Pfanne geben und alles 2 Minuten bei mittlerer Hitze anbraten. Tomaten dazugeben und ebenfalls kurz anschwitzen. Tomatenmark in der Pfanne für 30 Sekunden anrösten und anschließend mit der Gemüsebrühe ablöschen. Sojasahne, Majoran und Paprikapulver dazugeben und alles mit geschlossenem Deckel für 5 Minuten köcheln lassen. Währenddessen die Beilage zubereiten. Zum Schluss mit Salz und Peffer abschmecken und mit frischer Petersilie servieren. Nährwerte pro Portion (bei 3 Portionen; ohne Beilage) 277 kcal 25 g Protein 14 g Kohlenhydrate 9 g Ballaststoffe 12 g Fett

🌱 Heute gibt’s cremige Mapo Tofu Udon! 🍜🔥 Mapo Tofu ist ja an sich schon absolutes Comfort Food, aber hast du mal probiert, den Seidentofu zu pürieren, statt ihn in Stücken zu lassen? Das macht die Soße so unfassbar cremig! Zutaten (ca. 3 Portionen): * 2 Packungen vorgegarte Udon (ca. 400 g) * 1 Packung Seidentofu (ca. 400 g) * 25 g Sojagranulat * 150 g Shiitake * 4 Frühlingszwiebeln * 3 Knoblauchzehen * 1 kleines Stück Ingwer * 375 ml Gemüsebrühe * 2 EL Doubanjiang * 1-2 TL Szechuanpfeffer, ganz * 1-2 TL milde Chiliflocken * 1 TL Sojasoße * 2 TL Agavendicksaft * 1 EL Speisestärke + 2 EL Wasser * 1 EL Olivenöl Tipp: Wenn du nicht extra Doubanjiang und Szechuanpfeffer kaufen willst, lass sie und auch die Chiliflocken weg. Nimm stattdessen eine Mischung aus 2 TL Misopaste, 2 TL Gochujang, 2 TL Crispy Chili Öl und 1 TL Sojasoße. Zubereitung: 1. Sojagranulat mit 75 ml Gemüsebrühe einweichen. Frühlingszwiebeln und Shiitake in Stücke schneiden. Knoblauch und Ingwer hacken. Seidentofu mit einer Prise Salz glatt pürieren. 2. Szechuanpfeffer kurz in einer Pfanne ohne Öl rösten, bis er duftet. Schwarze Samen und Zweige aussortieren. Nur die rötlichen Schalen im Mörser fein mahlen. Das Pulver durch ein feines Sieb geben. 3. Pilze trocken in einer Pfanne anbraten, bis sie kein Wasser mehr verlieren. Dann 1 EL Olivenöl und das Sojagranulat dazugeben und 2-3 Min. anbraten. 4. Frühlingszwiebeln dazugeben und 2-3 Min. mitbraten. Dann Knoblauch und Ingwer hinzufügen und 1-2 Min. mitrösten. 5. Chiliflocken, Szechuanpfeffer und Doubanjiang dazugeben, alles gut unterheben und 1-2 Min. anbraten. In der Zwischenzeit Stärke mit 2 EL Wasser glatt rühren. 6. Herd ausschalten, mit der restlichen Brühe ablöschen. Sojasoße, Agavendicksaft und Stärkegemisch dazugeben und alles sofort gut vermengen, bis es andickt. 7. Pfanne vom Herd nehmen. Udon nach Packungsanleitung zubereiten. 8. Alles zusammen anrichten und optional mit etwas Frühlingszwiebelgrün toppen und servieren. Nährwerte pro Portion (bei 3 Portionen): * Energie: 375 kcal * Protein: 17 g * Kohlenhydrate: 53 g * Fett: 8 g * Ballaststoffe: 6 g 👉 Speichern, ausprobieren und Bescheid sagen, wie’s geschmeckt hat! 🌻

recipe.description: high protein Honey BBQ Chicken Mac N Cheese.
instructions: Step 1: Cook the large elbow macaroni according to package instructions.
Step 2: In a saucepan, melt the unsalted butter over medium heat.
Step 3: Add chili powder, paprika, and garlic powder to the melted butter and stir.
Step 4: Pour in the evaporated milk, heavy cream, and milk, and mix well.
Step 5: Gradually add the pepper colby jack, gouda, and sharp cheddar, stirring until melted and smooth.
Step 6: Season the cheese sauce with salt to taste.
Step 7: In a separate bowl, combine the chicken thighs, buttermilk, and hot sauce. Let marinate.
Step 8: In another bowl, mix flour, garlic powder, chili powder, and paprika powder.
Step 9: Dredge the marinated chicken in the flour mixture, then coat with panko.
Step 10: Fry the chicken until golden brown and cooked through.
Step 11: For the honey BBQ sauce, mix ketchup, brown sugar, apple cider vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, hot sauce, honey, and cold butter in a saucepan over low heat until combined.
Step 12: Layer the cooked macaroni with the cheese sauce and top with fried chicken and additional cheese for layering.
Step 13: Drizzle with honey BBQ sauce before serving.

meta.description:
🌮 Taco Burger 🇹🇷Malzemeler Kıyma için: Kişi sayısına göre küçük boy lavaş Küçük boy 1 taco burger için yaklaşık 55–60 g orta yağlı dana kıyma (Ben tek çekim kıyma kullandım.) Tuz Karabiber Ceddar peyniri Not: Ben 10 adet küçük boy taco burger hazırladım ve toplam 600 g kıyma kullandım. Hazırlanışı Kıymayı tuz ve karabiber ile lezzetlendirip güzelce yoğurun. Ardından yaklaşık 55–60 g olacak şekilde porsiyonlara ayırıp yuvarlayın. Kıymayı lavaşın üzerine yerleştirin ve elinizle iyice bastırarak lavaşın üzerine ince bir şekilde yayın. Yapışmaz tavayı  ısıtın. Kıymalı tarafı alta gelecek şekilde lavaşları tavaya yerleştirin ve yaklaşık 2 dakika kızartın. Daha sonra taco burgerleri çevirin ve üzerine çedar peyniri ekleyin. Tavanın kapağını kapatıp peynir eriyene ve lavaşın altı güzelce kızarana kadar pişirin. Pişen taco burgerleri tavadan alın. Üzerine dilediğiniz malzemeleri ve sosları ekleyip servis edin. 🍔 Burger Sosu Malzemeler 120 g mayonez 2 tatlı kaşığı ketçap 2 tatlı kaşığı hardal 1 diş sarımsak, ezilmiş 1 yemek kaşığı çok ince doğranmış kornişon turşu 3-4 tatlı kaşığı turşu suyu ½ tatlı kaşığı şeker Bir tutam tuz Bir tutam karabiber ½ tatlı kaşığı kırmızı toz biber  Hazırlanışı Tüm malzemeleri bir kaseye alın ve güzelce karıştırın. Sosunuz hazır. Ayrıca: ½ adet beyaz soğan ½ adet kırmızı soğan 2 tatlı kaşığı soya sosu 1 tatlı kaşığı esmer şeker ½ yemek kaşığı tereyağı Hazırlanışı Soğanları yarım ay şeklinde doğrayın. Tereyağını tavada eritin ve soğanları ekleyin. Orta ateşte, ara sıra karıştırarak soğanları yavaşça kavurun. Ardından esmer şekeri ve soya sosunu ekleyin. Ara sıra karıştırarak soğanları güzelce karamelize edin. Hazırladığınız karamelize soğanları sosa ekleyip karıştırın.  🌮 Taco Burger 🇩🇪 Zutaten Kleine Tortilla-Wraps, je nach Personenanzahl Pro kleinem Taco Burger ca. 55–60 g Rinderhackfleisch, mittlerer Fettanteil (Ich habe einfach gewolftes Rinderhack verwendet.) Salz Pfeffer Cheddar-Käse Hinweis: Ich habe 10 kleine Taco Burger zubereitet und dafür insgesamt 600 g Hackfleisch verwendet. Zubereitung Das Hackfleisch mit Salz und Pfeffer würzen und gut durchkneten. Anschließend in Portionen von jeweils ca. 55–60 g aufteilen und zu Kugeln formen. Das Hackfleisch auf die Tortilla-Wraps legen und mit den Händen gut andrücken, sodass es dünn und gleichmäßig auf dem Wrap verteilt ist. Eine beschichtete Pfanne erhitzen. Die Wraps mit der Hackfleischseite nach unten in die heiße Pfanne legen und ca. 2 Minuten anbraten. Anschließend die Taco Burger wenden und mit Cheddar-Käse belegen. Den Deckel auf die Pfanne setzen und braten, bis der Käse geschmolzen und die Unterseite des Wraps schön knusprig und goldbraun ist. Die fertigen Taco Burger aus der Pfanne nehmen, nach Belieben mit weiteren Zutaten und der Sauce belegen und servieren. Burger Sauce Zutaten 120 g Mayonnaise 2 TL Ketchup 2 TL Senf 1 Knoblauchzehe, gepresst 1 EL sehr fein gehackte Gewürzgurken 3–4 TL Gurkenwasser ½ TL Zucker Eine Prise Salz Eine Prise Pfeffer ½ TL Paprikapulver Zubereitung Alle Zutaten in eine Schüssel geben und gut miteinander verrühren Außerdem: ½ weiße Zwiebel ½ rote Zwiebel 2 TL Sojasauce 1 TL brauner Zucker ½ EL Butter Zubereitung Die Zwiebeln in halbe Ringe schneiden. Die Butter in einer Pfanne schmelzen und die Zwiebeln hinzufügen. Bei mittlerer Hitze unter gelegentlichem Rühren langsam anbraten. Anschließend den braunen Zucker und die Sojasauce dazugeben. Unter gelegentlichem Rühren weiterbraten, bis die Zwiebeln schön karamellisiert sind. Die karamellisierten Zwiebeln zur Burger Sauce geben und gut miteinander verrühren.

meta.description:
Kinder Country Oats / Protein- und Ballaststoffreich 🍫🧚‍♀️ Welche Variante möchtet ihr als Nächstes? 🥹 Yogurette, Raffaello, Germknödel und Kinder Pingui sind schon online! 🍫  Folgt mir gerne, um kein Rezept zu verpassen 🧚‍♀️ REZEPT (1 Portion) Oats: * 60g kernige Haferflocken  * 3-4 El (Soja)Joghurt * 10g Chiasamen * 10g Vanille Protein (oder Haferflocken + Vanilleextrakt) * 10g Cashewmus oder helles Mandelmus * 1-2 Tl Süße nach Wahl (Dattelmus, Ahornsirup, Chicorée Sirup …) * Pflanzenmilch + Wasser Schoko-Schicht: * 15g dunkle Schokolade (z.B. mit Datteln gesüßt) * 1 El gepuffter Dinkel Alle Zutaten für die oats vermengen und etwas Pflanzenmilch und Wasser zum verdünnen hinzugeben. Da die Haferflocken & Chiasamen aufquellen, darf das Ganze zu Beginn noch relativ flüssig sein. Für mindestens eine halbe Stunde quellen lassen und bei Bedarf noch mehr Flüssigkeit hinzugeben. Wenn die Konsistenz cremig (aber nicht zu fest) ist, in ein Glas füllen. Die Masse wird noch weiter andicken, daher sollte es noch nicht zu „sticky“ bzw. zu „dick“ sein. Schokolade schmelzen und den gepufften Dinkel unterrühren. Über die Oats geben und verteilen, sodass alles bedeckt ist. Nun für mindestens 2h oder über Nacht im Kühlschrank ziehen lassen. Am besten mit etwas frischem Beeren genießen! #gesunderezepte #overnightoats #ohneraffiniertenzucker

meta.description:
CHINESE TOMATENSOEP 🥣🥫🇨🇳 | NIEUWE SERIE  - ALLES VAN DE AFHAAL #1 🥡⛩️🇨🇳 | Recept 👇 Ik heb een grote liefde voor het Chinees-Indisch restaurant, want alles wat je daar kunt eten smaakt gewoon als iets dat niet te evenaren is. Daarom heb ik mezelf voorgenomen om de hele menukaart zelf te maken! Dus dit is mijn nieuwe serie ALLES VAN DE CHINEES! We trappen af met een klassieker: de Chinese tomatensoep! Recept 🌟 9,5 ⏳️ 50 minuten 🥣 8 grote kommen Ingrediënten  - 2 el zonnebloemolie + extra om ei te bakken - 2 rode uien - 4 tenen knoflook - stuk gember van ongeveer 4 cm - 140 gram tomatenpuree - 3 blikken tomatenblokjes (1200 gram) - 2 sinaasappels - 200 gram appelmoes - 100 ml azijn - 125 gram suiker - 3 el ketjap manis - 5 el gembersiroop - 1 à 2 el sambal oelek - 3 blokjes kippenbouillon  - 1 tl vetsin (optioneel) - 400 gram kipfilet - 100 gram rijstnoedels - 4 eieren - 125 gram taugé  - lente-ui ter garnering - peper en zout - 1 à 2 el maïzena  Klaarmaken: 1. Snijd de rode ui grof. 2. Bak de rode ui een paar minuten in een scheut zonnebloemolie. 3. Schil de gember en pel de knoflook. 4. Rasp de gember en de knoflook. 5. Bak de gember en knoflook 1 à 2 minuten mee. 6. Bak de tomatenpuree ook kort mee. 7. Voeg de tomatenblokjes en 2 liter water toe (ik heb buiten beeld nog extra water erbij gedaan).  8. Snijd de sinaasappels in plakken. 9. Doe de plakken sinaasappel, appelmoes, sambal, ketjap, gembersiroop, suiker, azijn, kippenbouillon en eventueel vetsin in de soep. 10. Breng de soep aan de kook. 11. Laat de kipfilets gaar koken in de soep. 12. Haal de kip en sinaasappel uit de soep. 13. Pureer de soep. 14. Pluk de kip met 2 vorken uit elkaar. 15. Doe de kip terug in de pan. 16. Breek / sla / knip de rijstnoedels in stukken. Kook die gaar in de soep. Dat duurt maar een paar minuten.  17. Maak een papje van 1 à 2 el maizena (ligt eraan hoe veel je de soep wilt indikken) en evenveel water. Bind hier de Chinese tomatensoep mee. 18. Breng de soep eventueel op smaak met peper en zout. 19. Kluts 2 eieren met peper en zout naar smaak. 20. Bak een dunne omelet (in een pan met een beetje olie). 21. Laat de omelet een beetje afkoelen (anders verbrand je je vingers) en rol hem dan op.  22. Snijd dunne reepjes van de omelet. 23. Één omelet is voldoende voor 3 of 4 kommen soep, dus bedenk even of je nog meer omeletten moet bakken. 24. Schep een kom vol soep. 25. Leg er omeletreepjes, een klein handje tauge en ringetjes lente-ui op. Eet smakelijk! 😋 #food #koken #eten #cooking #recept #recipe

instructions: Preheat the pot.
In a bowl, mix 2 cups of salt and 1.5 cups of sugar.
Add lemon zest.
Beat 6 eggs for 7 minutes until creamy.
Mix in 1 cup of plain yogurt.
Add 0.5 cup of butter and 0.5 cup of vegetable oil.

Coat the blueberries with flour before adding to the butter to prevent sinking.
Add vanilla essence.
Bake the cake in a preheated pot for 1 hour.
For the syrup, combine blueberries, 0.5 cup of sugar, lemon zest, and corn flour mixed with water to thicken.

meta.description:
Die einfachste Hühnersuppe (ohne ganzes Suppenhuhn) 🙌 Suppe: 1 Kilogramm Hähnchenschenkel 2 Karotten ¼ Knolle Sellerie 2 Zwiebeln 3 Zehen Knoblauch 1 Porree (Lauch) 2,5 Liter Wasser 1 Teelöffel Salz ½ Bund Petersilie 2 Lorbeerblätter 10 Pfefferkörner (ganz) Suppeneinlagen 2 Karotten, fein gewürfelt 1 Porree, halbiert und in feine Halbmonde geschnitten ¼ Knolle Sellerie, fein gewürfelt 200 Gramm Suppennudeln (z.B. Orzo Nudeln) Zubereitung: 1. Karotten und Sellerie schälen und in grobe Stücke schneiden. Zwiebel schälen und vierteln. Knoblauchzehen schälen, Porree halbieren, gründlich waschen und ebenfalls in grobe Stücke schneiden.  2. Hähnchenschenkel in einen großen Topf legen. Karotten, Zwiebeln, Knoblauch, Sellerie und Porree dazugeben und mit Wasser aufgießen. Salz, Lorbeerblätter, Pfefferkörner und Petersilie dazugeben und zum Kochen bringen. 3. Sobald das Wasser kocht, die Hitze etwas reduzieren und die Suppe für 90 Minuten ohne Deckel leicht köcheln lassen. In der Zwischenzeit gelegentlich den Schaum, der sich immer wieder auf der Oberfläche bilden wird, mit einem Löffel oder Teigschaber abschöpfen und entfernen. 4. Fleisch aus dem Topf holen und auf ein großes Brett oder Blech legen. Suppe durch ein feines Sieb abseihen, die Brühe dabei in einem zweiten Topf auffangen. Verkochtes Gemüse entfernen und Brühe zurück auf den Herd stellen. Suppengemüse dazugeben und in der leicht köchelnden Brühe bissfest garen. Im der Zwischenzeit die Nudeln in Salzwasser kochen. 5. Haut von den Hähnchenschenkeln trennen und entfernen. Fleisch vom Knochen ablösen und Knorpeln entfernen. Fleisch mit zwei Gabeln in mundgerecht Stücke zerkleinern und zurück in die Suppe geben. 6. ingredients.name: 2 to 2 ½ pounds boneless, skinless raw chicken breast tenders (or thin-sliced chicken breasts)

½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese
Optional: chopped fresh parsley for garnish

instructions: Place the chicken breast in a large slow cooker. Pour the heavy cream and chicken broth over the chicken breast. Add the sliced butter, cubed cream cheese, Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Cover the slow cooker with the lid and cook on high for 3 hours or low for 5 hours until the chicken is cooked through and fork tender.
Remove the chicken from the slow cooker and place on a large plate. Whisk the sauce in the slow cooker until smooth. Shred the chicken with forks, then add back to the slow cooker.
Add the uncooked rigatoni and the Parmesan cheese. Re-cover the slow cooker with the lid and cook on high for 30 minutes or until the pasta is tender.
Serve hot with fresh parsley for garnish if desired.

recipe.description: high protein gluten free balanced Peruvian Lomo Saltado.

ingredients.name: 1 pound sirloin or tenderloin steak (sliced into thin strips against the grain)
3 tablespoons neutral oil (divided (2 for steak, 1 for vegetables))

instructions: Make the Aji Verde: Add cilantro, jalapeños, mayonnaise, Parmesan, minced garlic, lime juice, and black pepper to a blender. Blend until smooth and creamy. Transfer to a bowl, cover, and refrigerate until ready to serve.
Prep Steak: Add sliced steak to a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and toss. Add cornstarch, baking soda, smoked paprika, salt, cumin, oregano, and black pepper. Mix very well until evenly coated.

Cook Steak: Heat 2 tablespoons neutral oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat. Add steak in a single layer. Let it sear undisturbed for 1–2 minutes to develop deep color, then toss and cook until browned but not overcooked. Remove from the pan and set aside.

Cook Veggies: Add the remaining 1 tablespoon neutral oil to the same pan over high heat. Add red onion wedges and cook 2–3 minutes until slightly softened but still crisp with charred edges. Add minced garlic and cook about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in beef broth and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Add the tomato wedges and cook briefly, about 1 minute, just until they begin to soften but still hold their shape.
Return the steak to the pan.
Add soy sauce, aji amarillo paste, sugar, and distilled white vinegar directly to the pan. Toss everything together over high heat so the sauce coats the meat and reduces slightly.
Turn off the heat and fold in chopped cilantro. Gently fold in hot, crispy French fries so they absorb some sauce while keeping texture.
Serve immediately with warm white rice and aji verde on the side.
recipe.name: Peruvian Lomo Saltado

ingredients.name: 1.5 pounds chicken breast cut into small pieces

instructions: To a ziplock bag, add flour, cornstarch, sprinkle of salt, and sprinkle of black pepper to taste. Mix together.
In a deep bowl, whisk together eggs, sprinkle of salt, and sprinkle of black pepper to taste.
Add all the chicken into the wet batter.

Take out the chicken one piece at a time, letting the wet excess drip off and transfer to the ziplock bag. Once all the chicken is in the bag, seal it tightly and shake it around well until each piece is coated evenly. Take out the chicken, shaking any excess dry batter off and set aside.

Over medium-high heat to a saucepan, add soy sauce, honey, ketchup, rice vinegar, brown sugar, red pepper flakes, sesame oil, and minced garlic. Mix together, bring to a simmer, and then lower the heat. Combine the water and cornstarch and pour in the pan to thicken the sauce into a glaze. Once it coats the back of spoon, take off the heat and transfer to a large bowl. Set aside.
To stir-fry the veggies, add sesame oil to a pan over medium-high heat. Once hot, toss in the bell peppers and green beans. Sauce for about 5 minutes or until golden.

Heat vegetable oil to 350°F in a frying pan. Drop the breaded chicken in, making sure not to overcrowd. Fry in two batches. Once golden, about 5 to 6 minutes, take out of the oil and drain on a wire rack.
Toss the chicken in the sauce/glaze along with the veggies and sesame seeds.
Enjoy with rice or noodles.

instructions: White Sauce
Whisk together mayo, toum, sour cream, black pepper, lemon juice, sugar, and water to desired consistency until smooth. Set aside.
Chicken Shawarma

To a large bowl, add the chicken thighs, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and spices. Mix to marinade evenly. For more flavor, you can score the chicken before marinading and let it sit overnight or for at least half an hour.

Heat oil in a cast iron skillet or pan over high heat. Add the chicken and cook on each side until a nice brown crust develops, about 4 minutes on each side. Then turn the heat to low and cover to cook for a few minutes more until cooked in the center.
Transfer the chicken to a cutting board. Once cooled to touch, chop into small pieces.
Optional: Add the chopped chicken back to the pan and give it a quick fry for extra flavor.
Yellow Rice
Wash rice for 2 minutes with warm water or until the water runs clear. Another option is to let it soak in water for 30 minutes and then drain.
To a pot over medium heat, add the ghee or butter. Then, add the rice and toast it for about 3 minutes until fragrant.

Add the chicken broth, turmeric, oregano, cumin, salt, and bay leaf. Mix together and bring to a boil. Then lower the heat to simmer, cover, and cook for about 11-12 minutes. Turn off the heat but leave covered for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes, take off the lid, remove the bay leaf, and fluff with a fork.
Assembly
In a plate, add rice, chicken, tomatoes, lettuce, and pita bread. Drizzle tons of white sauce and some hot sauce on top.

Prepare the sauce: In another bowl or measuring cup, whisk beef broth, low sodium soy sauce, brown sugar, oyster sauce,

recipe.description: high protein high fiber gluten free balanced Chinese Beef & Broccoli.

ingredients.name: 1 pound flank (NY strip, or ribeye steak, thinly sliced against the grain)

instructions: Marinate the steak: In a medium bowl, toss the sliced steak with cornstarch, dark soy sauce, baking soda, white pepper, and salt. Set aside.

Prepare the sauce: In another bowl or measuring cup, whisk beef broth, low sodium soy sauce, brown sugar, oyster sauce, rice vinegar, dark soy sauce, cornstarch, white pepper, and cayenne powder together until smooth. Set aside.

Cook the broccoli: Heat 1 tablespoon neutral oil in a large pan or wok over medium heat. Add broccoli and stir-fry briefly. Add a splash of water, cover, and steam for 2-3 minutes until broccoli is tender-crisp. Remove broccoli and set aside.

Cook the steak: Over medium-high heat, heat the wok or pan until it’s very hot, then add 1 1/2 to 2 tablespoons neutral oil. Add the marinated steak and stir-fry until just cooked through and seared, about 2-3 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Sauté aromatics: Lower the heat to medium-low. Add sesame oil and 1/2 tablespoon neutral oil to the pan. Add garlic and ginger, sauté gently until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Combine: Return broccoli and steak to the pan. Pour in the sauce and toss everything together until the sauce thickens and coats evenly, about 1-2 minutes.
Serve hot with rice or noodles.

We love our cream cheese pound cake so much but sometimes we don't need to bake a whole cake. Here's our favorite recipe for a half batch of Cream Cheese Pound Cake. Find the full recipe below!👇️⁠
⁠
✨REMINDER: Don't forget to save this recipe for later!✨⁠
⁠
Ingredients:⁠
• 1 2/3 cups White Lily® Enriched Bleached All-Purpose Flour⁠⠀⁠⁠
• 1/4 teaspoon salt⁠⠀⁠⁠
• 3/4 cups butter, softened⁠⠀⁠⁠
• 1/2 (4 oz.) package cream cheese, softened⁠⠀⁠⁠
• 1 1/2 cups sugar⁠⠀⁠⁠
• 3 large eggs⁠, at room temp⁠⁠
• 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract⁠⠀⁠⁠
• 1/4 teaspoon almond extract⁠⠀⁠⁠
⁠
Directions:⁠
1. Heat oven to 325°F. Coat loaf pan with flour no-stick cooking spray.⁠⠀⁠⁠
⁠
2. Combine flour and salt in small bowl; set aside. Beat butter and cream cheese with an electric mixer for about 60 seconds or until smooth. Add sugar gradually; beat on medium-high speed 5 minutes or until mixture is light and fluffy.⁠⠀⁠⁠
⁠
3. Beat in eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Stir in vanilla and almond extract. Fold in flour just until combined (do not overmix). Spoon batter into prepared pan.⁠⠀⁠⁠
⁠
4. Bake 55 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Cool in pan on cooling rack 15 minutes. Remove from pan. Cool completely on cooling rack.

Hot Cheetos Mozzarella Sticks

Ingredients
	•	16 oz mozzarella (block)
	•	5 eggs
	•	1 (8 oz) bag hot Cheetos
	•	Oil, for frying

Instructions
In a bowl, whisk the eggs and set aside. Add the Cheetos to a plastic bag and crush until very fine, then transfer to a separate bowl. Cut the mozzarella block into 12 sticks. meta.description:
Sheet Pan Cashew Chicken

Ingredients:
For the Base:
- 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes
- 2 cups fresh broccoli florets
- 1 large red bell pepper, chopped into bite-sized chunks
- 1/2 large red onion, cut into thick chunks
- 1 cup whole unsalted cashews

For the Sticky Stir-Fry Sauce:
- 1/2 cup low-sodium soy sauce
- 1/4 cup hoisin sauce
- 2 tbsp honey
- 2 tbsp rice vinegar
- 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tsp fresh ginger, minced or grated
- 2 tbsp cornstarch
- 1/4 cup cold water

Instructions:
1. PREP AND PREHEAT: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a large, rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper or aluminum foil for effortless cleaning.
2. MIX THE SAUCE: In a medium bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, hoisin sauce, honey, rice vinegar, sesame oil, minced garlic, and minced ginger. In a separate small cup, mix the cornstarch and cold water until completely smooth, then stir it thoroughly into the main sauce.
3. PARTIAL BAKE THE CHICKEN: Place your cubed chicken in a separate bowl and toss with exactly half of the prepared stir-fry sauce. Spread the chicken out into an even, single layer on the prepared sheet pan. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes so it begins cooking through and seals in its juices.
4. ADD VEGETABLES & CASHEWS: Safely remove the hot sheet pan from the oven. Add the broccoli florets, chopped bell peppers, red onions, and whole cashews directly onto the pan alongside the chicken.
5. COAT AND ROAST: Drizzle the remaining half of the stir-fry sauce over all the newly added vegetables and cashews. Using tongs, toss everything together right on the pan until evenly coated, then spread it back out into a flat, single layer.
6. ROAST TO PERFECTION: Return the pan to the oven and bake for an additional 12 to 15 minutes. The chicken should reach an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C), the sauce should turn into a thick, sticky glaze, and the vegetables should be beautifully crisp-tender. Serve hot over rice or grains.

* 75 g low-fat paneer

* ½ inch ginger
* ½ tsp baking powder
* Salt to taste
* ½ tsp oil
* Water as needed

1. Add paneer, Greek yogurt, chilli, ginger, oil, and a splash of water to a mixer. Blend until smooth.

3. Transfer to a large microwave-safe mug.
4. Add Eno and 1 tsp water. Mix gently.
5. Microwave for 2-2½ minutes until cooked through.
6. Let it rest for 1 minute and enjoy.

meta.description:
𝗖𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘀𝗲 𝗛𝗲𝗿𝗯𝗮𝗹 𝗖𝗼𝗹𝗱 𝗕𝗿𝗲𝘄 𝗧𝗲𝗮 🌿🍵
This Chinese-style cold brew I shared before hit 1M+ views, and many of you asked:
👉 𝗖𝗮𝗻 𝗜 𝗯𝗼𝗶𝗹 𝗶𝘁 𝗶𝗻𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗮𝗱 𝗼𝗳 𝗰𝗼𝗹𝗱 𝗯𝗿𝗲𝘄𝗶𝗻𝗴? 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁’𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗱𝗶𝗳𝗳𝗲𝗿𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲?
Here’s the simple answer ⤵️
𝗖𝗼𝗹𝗱 𝗯𝗿𝗲𝘄 𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻 ❄️
• Lighter, cleaner, more refreshing
• Lower maintenance — just soak & chill
• Slower infusion = crisp taste
• Great for hot days
𝗕𝗼𝗶𝗹𝗲𝗱 𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻 🔥
• Stronger, deeper, more concentrated
• More traditional method
• Warm, comforting, cozy
• Perfect for rainy days or when you’re under the weather
How to make it (same ingredients, 2 ways 🫙)
• Add your Chinese herbal ingredients into a jar or pot
➡️ Cold brew:
Top with room-temperature water → chill 6–8 hours or overnight
➡️ Boiled:
Simmer gently in water 15–30 minutes → strain & enjoy warm
Same ingredients. Different vibes.
It really depends on your mood ✨

meta.description:
Welcome to my “Make it, Don’t Buy It” series!  Here, I’ll teach you how to make simple things that you usually buy at the store, starting with butter.  It’s not just about making your own food—it’s about having the skills to make it when you need to.  Butter is a perfect place to start. It’s easy, fun, and something you’ll be proud of every time you use it. Homemade Butter Recipe -Pour about 2-4 cups of heavy cream into a stand mixer bowl. You can use a hand mixer or whisk by hand, but it will take much longer to reach the right consistency. -Turn the stand mixer on high speed. Be sure to cover the mixer with a towel at first, as it will splatter. The cream will first turn into whipped cream and then start to separate into butter and buttermilk. This process will take about 10 minutes. -Keep mixing until the butter solidifies and separates from the buttermilk. The buttermilk will be the liquid left behind — save it for other recipes like buttermilk pancakes or buttermilk ranch. -Once the butter has separated, remove it from the mixer and place it in a bowl. Rinse the butter under cold water, squeezing it to remove any remaining buttermilk. The more you squeeze, the longer your butter will last. -If you like salted butter, now is the time to add a pinch of good-quality sea salt. Stir it in thoroughly. -To store, fold the butter into parchment paper, shaping it into a log. You can store it in the fridge as a log or place it in a butter dish. #toddlermama #healthysnackideas #homemadebutter

meta.description:
Welcome to my “Make it, Don’t Buy It” series!  Here, I’ll teach you how to make simple things that you usually buy at the store, starting with butter.  It’s not just about making your own food—it’s about having the skills to make it when you need to.  Butter is a perfect place to start. It’s easy, fun, and something you’ll be proud of every time you use it. Homemade Butter Recipe -Pour about 2-4 cups of heavy cream into a stand mixer bowl. You can use a hand mixer or whisk by hand, but it will take much longer to reach the right consistency. -Turn the stand mixer on high speed. Be sure to cover the mixer with a towel at first, as it will splatter. The cream will first turn into whipped cream and then start to separate into butter and buttermilk. This process will take about 10 minutes. -Keep mixing until the butter solidifies and separates from the buttermilk. The buttermilk will be the liquid left behind — save it for other recipes like buttermilk pancakes or buttermilk ranch. -Once the butter has separated, remove it from the mixer and place it in a bowl. Rinse the butter under cold water, squeezing it to remove any remaining buttermilk. The more you squeeze, the longer your butter will last. -If you like salted butter, now is the time to add a pinch of good-quality sea salt. Stir it in thoroughly. -To store, fold the butter into parchment paper, shaping it into a log. You can store it in the fridge as a log or place it in a butter dish. #toddlermama #healthysnackideas #homemadebutter

Some seasons you’ll make things like this, some seasons you won’t, and both are totally okay. Having the option matters. This is a perfect easy recipe to replace your store bought peanut butter. Homemade peanut butter can be better because you control exactly what goes into it.  There’s no seed oils or no refined sugars, just one real ingredient you recognize.  Peanut butter is one of the easiest kitchen staples you can start making at home today. Or really any nut butter!  Ingredients: -3 cups roasted or raw peanuts -optional add a pinch of sea salt  Directions: -Place 3 cups of peanuts in the bowl of a food processor. -Turn on the food processor and blend continuously. The peanuts will go through stages. Starting as crumbs, then turning into a thick paste, and finally becoming smooth and creamy. This process usually takes 4–5 minutes. Stop and scrape down the sides as needed for an even texture. -Transfer the peanut butter to an airtight jar. Store at room temperature for up to 1–2 weeks or in the fridge for longer freshness. #momhacks

recipe.description: vegetarian low carb keto gluten free balanced Cultured Butter.
instructions: Step 1: Pour 2 cups of heavy cream into a jar.
Step 2: Add 1/4 cup of plain yogurt to the cream.
Step 3: Stir the mixture well to combine.
Step 4: Cover the jar and let it sit at room temperature for 12-24 hours until it thickens.
Step 5: Once thickened, pour the mixture into a mixing bowl.
Step 6: Use a mixer to whip the mixture until it separates into butter and buttermilk.
Step 7: Drain the buttermilk and rinse the butter under cold water.
Step 8: Store the cultured butter in the refrigerator.

instructions: Step 1: Preheat your oven to 400°F and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Step 2: Sprinkle a thin layer of shredded cheese onto the parchment.
Step 3: Add an onion round, thinly sliced, leaving a little space between each slice.
Step 4: Top each onion round with more shredded cheese, making sure the onions are tucked between the cheese.
Step 5: Bake for 15 minutes, or until the cheese is golden and crisp around the edges.
Step 6: Let them cool completely on the baking sheet. As they cool, they’ll crisp up just like chips!

meta.description:
HOMEMADE BUTTER 🧈✨ all you need are a mason jar, some heavy cream, sea salt + a little muscle 💪🏻 homemade butter just hits different. plus, you get a great arm workout in the process 😅 YOU NEED (use organic ingredients when possible) * 1 c heavy cream * a pinch or two of sea salt WHAT TO DO - pour heavy cream into a mason jar and put on the lid - now shake, shake and shake some more - shake as vigorously as possible for about 10 minutes and when it kind of looks like deflated whipped cream, add in the sea salt - shake about 5 more minutes + once you notice a thud when shaking, you should see butter covered in buttermilk! - drain the buttermilk into a bowl and either save it or empty it, then put the butter into a bowl of ice water - squeeze out excess buttermilk (empty bowl and repeat ice water + squeezing if necessary) store in an airtight container in the fridge up to 5 days be sure to LIKE + FOLLOW @wellnessrains for more easy, healthy recipes ❤️ #butter #diy #homemade #homemadebutter #fyp

recipe.description: vegetarian low carb keto gluten free balanced Homemade Butter.
instructions: Step 1: Pour heavy cream into a mason jar and put on the lid.
Step 2: Shake vigorously for about 10 minutes until it looks like deflated whipped cream.
Step 3: Add in the sea salt and shake for about 5 more minutes.
Step 4: Once you notice a thud when shaking, you should see butter covered in buttermilk.
Step 5: Drain the buttermilk into a bowl and either save it or empty it.
Step 6: Put the butter into a bowl of ice water and squeeze out excess buttermilk.
Step 7: Empty the bowl and repeat ice water and squeezing if necessary.
Step 8: Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 5 days.

recipe.description: vegetarian low carb keto gluten free balanced Homemade Butter.
instructions: Step 1: Start by adding Heavy Whipping Cream to your mixer.
Step 2: Turn on medium and start whisking.
Step 3: Keep going until butter separates from milk.
Step 4: Clean off the beater.
Step 5: Remove the milk from butter.
Step 6: Strain one more time.
Step 7: You now have buttermilk! Save for later to make other recipes!
Step 8: Form the butter into a ball and submerge in ice water.
Step 9: 'Wash' the butter and squeeze out the water.
Step 10: Continue this, changing out water, until water is clear when squeezed out.
Step 11: Squeeze out remaining water, and dry butter.
Step 12: You can stop here, or add in salt.
Step 13: If salting, give it a good mix.
Step 14: Flatten out onto parchment paper, and form into sticks.
Step 15: Then enjoy the satisfaction of homemade butter!
recipe.name: Homemade Butter
notes: Save the buttermilk for later use in other recipes.
Salt is optional and can be added to taste.

meta.description:
TWO INGREDIENT COOKIES. Recipe 27/100:. INGREDIENTS 2 large, very ripe spotted bananas (165 g or 170ml) 2.5 cups (packed) finely ground almond flour (280 g or 600 ml) METHOD Heat + Prep: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. The Base: Peel + mash the bananas in a mixing bowl until they form a smooth, consistent puree. Mix: Pour in the almond flour + work it into the mashed banana using a fork until it’s perfectly smooth + holds together. Form: Roll approximately one tablespoon of dough between your palms to form a ball. Place each ball onto the prepared baking sheet. The Signature Press: Use the back of a fork to press down firmly on each ball, creating the classic criss-cross pattern. Bake: Place in the oven for 13 - 16 minutes. You are looking for a slight golden brown finish on the edges + the bottom. Set: Remove from the oven + allow them to cool on the baking sheet for at least 15 minutes. These are soft, banana-style cookies - this cooling phase is non-negotiable for them to firm up + become crisp! SAVE this one for the 4 PM serotonin boost. And SHARE this with a sister who needs to stop eating cardboard “health” bars! P.S. Are you a 2-ingredient purist, or are you already thinking of ways to break the rules + add chocolate chips? 👇

instructions:
Heat and put oil in wok. 

Add egg and scramble.  

Add 250 g of rice and toss with 1 whole egg for a few minutes.

Add 10 g pickled cabbage, pinch of salt and sugar. 

Toss properly until well combined. 

Then put some beetroot purée to make enough to create a bright pink colour. 

Put rice in a bowl. 

Add more oil to the wok and put 125 g scallops and 125 g prawns toss in to cook. 

Cook for a few seconds and put 25 g of XO sauce on top of the seafood. 

Once cooked, remove from wok and add on top of the beetroot fried rice. 

Garnish with micro greens, pickled ginger and salmon caviar on the top.

recipe.description: high protein low carb balanced Southern Fried Chicken.

ingredients.name: 1/4 cup Creole Seasoning (I used Creole Kick)
Enough Frying Oil to Cover Half the Chicken (heat to 350 - 360 degrees F)

instructions:
Start by washing and thoroughly drying your chicken pieces. Pat them dry with paper towels to ensure a crispy crust.


In a large resealable plastic bag, combine the buttermilk, pickle juice, and a bit of water (the exact measurements can be found in the description box below). You want enough liquid to immerse your chicken pieces comfortably.


Place the chicken pieces into the bag, ensuring they are fully submerged in the buttermilk mixture. Seal the bag and massage it gently to evenly distribute the flavors. You can let it marinate in the refrigerator for about two hours, but overnight is even better for maximum flavor.


Step 2: Prepare the Seasoned Flour


In a mixing bowl, combine the all-purpose flour, Creole Kick, onion powder, salt, and freshly ground black pepper. The Creole Kick adds that distinctive Southern flavor.


Mix the dry ingredients thoroughly to ensure that the seasoning is evenly distributed throughout the flour. You should be able to see and taste the spices in the mixture.


Step 3: Bread the Chicken


Remove the marinated chicken pieces from the bag and let them drip slightly to remove any excess buttermilk. We want the chicken damp, but not overly wet.


Coat the chicken pieces with the seasoned flour mixture. Make sure they're completely covered with the flour, giving them a good shake to remove any excess.


Gently press the flour onto the chicken to ensure the coating adheres well. Place the breaded chicken on a baking sheet and let them rest for a few minutes to let the coating adhere even better.


Step 4: Heat the Oil

Heat your vegetable oil in a deep skillet or frying pan to a temperature of around 350-360 degrees Fahrenheit. You can use a meat thermometer to check the temperature. When you see the oil start to shimmer and produce a few ripples, it's ready for frying.

Step 5: Fry the Chicken


Carefully place the breaded chicken pieces into the hot oil, working away from you to avoid any splattering.


Fry the chicken for about 10-15 minutes, turning occasionally to ensure even cooking. The internal temperature of the chicken should reach 165 degrees Fahrenheit, ensuring that it's cooked through and safe to eat.


When the chicken reaches a beautiful golden brown color, it's time to remove it from the oil. Place it on a wire rack to let any excess oil drain.


          Enjoy Your Southern Fried Chicken!
recipe.name: Southern Fried Chicken

Welcome back to Dumb Dinners, my weekly series for anyone who has to feed people every night and would like to spend as little time doing it as humanly possible. No fancy techniques, no long ingredient lists, and nothing you have to stand over.

Comment “RECIPE” and I’ll send you the recipe card. It’s also down here for you 👇🏼

Dumb Dinner: Crockpot Lazy Meatball Lasagna

What you’ll need:
1 jar marinara sauce (32 oz)
¾ cup water
8 oz dried lasagna noodles, broken into pieces (not oven-ready)
1 cup whole milk ricotta
1¾ cups shredded mozzarella, divided
About 30 frozen bite size meatballs
⅓ cup grated Parmesan
1 tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp garlic powder

How to make it:
Spray the crock pot or use a liner
Stir the marinara, water, ricotta, and seasonings right in the crock
Break the noodles in, add the frozen meatballs and ½ cup of the mozzarella
Stir everything together and press the noodles down under the sauce
Cook on high, checking at 2 hours (or low, checking at 3)
Top with the rest of the mozzarella and the Parmesan, cover 20 min to melt
Rest 10 min with the lid off before scooping

meta.description:
During sick season, I love having simple homemade remedies on hand that can help soothe symptoms and support the body while it recovers. 🍍🍯

Some over-the-counter cough medicines aren’t recommended for young children and may come with unwanted side effects. And because coughing is one of the ways our bodies naturally move mucus, I also like using gentle remedies that can soothe the throat rather than focusing only on suppressing a cough.

One of our favorites is fermented pineapple honey. It’s incredibly easy to make, tastes delicious, and combines ingredients traditionally used during cold and cough season.

You’ll need:

* 1 fresh pineapple core, chopped into small pieces
* 4 whole cloves
* ½ tsp thyme
* ½ tsp cinnamon
* ½–1 cup organic raw honey

How to make it:
Add everything to a clean glass jar and mix well. Let it sit on the counter overnight or for up to 24 hours, then strain and refrigerate.

We enjoy it by the spoonful during sick season or when we want something soothing for the throat. 🍯

Important: Honey should never be given to babies under 12 months old. For children with persistent, severe, or worsening coughs, breathing trouble, high fever, or other concerning symptoms, check with their pediatrician.

#holisticmom 
#crunchymama #naturalremedieswork #lowtoxliving

🥚🧀 Fluffy Cottage Cheese Protein Muffins

Looking for an easy high-protein breakfast with almost no ingredients? These fluffy cottage cheese muffins are made with just **two simple ingredients** and can be customized sweet or savory! 💛

⏱️ **Prep & Cook Time:** About 25 minutes
🍽️ **Makes:** 6–8 muffins

 🛒 Ingredients

* 1 cup (225 g) cottage cheese
* 1 cup beaten eggs

**Optional Flavor Ideas**

* Cheddar or mozzarella + herbs 🧀🌿
* Garlic and Italian seasoning 🧄
* Blueberries or raspberries 🫐
* Cinnamon + your favorite sweetener ✨

 👩‍🍳 How to Make Them

1️⃣ Preheat your oven to **350°F (175°C)** and prepare a muffin pan.

2️⃣ Add the cottage cheese and eggs to a blender.

3️⃣ Blend until smooth, creamy, and completely combined.

4️⃣ Pour the mixture evenly into the muffin cups.

5️⃣ Add any desired toppings or flavorings.

6️⃣ Bake for about **20 minutes**, until puffed and firm in the center.

7️⃣ Let the muffins cool for a few minutes before removing them.

8️⃣ Enjoy warm, or refrigerate them for an easy grab-and-go breakfast.

✨ **Light, fluffy, cheesy, and protein-packed — these little muffins are proof that simple ingredients can make an amazing snack!**

meta.description:
I wish more people knew how easy it is to make chocolate syrup at home. I’ve been making it for 10+ years.

5 minutes. 4 ingredients. No corn syrup. No junk.

Just rich, chocolatey goodness you can drizzle on everything — ice cream, pancakes, fruit, straight into milk 🍫

Your kids will think you bought it. 

Kristin | The Freshly Milled Homesteader Homemade Chocolate Syrup Recipe 

1 ½ cups water
1 cup sugar
1 cup cocoa powder
1 teaspoon vanilla
dash of salt (optional)

In a saucepan over medium heat, combine water, sugar, cocoa powder and dash of salt. 
Mix until no clumps remain and stir constantly until the mixture begins to thicken and simmers. 
Remove from heat and allow to cool. Add vanilla and stir. 
Store in glass jar in the fridge for 1-2 weeks

meta.description:
Ingredients
 * 16 oz ditalini pasta
 * 16 oz kielbasa, sliced
 * 1-2 tbsp butter
 * 8 oz cream cheese, cubed and softened
 * ¾–1 cup grated Parmesan cheese
 * 1 cup reserved pasta water
 * 2 tbsp Cajun seasoning (to taste)
 * 1 tsp garlic powder
 * 1 tsp onion powder
 * 1 tsp Italian seasoning
 * 1 tsp red pepper flakes 
 * Salt & black pepper, to taste

Instructions
 1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the ditalini until al dente.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water, then drain and set pasta aside.
 2. In a large skillet over medium-high heat, cook the sliced kielbasa until browned and slightly crispy. Do not drain the pan.
 3. Reduce heat to medium and remove kielbasa. Add butter to the kielbasa pan and let it melt.
 4. Add cream cheese and stir until softened and melty.
 5. Sprinkle in Cajun seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Season generously.
 6. Slowly pour in the reserved pasta water, stirring constantly, until a creamy sauce forms.
 7. Add drained pasta directly into the skillet and toss to coat.
 8. Stir in Parmesan cheese until melted and creamy.
 9. Add the kielbasa back in (if removed), toss everything together, taste, and adjust seasoning as needed.
 10. Serve hot with extra Parmesan on top.

Notes
 • Add more pasta water if the sauce thickens too much.
 • This dish loves bold seasoning, don’t be shy.
 • Optional add-ins: spinach, bell peppers, or a splash of cream for extra richness.

Fermented garlic honey - your winter self will thank you 🍯🧄

The only honey I use for my garlic honey:

Garlic and honey have been used as medicine for thousands of years across so many cultures (ancient Egypt, Greece, China, Ayurvedic tradition, and more).

🤍 Soothes a sore throat
🤍 Garlic releases allicin - nature’s antimicrobial
🤍 Honey is unreal for calming coughs
🤍 Supports your gut + immune system
🤍 Antioxidant-rich
🤍 Helps break down bacterial biofilms
🤍 Lasts basically forever in your pantry

How to make it:

Fill a clean, COMPLETELY dry glass jar halfway with peeled organic garlic cloves

Pour raw, unfiltered honey over the top until the garlic is fully covered (leave room at the top - it bubbles!)

Seal it, and burp + flip the jar every single day

Keep it at room temp, out of direct sunlight

Ready in about 3-4 weeks - and it only gets better with time

A few IMPORTANT things:

⚠️ Use raw, unfiltered honey only - the processed stuff won’t ferment
⚠️ Keep the garlic fully submerged in honey at all times (never let it poke up into the air)
⚠️ Burp it daily so pressure doesn’t build up
⚠️ Your garlic might turn blue/green - totally normal and harmless!
⚠️ For extra peace of mind, add a splash of raw apple cider vinegar and/or test with a pH strip (you want below 4.6)
⚠️ NEVER give honey - fermented or not - to a child under 1 year old

Not medical advice - I’m a health coach, not a doctor. If you’re pregnant, immunocompromised, or on medication, check with your provider first 🤍

Save this for summer and let’s get fermenting!

Sourdough Starter Guide ⬇️

Don’t overthink sourdough — you can start your starter today with just flour + water 🥖

🧂 Basic ratio:
½ cup flour + ¼ cup filtered water

📅 Simple 7-Day Starter Plan:

Day 1:
Mix ½ cup flour + ¼ cup water in a clean glass jar.
Cover loosely and leave at room temperature for 24 hours.

Day 2:
Add ½ cup flour + ¼ cup water again.
Stir well and cover loosely.
No bubbles yet? That’s normal.

Days 3–6:
Discard half of the starter.
Feed with ½ cup flour + ¼ cup water.
Repeat once daily.

Day 7:
Your starter is ready when it:
✅ has lots of bubbles
✅ smells fresh and tangy
✅ doubles in 4–6 hours after feeding

⚠️ Tip:
If it doesn’t double by Day 7, keep feeding every 8–12 hours until active.

PEANUT SAUCE BUTTER BEANS
Serves 4
INGREDIENTS:
1/2 cup creamy peanut butter
3/4 -1 cup water
3 tablespoons reduced sodium soy sauce
1 tablespoon toasted sesame oil
1/2 tablespoon sriracha
1/2 in ginger, grated
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 (15-oz) jar butter beans, drained and rinsed
1/2 lime, juiced
To serve: chili crisp, cilantro, pita

DIRECTIONS: 
Add the peanut butter, water (start with 3/4 cup and add more if needed to thin the sauce), soy sauce, sesame oil, sriracha, ginger, and garlic to a skillet over medium heat. Bring to a simmer and whisk for 2-3 minutes or until thick and creamy. �
Add the butter beans and stir well to coat in sauce. Cook for another 2-3 minutes to warm up the beans. Turn off the heat and stir in the lime juice. Garnish with chili crisp, cilantro, and sesame seeds. �
Serve with naan or pita for dipping or scoop into a bowl with rice and veggies.

sample_steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).

meta.description:
Creamy Greek Chicken & Broccoli Bake
Tender seasoned chicken, broccoli, spinach, and four creamy cheeses come together in this hearty Greek-inspired casserole. Fresh dill and feta give every bite a bright Mediterranean flavor, while bubbly mozzarella makes the top irresistible!

🛒 Ingredients
1¾ lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces
2 medium broccoli crowns, cut into florets
1 small onion, diced
Fresh spinach, chopped
3 large eggs
⅔ cup milk
1 cup cottage cheese or ricotta
3 Tbsp olive oil, plus more for sautéing
½ cup panko breadcrumbs or almond flour
½ cup grated Parmesan cheese
5 oz feta cheese, crumbled
1 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded
Fresh dill, minced
Paprika, to taste
Garlic powder, to taste
Onion powder, to taste
Salt, to taste
👩‍🍳 Directions

Preheat the oven to 375°F.

Boil the broccoli florets for about 2 minutes, until just fork-tender. Drain thoroughly.

Sauté the diced onion in olive oil until golden. Add the chopped spinach and cook until wilted. Drain and squeeze out as much excess moisture as possible.

Season the chicken pieces with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder. Sear in olive oil until golden.

Whisk the eggs, milk, cottage cheese, olive oil, seasonings, panko breadcrumbs, fresh dill, spinach mixture, Parmesan, and crumbled feta together.

Spread the broccoli across the bottom of a 9×13-inch baking dish and arrange the chicken over it.

Pour the creamy feta mixture evenly over the chicken and broccoli, then finish with shredded mozzarella.

Bake for 35–40 minutes, until bubbling and golden. For extra color, broil briefly at the end.

Prep Time: 20 minutes
Cook Time: 35–40 minutes
Total Time: 55–60 minutes
Servings: 6–8

 Probably the coziest meal I’ve ever made 🍂French Onion 🧅 Pot Roast Pie —with Maple Garlic Mashed Potatoes

Cook Time: About 5 hours
Serves: 6–8

Ingredients

French Onion Pot Roast

* 3–4 lb chuck roast 
* Kinder's Flavors Flavors Sunday Pot Roast Seasoning
* 2 tbsp olive oil Graza 
* 6 small yellow onions, thinly sliced
* 2 tbsp butter
* 2 tbsp tomato paste
* 4 cloves garlic, minced
* ½ cup dry red wine
* 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
* 2 cups Kettle & Fire beef broth
1 tbsp dried thyme
2 bay leaves

Maple Garlic Mashed Potatoes

* 3 lbs Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and chopped
* 4 tbsp butter
* ½ cup Organic Valley heavy cream or whole milk
* 3–4 cloves roasted or minced garlic
* 1–2 tbsp pure maple syrup
* Salt + pepper, to taste
For the Top

* ½ cup shredded Gruyère cheese
* ¼ cup freshly grated Parmesan
* Fresh thyme

Instructions

1. Sear the roast.
Preheat oven to 325°F. Season the chuck roast generously with Kinder’s Sunday Pot Roast Seasoning.

Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the roast on all sides until browned. Remove and set aside.

2. Caramelize the onions.
Add butter and sliced onions to the same Dutch oven.

Cook over medium-low heat for 20–30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the onions are soft, golden and caramelized.

3. Build the sauce.
Add tomato paste and garlic. Cook for about 1 minute.

Pour in the red wine and Worcestershire sauce. Stir and scrape up all the browned bits from the bottom of the pot.

Let simmer for a few minutes until slightly reduced.

4. Slow cook the roast.
Pour in the beef broth and return the chuck roast to the Dutch oven.

Cover and bake at 325°F for about 4 hours, or until the meat easily falls apart with a fork.

5. Make the maple garlic mashed potatoes.
Boil potatoes in salted water until fork-tender. Drain well.

Add potatoes, butter, cream, garlic and maple syrup to a stand mixer. Mix until creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
6. Shred + assemble.
Remove the Dutch oven from the oven and shred the roast directly into the French onion gravy.

Spread the maple garlic mashed potatoes evenly
